Job Summary
As a Consultant you will help the team deliver and contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring client engagements are executed in an efficient manner.


Responsibilities
Your client responsibilities:
Conduct the engagement in a professional manner and in accordance with client expectations and as defined by the terms and conditions of the contract.
Preparation and filing of individual tax return, e-TDS return, drafting of submissions before tax authorities, representation before the tax authorities, advising on outbound/ inbound structuring in connection with movement of employees, working knowledge of immigration and provident fund in connection with expatriates, etc
Your people responsibilities:
Exhibit positive attitude and demonstrate willingness to learn.
Work constructive with team to evaluate and improve personal and team performance.
Contribute and leverage knowledge from individuals, databases and other sources.
Provide timely and high-quality services and work products that exceed client expectations.
Operational Excellence / Day to day responsibilities:
Participate in executing work within a group by assisting by delivering work effectively, and teaming with tax professionals to provide comprehensive tax solutions.
Ensure that the areas of work assigned are executed in accordance with the work programme and the firms methodologies and guidance, and professional standards.
Use electronic working papers, efficiently including various software applications and sources of knowledge in an appropriate manner to conduct research.
Acquire and demonstrate competence in technical knowledge, and compliance process by keeping up to date on trends, developments and technical authorities and apply them to moderately complex situations.
Analyze and convert data into a tax product (advisory/compliance) and ensure accuracy and timeliness of the product.
Where applicable thoroughly check documents and make available for tax inspections in an appropriate manner.
Demonstrate professionalism through a positive and cooperative attitude and by maintaining the confidential and proprietary nature of client relationships and related work products.
Contribute to the overall success of the team by developing a thorough understanding of our methodologies and tools to enhance service delivery; keeping team members informed of work status; actively seeking assignments when unassigned; proactively seeking opportunities to provide tax services; challenging traditional procedures used in the past; and attempting to find new approach


Skills and attributes for success
Good Communication skills (Written Oral)
Proficient in MS word, excel, power point
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
Strong Analytical/Numerical ability
Enthusiastic and Self Starter
Team Player
Ability to grasp details
Good time management skills


To qualify for the role you must have
A certified CA
0-1 year of relevant experience


Ideally you'll also have
Good interpersonal skills
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

Title: Consultant FP&A
Location: Bangalore
Shift: General Shift
Education: CA Mandatory
Experience: 0 to 1 year experience in FP&A.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Financial Analyst to join our Finance Controllership Team in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will be responsible for budgeting, forecasting, P&L preparation, pricing, and preparation of industry specific and company specific KPI. This role requires close collaboration with the Business and Business Operations team to ensure accurate data preparation and support business decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
• Budgeting and Forecasting: Develop and maintain budgets and forecasts in alignment with business goals and strategies.
• P&L Preparation: Prepare and analyze Profit & Loss statements to provide insights into financial performance and compare results against forecasts.
• Pricing: Assist in pricing strategies and analysis to ensure competitive and profitable pricing models.
• Preparation and reporting of KPI: Design and implement key performance indicators to monitor business performance and provide actionable insights.
• Business Support: Collaborate with the Business and Business Operations teams to provide detailed financial reports and explanations for variances.
• Data Accuracy: Ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial data and reports.
• Decision Support: Provide financial analysis and recommendations to support business decisions, while working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, leveraging strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Qualifications and Experience:
• Chartered Accountant with 0 to 1 years of relevant experience in FP&A. • Proven experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and P&L preparation.
Preferred Skills:
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Advanced skills in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
• Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle and SAP.
• Superior understanding of financial analysis and accounting principles, as well as industry specific financial practices and regulations.
• Proficiency in financial modeling and data analysis tools. Like Power BI, Tableau
AboutCompany: Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world. Operating in hundreds of locations across the globe, CGI delivers end-to-end services and solutions, including strategic IT and business consulting, systems integration, intellectual property, and managed IT and business process services

Description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Business Development Associate (BDA) who will work closely with property owners and prospective tenants to facilitate property transactions and close deals.

The candidate will receive leads from the company, visit properties with clients, understand owner requirements, identify potential tenants, and drive the deal to closure.

Key Responsibilities
Handle company-generated leads and connect with potential clients/tenants.
Visit properties and show them to prospective tenants/clients.
Travel approximately 3040 km daily for property visits and client meetings.
Understand and manage property owner requirements.
Identify suitable and potential tenants based on property requirements.
Coordinate between property owners and tenants throughout the transaction.
Conduct property visits, explain property details, and address client queries.
Negotiate and follow up with both parties to close the deal.
Maintain regular follow-ups with leads until closure.
Build strong relationships with property owners and clients.
Maintain updated records of leads, property visits, follow-ups, and closures.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Real estate knowledge is preferred.
Good understanding of property types, location, configuration, and surface/built-up/carpet area.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Good convincing, negotiation, and sales skills.
Comfortable with daily field travel of 3040 km.
Ability to understand client and owner requirements and match them effectively.
Target-oriented and strong in follow-ups.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple property/client requirements.
Ideal Candidate

Someone who is sales-driven, confident in client interactions, comfortable with field work, and has a good understanding of the real estate market.

If you enjoy meeting clients, exploring properties, and closing real estate deals, this role is for you!

Description:
EY- Assurance Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.


The opportunity
We're looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.


Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.


Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.


To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.


Ideally, youll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.


What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Job Summary
Analyst Complex Securities
As part of our EY-Valuations team, you will help clients understand the value of their business, securities, intellectual property, capital equipment, intangibles and other assets. The group is comprised of several key areas, including business valuation, business modelling, capital equipment and complex securities
The opportunity
We are looking for Analyst with expertise in Quantitative Finance and Complex Securities Valuation to join EY-VME (Valuation, Modelling and Economics). This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a prominent firm and develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring, and learning & development
Your key responsibilities
Demonstrated an aptitude in the quantitative and qualitative analyses of financial instruments, including options, warrants, fixed income securities, and other derivatives.
Knowledge of numerical techniques such as Monte Carlo simulation, lattice techniques, and finite difference methods.
Knowledge of valuation of instruments like incremental borrowing rate (IBR), Employee Stock Options (ESOPS), Total Shareholder Return (TSR), Convertible Bonds, Bonds with embedded options etc.
Strong derivative pricing and financial modelling skills, with the ability to create both valuation and financial models based on a description of a clients derivative financial asset or operational and financial business plan.
Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
Identify issues and propose strategies related to the procedures executed.
Assume a major role in valuation report writing and detailed financial modelling.
Maintain and develop positive, productive, and professional relationships with EY offices globally.
Demonstrate teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members.
Use current technology and tools to enhance the effectiveness of services provided.
Identify business development opportunities and assist Partners and Senior Managers on proposals and new business opportunities.
Stay abreast of current business and economic developments relevant to our as well as the client's business.
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent thoughtfulness, communication, interpersonal and teaming skills
Experience in Equity Research, Investment Banking and Corporate Finance
Experience in financial modelling, including experience building models from scratch in MS Excel and related software preferred
Knowledge and experience in any of the following sectors will be added advantage Financial Services, Oil and Gas, Technology, Consumer Products, Power and Utilities and Life Science
Willingness and ability to travel, when necessary
Exposure to databases such as Capital IQ, Bloomberg etc.
Experience in analytics tools and techniques like Python, R, VBA, PowerBI etc.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A post graduate degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting (CA) or Business with 1-3 years of related work experience
A minimum of 1 to 3 years direct experience in utilizing Valuation techniques and methodologies such as Purchase Price Allocations (PPA), Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Income Approach, market comparable, etc. in a business valuation firm or practice or in venture capital, investment banking, commercial banking, financial research, national valuation firm or experience working in a corporate finance role for an organization, preferably for M&A activities Experience in financial modelling including experience building models from scratch in MS Excel and related software preferred
Preferable achievement in or significant progress towards a CFA, ASA, CPA or related certification
Ideally, youll also have
Project management skills
Strong communication and presentation skills
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of a market-prominent, multi-disciplinary team of 1400+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with prominent businesses across a range of industries

Skilled in Advanced prompt engineering
Nice-to-Have:
Awareness about various AI Agents/ Agentic workflow frameworks and SDKs
Graph Database such as Neo4j
Experience with M365 Copilot Studio
Microsoft Azure AI-900/ AI-102 Certification

Excellent learning ability.
Strong communication skill.
Flexibility to work both independently and as part of a larger team.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
The ability to adapt your work style to work with both internal and client team members.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors / masters degree in software engineering / information technology / BE/ B.TECH
An overall 3 5 years of experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented GRC Analyst to support Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) technology and business process initiatives. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a willingness to learn new technologies, and a basic understanding of risk, compliance, and business processes.
This role offers an excellent opportunity to build expertise in leading GRC platforms such as Archer, ServiceNow IRM, Process Unity, Aravo, and other risk and compliance solutions.
Your Key Responsibilities
Support GRC implementation and support activities across risk, compliance, audit, policy, or third-party risk management areas.
Assist in requirement gathering, documentation, configuration, testing, and user support.
Work with senior team members to understand business requirements and translate them into tool-based solutions.
Support data validation, report preparation, dashboard updates, and basic workflow testing.
Assist in preparing user stories, process documents, test cases, and training materials.
Participate in UAT, defect tracking, issue analysis, and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with project teams and maintain clear communication on assigned tasks and status updates.
Monitor project deliverables and provide regular status updates to project leads.
Demonstrate ownership, willingness to learn, and ability to adapt to new GRC platforms and client requirements
Stay updated on emerging GRC trends, regulatory requirements, and technology platforms.
Skills and attributes for success
02 years of experience in GRC - Risk Management, Policy and Compliance Management, Audit Management, or related technology domains.
Basic understanding of databases, software applications, and business processes.
Good analytical, logical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to learn new tools and technologies quickly.
Team player with a positive attitude and ownership mindset.
Good to Have (Preferred Qualifications)
Basic knowledge of GRC concepts, Risk Management, Compliance, Audit, or Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM).
Exposure to any GRC platform such as Archer, ServiceNow IRM/GRC, Process Unity, Aravo, OpenPages, or Audit Board.
Understanding of CRUD operations, workflows, and business process automation.
Familiarity with Excel, Power BI, SQL, or reporting tools.
Knowledge of SDLC, Agile, or project delivery methodologies.
Soft Skills
Strong communication and effective stakeholder communication.
Ability to work independently as well as in crossfunctional teams.
Detailoriented with strong documentation and requirementanalysis abilities.
Strong logical and analytical thinking.
Learning agility and adaptability.
Collaboration and teamwork.
Problem-solving mindset.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (B.Tech preferred).

02 Years

Biz Print Publishing, working with several leading US business and technology magazines, invites aspiring writers to join a dynamic editorial team that produces content for global business and technology magazines. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of innovation, covering influential companies, emerging technologies, industry trends, and executive thought leadership from around the world.

As a writer, you will create compelling company features, in-depth research articles, executive profiles, and business news stories that inform and inspire professional audiences. Along the way, you'll gain valuable exposure to diverse industries, engage with cutting-edge ideas, and develop expertise in business journalism, research, and strategic storytelling.

Learn to use modern AI tools, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and other emerging technologies used by leading global publishers. You'll receive structured training in AI-assisted research, fact-checking, editorial workflows, prompt engineering, and content development.
Learn practical prompt engineering techniques used by professional editorial teams to improve research, writing, and content quality.

Your work will be published in internationally recognized business and technology magazines read by executives, business leaders, and technology decision-makers worldwide.

What You'll Do
Write business and technology articles based on executive interviews for international magazines.
Conduct interviews with CEOs, founders, and senior executives of leading U.S. companies, with guidance and training from our editorial team.
Develop company profiles, executive features, business guides, research articles, and news stories.
Research industry trends, emerging technologies, and business developments across diverse sectors.
Analyze and enhance content using AI-powered research and writing tools.
Support editorial production for both print and digital publications.
Collaborate with editors to ensure adherence to editorial standards, style guidelines, and journalistic best practices.
Skills We Are Looking For
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong grammar, vocabulary, and attention to detail.
Good research and analytical skills.
Ability to organize information into clear, engaging content.
Curious about business, technology, AI, startups, and innovation.
Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
Familiarity with ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, or other AI tools is a plus but not required.
Basic understanding of Microsoft Word, Google Docs, and online research.
Good time management and organizational skills.
Positive attitude and willingness to receive feedback.

Comprehensive training will be provided to familiarise you with our editorial standards, writing methodology, and AI-powered content workflows.

Career Growth
Career Growth As you grow, you'll develop expertise in:
Business Research • Executive Interviewing • Business Journalism • AI-assisted Publishing • Editorial Strategy • International Business Writing • Content Leadership

Career progression may include: • Senior Writer • Associate Editor • Managing Editor • Editorial Team Lead

Develop expertise in:
Business Research
Editorial Strategy
AI-assisted Publishing
Executive Communications
Interviewing

Why Fresh Graduates Choose This Role
Build a professional writing portfolio from day one.
Learn directly from experienced editors.
Gain expertise across multiple global industries.
Receive hands-on training in AI-powered publishing.
Conduct executive interviews with business leaders.
Work on internationally published magazines.
Develop skills valued in journalism, content strategy, corporate communications, marketing, and research.

Remote-Friendly Hiring
If you are currently based outside Bangalore and are willing to relocate upon receiving an offer, the recruitment process can be conducted remotely. Remote hiring is applicable only for the night-shift position.

Perks & Benefits

Learn from the Best
Join a 100+ member editorial team and learn from some of the most experienced professionals in business publishing. Many of our senior editors bring more than a decade of expertise in translating complex business concepts into compelling stories for executive audiences.

Healthy Work Environment
We are committed to creating a growth-oriented workplace where employees can learn, contribute, and thrive. Optional health insurance coverage is available for employees and their dependents.
If you're curious, enjoy learning, and want to build a career in content writing, journalism, business research, or AI-powered publishing, we'd love to hear from you. Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
Send your CV along with a brief note explaining why you want to build a career in business and technology writing.

Key Responsibilities & NABH Compliance Duties1. Pre-Anesthesia Evaluation (PAE) & Planning:
Patient Assessment: Conduct and document a thorough pre-anaesthesia evaluation of the patient's medical history, physical examination, airway status, and relevant lab/radiology investigations prior to any procedure.
Risk Stratification: Evaluate ASA (American Society of Anesthesiologists) physical status grading and formulate a customized anesthesia plan (general, regional, spinal, epidural, or monitored anesthesia care).
Informed Consent: Obtain a separate, dedicated bilingual/informed consent for anesthesia (distinct from the surgical consent), clearly explaining the technique, associated risks, benefits, and alternatives to the patient or legal guardian.
Starvation & Medication Protocols: Verify adherence to pre-operative fasting/starvation guidelines and manage pre-medication orders.
2. Intra-Operative Management & Monitoring
Anesthesia Delivery: Safely induce, maintain, and reverse general, regional, or local anesthesia/sedation.
Continuous Monitoring: Maintain continuous, documented intra-operative monitoring of vital parameters as per NABH minimum standardsincluding heart rate, ECG rhythm, non-invasive/invasive blood pressure, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation (SpO), body temperature, and End-Tidal CO (EtCO).
Hemodynamic & Organ Support: Manage fluid balance, blood/blood-product transfusions, ventilation, and intra-operative medical emergencies.
Presence: Ensure the qualified anesthesiologist remains physically present and attentive throughout the course of the anesthesia.
3. Post-Anesthesia Care Unit (PACU) & Recovery
Handover & Recovery Tracking: Supervise the safe transfer of the patient to the recovery room or Intensive Care Unit (ICU) with verbal and written handovers.
Discharge Criteria: Evaluate and document recovery status using objective scoring systems (e.g., Aldrete Score) before authorizing discharge from the PACU back to the ward or step-down unit.
Post-Operative Pain Management: Implement acute pain management protocols (e.g., patient-controlled analgesia, epidural infusions, or multi-modal analgesia regimens).
4. Critical Care, Trauma & Non-OR Anesthesia (NORA)
Provide airway management, resuscitation, and critical care support in emergency departments, labor/delivery suites (obstetric analgesia), cath labs, radiology suites, and the ICU.
Participate actively in hospital code blue (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) teams and disaster/trauma response protocols.
5. Quality Assurance, Infection Control & NABH Documentation
Mandatory Documentation: Ensure real-time, signed, and dated entries in the medical record for pre-anesthesia notes, intra-operative chart logs, drug dosages, and post-anaesthesia evaluations.
Adverse Event Reporting: Immediately record, report, analyze, and review any intra-operative or post-operative adverse anesthesia events, near-misses, or complications through the hospitals quality improvement framework.
Infection Control & Equipment Checks: Verify daily safety checks of anesthesia work-stations, crash carts, and defibrillators, adhering strictly to sterile and infection-control guidelines (e.g., circuit changes, proper CSSD sterilization).

Key Competencies & Skills Required
Clinical Mastery: Advanced airway management (intubation, LMA placement, difficult airway cart utilization).
Emergency Response: Proficiency in ACLS (Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support) and PALS (Pediatric Advanced Life Support).
Compliance Mindset: Strict adherence to hospital Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) required for NABH accreditation audits.
Communication: Clear, empathetic interaction with patients/families during consent and multi-disciplinary coordination with surgeons and nursing staff.

Qualification Requirement: MD / DNB / DA in Anesthesiology with valid State Medical Council registration and hospital credentialing/privileging per NABH guidelines.

Description:
Executive Indirect Taxation (Bhiwadi & Bangalore location)

The Executive Indirect Taxation will support the tax function by ensuring accurate GST compliance, audit readiness, strategic liaison and effective stakeholder communication within a dynamic environment. This role focuses on the timely filing of returns, accurate reconciliation of tax ledgers, data analysis, process Improvement and supporting the teams during statutory audits and assessments.

Key Responsibilities
Prepare, review, and file periodic GST returns ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Conduct GST audit activities, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
Interpret and apply GST rules, acts, and notifications to business transactions.
Timely coordinate with internal stakeholders and external tax authorities for dispute resolution and clarifications.
Generate management information system (MIS) reports to aid decisionmaking and highlight compliance risks.
Communicate tax implications and solutions to crossfunctional teams, facilitating problem identification and resolution.

Required Skills & Experience
58 years of handson experience in indirect taxation, predominantly GST, within the manufacturing sector who has handle huge volumes of data.
Proven ability to file GST returns and perform GST audits with minimal supervision.
Strong knowledge of GST Acts, rules, and recent amendments.
Excellent liaisoning and networking skills to interact with tax authorities, auditors, and internal departments.
Proficient in tax compliance software and advanced Excel, Power Point for MIS reporting.
Effective written and verbal communication, have ability to understand and act quickly, hard-working, proactive.

Preferred Qualifications
Professional certification such as B.Com, CMA (Inter) or CA (Inter),
Experience using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) for tax data extraction.

About the role
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead the development of a world-class franchise model. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales funnel, onboarding new franchisees, and ensuring both the growth and retention of franchise stores. In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Strategic Acquisition Planning: Design and execute a comprehensive franchise acquisition strategy aligned with organizational growth targets.
• Pipeline Leadership: Oversee and optimize the full acquisition funnel, ensuring consistent inflow of high-quality prospects and timely conversions.
• Market Penetration: Identify high-potential markets and expansion zones, developing region-specific growth plans.
• Channel Diversification: Leverage digital, on-ground, partnerships, and referral ecosystems to expand franchise reach and strengthen lead quality.

Franchise Onboarding & Set-Up
• End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead the onboarding and operational go-live of new franchise stores, ensuring all SOPs, processes, and compliance standards are met.
• Scale Management: Ensure successful onboarding of 50+ franchise stores per month, maintaining quality and standardization at scale.
• Capability Building: Establish robust training, enablement, and support frameworks to set new franchise partners up for long-term success.

Franchise Performance, Retention & Revenue Growth
• Portfolio Management: Oversee performance of the entire franchise portfolio, using data-driven insights to enhance store productivity and profitability.
• Retention & Engagement: Develop franchise retention programs, strengthen partner relationships, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Description:
Job Title: Japanese Team Lead (TL)
Department: Operations
Location: Jaipur
Employment Type: Full-time
Job Overview
We are seeking an experienced and fluent Japanese Team Lead to oversee daily operations, manage project deliverables, and guide a team of bilingual/multilingual professionals. In thisrole, you will act as the key liaison between Japanese clients/stakeholders and internal teams,
ensuring seamless communication, high-quality deliverables, and high operational performance.
Key Responsibilities
Team Management & Leadership
Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of Japanese-speaking customer service representatives, content moderators, or specialists.
Conduct regular 1-on-1 feedback sessions, performance reviews, and team coaching.
Manage team schedules, attendance, workload distribution, and overall productivity.
Client & Stakeholder Communication
Serve as the primary point of contact for Japanese clients, partners, or regional stakeholders.
Facilitate regular status meetings, deliver performance reports, and handle escalations professionally in Japanese (written and verbal).
Ensure accurate interpretation and translation of business requirements, guidelines, and project specs.
Quality & Operational Excellence
Monitor team outputs, SLAs, and KPIs (e.g., CSAT, response time, quality accuracy) to meet or exceed targets.
Conduct quality audits, root-cause analyses, and implement corrective action plans when needed.
Continuously optimize team processes, training materials, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Qualifications & Requirements
Language Proficiency: Native or near-native fluency in Japanese (JLPT N2 or equivalent required) and high proficiency in English (both written and spoken).
Experience: 2+ years of experience Team Lead role within BPO, customer support, IT, or localized operations.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace, CRM systems Zendesk), and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana).
Soft Skills: Excellent conflict resolution, decision-making, and organizational abilities.
AboutCompany: Welcome to Transcom! We specialize in managing customer experience support and contact center services for Indian and Global companies across various industries. Our goal is to deliver value-driven business process outsourcing solutions that minimize friction points for end customers, giving our clients a sustainable competitive advantage. With our expertise, we offer customer care and call center managed services in 60+ languages, spanning voice, email, chat, and social media channels. At our core, we cherish our people, fostering an engaging workplace that sparks inspiration and brings out their best. Join us in creating exceptional customer experiences through our BPO solutions!"

Job Purpose
This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd. Duties and Responsibilities
General Admin (Facility Management RM)
1. Control branch OPEX expenses within set budget.

4.the shops establishments application is applied the certificate is received well within the TAT. (within 10 days of branch completion)
5.security related equipments are up to date under AMC renewals are done prior to expiry of contract.
6. Renewals of all Lease agreements AMC contract done prior to the expiry date.
7. Ensuring all statutory documents / certificates are displayed at the common area (reception) in line to compliance.
1. Graduate in any discipline with experience of working in Administration preferred
2. Inclination to have knowledge/ exposure on legal/ compliance matters.
3. Exposure in handling govt. / legal Issues
4. Team management interpersonal Skills
5. Good on negotiations and Vendor development Management
6. Well versed with MS Word, Excel, Power Point
7. Willing to Travel

Description:
Position: PLM Support Engineer
Experience: 3 to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad (or as applicable)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.
Required Technical Skills
PLM Technologies
Strong experience in at least one or more PLM applications:
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam
Functional Knowledge
Engineering Change Management (ECR/ECO/ECN)
Product Structure Management
BOM Management
Workflow Management
Release Management
Document Management
CAD Integration
Siemens NX
CATIA
CAD Data Management
Technical Skills
SQL Queries and Database Fundamentals
PLM Data Model Understanding
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Dispatcher Monitoring
PDF Generation Processes
Job Server and Vault Management
Application Log Analysis
Support Tools
ServiceNow / Jira / Remedy
Incident & Change Management Tools
Monitoring and Reporting Tools
Desired Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3 to 8 years of experience in PLM application support.
Experience in global production support environments.
Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
ITIL certification is preferred.
Required Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work with global and cross-functional teams.
Customer-focused approach with strong ownership mindset.
Ability to work in rotational shifts and provide production support when required.
Strong documentation and reporting skills.
Preferred Skills
Teamcenter BMIDE knowledge.
Teamcenter Active Workspace exposure.
Aras administration/support experience.
Understanding of manufacturing and engineering business processes.
Exposure to deployment and release management activities.
Experience in performance tuning and application monitoring.

Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines

Description:
Role / Job Title- Manager - Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant
Experience - 8 - 14 years

Key Skills -Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, US Payroll, Payroll Configuration, Elements, Calculation Cards, Balances, Fast Formulas, Payroll Flows, Retro Processing and Costing
Location - Bangalore/Hyderabad/ Pune /Gurugram

Role & responsibilities

8 - 14 years of experience in Oracle HCM applications, with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll.
Must have worked on at least two end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, with strong Oracle US Payroll experience; Canada Payroll experience is a plus.
In-depth hands-on configuration across Legislative Data Groups, payroll definitions and calendars, Payroll Statutory Units / Tax Reporting Units, elements, input values, element eligibility, calculation cards, balances, payment methods and payroll costing.
Strong knowledge of QuickPay, payroll flows, retroactive processing, proration, balance adjustments, costing and payment processing.
Hands-on expertise in Payroll Fast Formulas and troubleshooting complex payroll calculation and configuration issues.
Strong understanding of US payroll processing, including federal, state and local taxation, quarter-end / year-end activities and legislative updates.
Experience with HDL / payroll data conversion, payroll extracts and reporting, with the ability to collaborate with technical teams on integrations and extensions.
Ability to perform fit-gap analysis, translate business requirements into scalable configuration, and lead unit testing, UAT / regression testing, quarterly release readiness and production issue resolution.
Strong client-facing communication and delivery leadership, including risk / escalation management, team guidance and working knowledge of Core HR and related HCM touchpoints.
As a Manager, you will serve as the functional lead and client-facing subject matter expert for Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, combining deep payroll configuration expertise with delivery leadership across implementation, enhancement and production support engagements.
Lead the Oracle HCM Payroll functional workstream across solution design, configuration, testing, cutover, hypercare and ongoing support.
Lead client requirement and design discussions, translate payroll policies into Oracle configuration, and provide clear recommendations on solution options and impacts.
Own complex payroll functional issues from analysis through resolution, driving root-cause analysis and sustainable fixes.
Review payroll configurations, functional designs and deliverables for quality, accuracy, controls and adherence to agreed standards.
Manage incidents, service requests, changes and problem records in line with SLAs / KPIs, including prioritization, risks, escalations and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate with Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Time and Labor, Integrations, Reporting and Finance teams, and lead quarterly release impact assessment and regression testing.
Mentor functional consultants, provide configuration oversight, build team capability and drive continuous improvement while maintaining strong client relationships.

Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.

Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.

Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Description:
Position- Territory Manager
Location- Bangalore & Hyderabad

Role Summary
The Territory Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth within the assigned territory by developing relationships with doctors and clients, generating prescriptions, achieving monthly sales targets, supporting branch growth initiatives, and ensuring timely collections.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Sales
Achieve monthly sales and revenue targets for the assigned territory.
Generate business through regular engagement with doctors and healthcare professionals.
Develop and maintain relationships with clients and referral partners.
Identify and develop new infrastructure and business opportunities within the territory.
Execute market development and brand-building initiatives.
Doctor & Client Engagement
Conduct approximately 8-10 doctor visits daily.
Conduct approximately 4 client visits daily.
Generate prescriptions and referrals through continuous relationship management.
Maintain strong customer engagement to improve business volumes.
Collection & Territory Management
Monitor collections and outstanding payments.
Ensure timely recovery of dues from clients.
Maintain market intelligence and competitive awareness.
Provide support to existing branches through local marketing activities.
Marketing Activities
Plan and execute BTL (Below-The-Line) marketing activities.
Organize 4-5 BTL camps every month to generate leads and business opportunities.
Support promotional campaigns and local brand visibility initiatives.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of monthly revenue targets.
8-10 doctor visits per day.
4 client visits per day.
New business development within the territory.
Successful execution of 4-5 BTL camps per month.
Collection efficiency and reduction of outstanding payments.
Candidate Profile
Education
Graduate in Science, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or related discipline.
MBA preferred.
Experience
0-2 years of experience in sales, healthcare, diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or related industries.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
Sales and negotiation capabilities.
Market awareness and territory management skills.
Target-oriented and self-motivated approach.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple stakeholders.
Good problem-solving and customer management skills.
Mandatory Requirements
Two-wheeler with valid driving license.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

JOB OVERVIEW


We are seeking an experienced Billing Platform Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the entire Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in both Billing and Revenue capabilities, with extensive experience in subscription billing, usage-based billing, pricing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will drive business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, engage with executive stakeholders, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs.
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, architecture, business process design, functional and technical design, application configuration, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts, testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, and stakeholder communication while driving successful project milestones.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a key role in practice development by contributing to solution accelerators, AI-enabled delivery, capability building, pre-sales, client workshops, and thought leadership initiatives. The individual will work closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, improve business outcomes, and support enterprise growth.


Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the solution architecture and design for enterprise Quote-to-Cash transformations across Billing and Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations. Lead end-to-end Billing Platform solution architecture for large-scale implementation programs.
Manage end-to-end implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution design, configuration, development, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, and hypercare while leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmap.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate workshops, perform fit-gap analysis, develop scalable solution designs, and provide strategic recommendations aligned with industry best practices. Excellent client-facing skills and communication (written/verbal) skills
Establish delivery governance, manage project risks and dependencies, review solution quality, ensure compliance with architectural standards, and drive successful milestone execution through proactive stakeholder communication and issue resolution.
Contribute to practice development through pre-sales, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, capability building, mentoring, solution assets, thought leadership, and the development of reusable frameworks that enhance delivery efficiency and support business growth.
Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes.
Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses
Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation.
Understand customer business processes/functional specifications and independently drive technical solutioning to delivery
Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution
Must ensure teams follow the correct procedures, best practices and documentation requirements across project phases
Drive solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Technical Skills:
API, SQL, CSS, HTML, Java Script, JSON and XML
Certifications:
BillingPlatform Partner Essential Certification (L1)
BillingPlatform Partner Pro Certification (L2)
BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)

You will also contribute to practice development through thought leadership initiatives and capability building.

- Overseeing the development of integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle ERP

- Facilitating workshops and performing fit-gap analysis to develop scalable solution designs
- Contributing to practice development through pre-sales, capability building, and thought leadership initiatives

- Leading business discussions with customers to discover requirements and deliver technical solutions
- Confirming compliance with architectural standards and driving successful milestone execution through proactive communication

Description:
Job DescriptionPosition Requirements:


Job Overview
In this role, you will work with PwC and client team members to design and deliver efficient Financial Close, Consolidation and/or FP&A processes. You will lead key aspects of OneStream implementations, including planning, solution design, configuration, build, testing, training, change management, go-live and post-go-live support. This position may require you to work directly with clients from an offshore location and at client sites.


Responsibilities Include
Knowledge Preferred: The candidate is expected to have strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
•  Strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
•  Strong understanding of OneStream application design, metadata, workflows, security, business rules, reporting and integrations.
•  Experience implementing planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial close, consolidation and management reporting solutions.
•  Good knowledge of Multi-GAAP, multi-entity and multi-currency applications.
•  For consolidation-focused candidates, good understanding of intercompany eliminations, consolidation adjustments, ownership accounting, currency translation and group reporting.
•  For FP&A-focused candidates, good understanding of integrated planning, driver-based forecasting, allocations, scenario modelling and management reporting.
•  Experience developing Cube Views, dashboards, reports and Excel Add-In solutions, and using/configuring relevant OneStream Marketplace Solutions.
•  Good understanding of data integration, data validation, reconciliation and financial reporting processes.
•  Ability to lead requirement-gathering and solution-design activities, support testing and deployment, establish best practices, guide team members and client stakeholders, and build prototypes or proof-of-concept applications.


Job Requirements
The candidate should be able to demonstrate abilities and proven success in end-to-end implementation of OneStream CPM/EPM projects:
•  8+ years of overall experience in CPM/EPM, finance transformation, financial systems or related consulting roles.
•  Minimum 6 years of hands-on OneStream experience, with at least two end-to-end implementation projects.
•  Strong functional expertise in FP&A or Financial Close and Consolidation; experience across at least one or both areas is preferred.
•  Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and sustainable OneStream solutions.
•  Experience designing and configuring metadata, workflows, security, business rules, integrations, reports and dashboards, including relevant OneStream Marketplace Solutions.
•  Ability to identify process-improvement opportunities and recommend standardized, automated and scalable solutions.
•  Experience managing system integration testing, user acceptance testing, data validation, cutover, deployment and hypercare activities.
•  Ability to manage multiple workstreams and coordinate activities across business, functional, technical and integration teams.
•  Experience managing project deliverables, timelines, dependencies, risks, issues and stakeholder communication.
•  Ability to lead teams involving multiple territories in Onshore-Offshore Model
•  Demonstrated people-management skills, including leading and mentoring team members, allocating work effectively, providing regular coaching and performance feedback, and fostering a collaborative and inclusive team environment.
•  Ability to review solution designs and project deliverables for quality, consistency and alignment with OneStream best practices.
•  Ability to guide business users during planning, forecasting, month-end, quarter-end or year-end reporting cycles, based on the candidate's area of expertise.
•  Experience leading and mentoring project team members, with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation and documentation skills.
•  OneStream certification and prior consulting experience are preferred.

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Your role will involve identifying opportunities, embracing technology, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. - Overseeing the development of Cube Views, dashboards, reports, and Excel Add-In solutions
- Implementing process improvements and recommending automated solutions to enhance financial operations
- Managing system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and data validation activities

- Providing mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment
- Reviewing solution designs and project deliverables for quality and alignment with OneStream standards

Craft and convey clear, impactful and engaging messages that tell a holistic story.

Job Summary
Position Senior
EY's GDS Tax Technology teams mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY's core Tax practice, you'll develop a deep tax technical knowledge and outstanding ERP, database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require tax departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
EY's GDS Tax Technology team members work side-by-side with the firm's partners, clients and tax technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Tax.
GDS Tax Technology works closely with clients and professionals in the following areas: Federal Business Tax Services, Partnership Compliance, Corporate Compliance, Indirect Tax Services, Human Capital, and Internal Tax Services. GDS Tax Technology provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global TAX service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking a Tax Senior to join our Tax Technology practice in Bangalore, India.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the solution design and development of Tax tools and technology solutions.
Be subject matter expert to program/project teams in the plan, design, and delivery of technical solutions.
Ability to effectively communicate with other senior leaders of IT on program strategies and plans and negotiate quality solutions.
Qualifications & Experience Required
Bachelors / Masters degree in Software Engineering / Information Technology / MBA / MCA / CA/ CWA.
Relavent 2-8 years of experience in SAP S/4 Hana Project Implementation with SAP FI / DRC. Overall experience not more than 10 years.
SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (previously known as Advance Compliance Reporting)
Minimum 1 End to End Implementation in SAP DRC.
Methodology, Integration & Migration experience in SAP overall.
Sound knowledge in Taxation Direct and Indirect Tax.
Tax integration is an added advantage.
SAP E-invoicing executions and Country specific reporting.
Sound knowledge in Manage Document and Reporting Compliance process.
Knowledge of Scrum and working experience will be an advantage.
Roles & Responsibilities of day-to-day activities of an SAP DRC Consultant:
Expertise in Basic configuration of SAP S/4 HANA in FI
General Ledger Accounting, Taxation.
Invoice creation via electronic documentation.
Knowledge in Electronic invoice Documentation, Data Preparation and Submission.
Reconciliation & Statutory Reporting of E-Invoicing.
Annual & Periodic Reporting of E-Document for various Statutory Reporting.
Correction processing of statutory reporting.
Knowledge on Intrastat Reporting, Withholding Tax & EC Sales list.
Sound Knowledge of Workflow.
Sound knowledge of DRC on Cloud and integration.

Collaborate with PAM, AD, Network, Distributed, GAD, and Product teams to support audits, change management, maintenance activities, upgrades, patching, disaster recovery testing, and operational excellence.

Strong knowledge of CyberArk APIs (PSPAS), PowerShell scripting, automation workflows, certificate management, and account lifecycle management.
Experience in troubleshooting CyberArk infrastructure issues, monitoring platform health, reviewing logs, managing services, and ensuring high availability.
Good understanding of Windows, Linux, Networking, SSH Key integration, cloud platforms (AWS), and enterprise security best practices.
Experience supporting audit, compliance, change management, DR/BCP testing, documentation creation, SOP development, and stakeholder engagement across multiple teams.

Manage onboarding, offboarding, registration, and deregistration of privileged accounts within CyberArk.
Troubleshoot CyberArk platform issues involving CPM, PSM, PVWA, CCP, integrations, certificates, and authentication mechanisms.
Perform health monitoring using monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, review logs, monitor services, and ensure platform stability.
Support change management activities including maintenance, patching, upgrades, testing, implementation, and rollback planning.
Create and maintain operational documentation, SOPs, testing evidence, audit artifacts, knowledge articles, and support resources.

Job Description: Assistant Manager MIS & Business Analytics (Finance)

Role Objective:
We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented professional to lead MIS reporting, financial data analysis, dashboard development, and business performance tracking. The primary responsibility will be to transform raw financial and operational data into meaningful insights that enable management to make informed business decisions.

Key Responsibilities:
1. MIS Reporting & Management Dashboards
Develop, manage, and enhance daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management.
Design interactive dashboards to track business performance, profitability, revenue, expenses, and other key performance indicators.
Consolidate data from multiple sources and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting.
Develop customised reports and dashboards based on management requirements.
Automate repetitive reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

2. Business Insights & Data Analytics
Analyse large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, patterns, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Develop new reports, analytical models, and performance metrics to provide deeper visibility into business performance.
Identify the reasons behind revenue fluctuations, cost increases, margin changes, and deviations from targets.

3. MIS Automation & Process Improvement
Build advanced Excel-based reports and dashboards using Pivot Tables, Power Query, advanced formulas, and data models.
Develop Power BI dashboards and automated reporting solutions wherever applicable.
Improve data collection, validation, reporting formats, and analytical processes.
Establish standardised KPI definitions and reporting practices across departments.
Ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and reliability of management information.

The Client Manager is responsible to understand the business and most important be a bearer of relationship with Enterprise Customer, with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for the assigned Enterprise Customers. Single & Most important bearer of Relationship with Enterprise Customer with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for all assigned Enterprise Customers.

Experience in managing global and a track record of global accounts/ enterprise solution selling
Experience in complex change management and operating in a matrix, fast moving and technical environment.
Experience in working in multi-cultural environment ability to manage an international and distributed team.
Team player, strong influence and relationship management skills, customer centric.
Strong communication and decision making skills– ability to balance conflicting interests and ability to lead in a high-growth, high-uncertainty environments

To learn new products and services so as to be updated with the Customer needs and market trends
Apply the learning in own Customer scenario
Must have technical/ professional qualifications
Experience handling Strategic Accounts and C-level engagement

5+ years of experience
Should have preferably worked with Telecom, Technology Companies

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Lead SAP PM functional consulting activities across requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
Conduct workshops with business stakeholders to understand maintenance processes, asset management requirements, and operational challenges.
Configure and implement SAP Plant Maintenance functionalities including Technical Objects, Functional Locations, Equipment Masters, Work Centers, Maintenance Notifications, Maintenance Orders, Task Lists, Maintenance Plans, and Measuring Points/Counters.
Design and optimize preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance processes aligned with business objectives.
Analyze business requirements and prepare functional specifications for custom developments, reports, forms, enhancements, interfaces, and workflows.
Perform fit-gap analysis and recommend SAP best practices to improve maintenance efficiency and asset reliability.
Work closely with ABAP, Basis, Data Migration, and Integration teams to implement business requirements.
Configure and support calibration management, refurbishment processes, warranty tracking, and maintenance costing processes.
Manage SAP PM integration with MM, QM, PP, SD, PS, and FICO modules to support end-to-end business processes.
Support inventory and spare parts management through PM-MM integration.
Define authorization requirements and assist in security role testing related to maintenance functions.
Participate in data migration activities involving equipment masters, functional locations, maintenance plans, task lists, and historical maintenance data.
Develop and execute unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and regression testing scenarios.
Prepare configuration documents, functional design documents (FDD), business process documents (BPD), test scripts, and end-user training materials.
Support cutover planning, go-live activities, hypercare support, and production stabilization.
Analyze and resolve production issues, ensuring adherence to SLAs and business continuity requirements.
Collaborate with business users to drive continuous process improvements and system optimization initiatives.
Provide guidance on SAP S/4HANA PM functionalities and Fiori applications related to maintenance operations.
Support implementation of asset management strategies focused on equipment reliability, maintenance compliance, and cost optimization.
Participate in project estimation, effort planning, risk assessment, and change request management.
Mentor junior consultants and provide functional expertise during project execution.
Work directly with client leadership, plant maintenance teams, operations teams, and external stakeholders in a customer-facing consulting role.
Ensure solutions comply with industry standards and maintenance best practices across Manufacturing, Automotive, Pharma, Chemicals, Utilities, Oil & Gas, and Engineering sectors.
Must have hands-on experience in at least one complete end-to-end SAP PM implementation lifecycle covering Blueprint, Realization, Testing, Go-Live, and Hypercare phases.

Preferred candidate profile

Minimum 6+ years of strong SAP PM functional consulting experience.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
Completed at least one full-cycle end-to-end SAP PM implementation project with active involvement across all project phases.
Strong hands-on expertise in SAP PM configuration and business process design.
Experience working on SAP S/4HANA PM implementations, migrations, or transformation projects.
Good understanding of Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and maintenance management best practices.
Proven experience in maintenance planning, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, shutdown management, and asset lifecycle management.
Strong integration knowledge with SAP MM, QM, PP, PS, and FICO modules.
Experience in preparing functional specifications and coordinating with technical teams for developments and enhancements.
Exposure to Fiori applications and SAP S/4HANA innovations in Plant Maintenance.
Ability to independently interact with business stakeholders and translate business requirements into SAP solutions.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in client-facing consulting environments and global delivery models.
SAP PM or SAP S/4HANA Asset Management certification will be an added advantage.
Prior experience in Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical, Automotive, Utilities, Chemicals, EPC, or Oil & Gas industries preferred.
Ability to work from Mumbai, Pune, or Bangalore and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Candidates with implementation plus support/rollout experience will be highly preferred.
Immediate joiners or candidates with short notice periods are preferred.

Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.

Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting

Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications

Functional Expertise

Accounts Payable (AP)

Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting

Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.
