0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

Description:
Responsibilities
OE shall be owner of his / her service area in terms of all operations related actions and shall Execute daily service operations with a team of assigned Technicians within a given service areas
Ensure quality of service delivery by effective supervision on technicians - on the job as per company SOPs
Ensure technicians carry out treatment within a given Time on Site (ToS) in a competent manner. (OE to engage technician via route riding, training on the job).
Plan execute 02 TPAs (Technicians Performance Assessment) per assigned technician with 2 development programs per year. Coach train assigned technicians in order to improve the service quality
Convey special instructions, if any, to technicians to execute the job as per Service Docket (liaison with Sales colleagues)
Carry out pest management audits of customer sites as per agreed schedule by i or R auditor.
Complete close customer audit non-conformities (external / internal). Follow up implement CAPA at customer site
On Site Documentation: Implementation of SOP, Compliance and closure of audits non-conformities (Internal / External). Send service dockets of completed services to NKA for invoicing on time.
Handle assigned customer complaints in his / her service areas, within 24 hours resolve complaint at earliest, as per the customers convenience and update the Root Cause in iCABS to ensure proper ticket closure
Identify resolve service delivery issues in coordination with the Branch Manager
Conduct daily 10 min stand up meeting monthly operations meeting
Be conversant with STP (Service Track Pest) and monitor, analyze visit extraction notes for all high infestation related service visits on a daily basis; take action.
Digital Initiative: Be conversant with all in house systems.
Maintain Material consumption, Overtime Hrs. schedule at an agreed targeted level for the assigned service area and for technician
Approval of conveyance amount for assigned technicians
Monitor report to ABM/BM on input costs at all major sites as per gross margin agreed discuss action plans to bring it within limits
Actively drive Service Product Leads for assigned technician group within service area by implementing STA (See, Tell, Ask) and T.I.M.E. (Train, Incentivise, Monitor, Engage) on the job coaching to create density of customers.
Innovation: conduct trials and report findings as per the guidelines, implement new service lines as per the SOPs.
Minimum 18 customer visits per week for Resi SA (Residential Small Accounts segment heavy branch), includes, Customer complaints. For Specific Site based OEs -Number shall not be applicable but Retention of customer/s at site would be main KPI with all scheduled services completed efficiently and effectively.
Inventory: Help ABM/BM to manage Inventory - coordinate with other Ops colleagues
to manage Stock Levels of branches forecasting, Indenting receipt of material for branch (as an assigned function within branch by BM).
Ensure APL (Approved Preparations List) is followed by all assigned technicians all chemical containers have original labels
Ensure proper schedule of maintenance repairs of equipment is established followed (via JOC).
Promote highest grooming standards (uniform, Safety shoes, PPEs)
Encourage technicians to plan their leaves in advance to curb absenteeism
Help Resolve any Grievances IR issues of Technicians bring to the notice of ABM/BM on day today basis
Report any deviation that could impact service quality or productivity of technicians like- over commitments, recommendation regarding night service (if it is not needed), covered area mismatch, etc


Requirements
Minimum B. Sc. (Chemistry / Zoology / Agriculture). Any prior experience in operations of pest management or service industry is desirable.
Proficient in use of computer applications systems with Excel, Word, PowerPoint (or its equivalent)
Should get well versed with various internal company systems such as iCABS, STP, iAuditor, SRA, SQA, SQS, TPA, myRentokilPCI, Service Leads App, U+ etc

Description:
Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Job Summary
Agilent is looking for passionate and motivated young scientists to join our team as Field Application Engineers (FAE) supporting our LCMS (Liquid Chromatography Mass Spectrometry) and GCMS (Gas Chromatography Mass Spectrometry) business. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work closely with leading pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, food, environmental, and research laboratories across India. As a Field Application Engineer, you will serve as a technical expert, helping customers develop analytical workflows, optimize methods, and maximize the value of Agilent's advanced analytical instrumentation. You will collaborate with sales, product specialists, application scientists, and customers to drive technology adoption and business growth.


Responsibilities
Develop and optimize LCMS and GCMS analytical methods and workflows for applications including pharmaceuticals, pesticides, antibiotics, food safety, and other emerging markets
Design and execute experiments to support development of new applications and workflow solutions.
Generate scientific data and contribute to application notes, technical publications, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Collaborate with leading researchers, industry experts, and key opinion leaders to drive innovative analytical solutions
Deliver customer demonstrations, technical seminars, and product trainings.
Support customer onboarding, workflow implementation, and application troubleshooting.
Participate in scientific conferences, workshops, and industry events to showcase Agilent technologies.
Work closely with commercial and technical teams to support strategic business growth in LCMS and GCMS.


Qualifications
M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
Strong academic understanding of chromatography and mass spectrometry techniques.
Hands-on laboratory experience through coursework, research projects, internships, or thesis work is preferred.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and scientific communication skills.
Passion for customer engagement and scientific consulting.


Desired Skills
Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact confidently with customers and internal stakeholders.
Curiosity to learn new technologies and applications.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a dynamic environment.
Willingness to travel extensively (up to 75%) across assigned territories.

Description:
Department: HCD (Projects & Services Division)

Tasks :
1.Facility Development & Project Execution: Review designs, specifications, BOQs and P&IDs; supervise mechanical installation, testing and commissioning; coordinate with EPC contractors, consultants and vendors; monitor progress, quality, cost and timelines.

2.HVAC & Cleanroom Engineering: Review and execute HVAC for classified areas, covering HEPA filtration, air changes, pressure cascades and environmental control; coordinate testing, commissioning and qualification.

3.Process Utilities: Supervise installation, commissioning and maintenance of chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, steam and pure steam, WFI, purified water, compressed air and gases, boilers, ETP, exhaust systems and cold storage.

4.Equipment Integration: Coordinate mechanical and utility requirements for bioreactors, fermenters, purification systems and filling lines; ensure hygienic design and maintainability; support qualification documentation.

5.Maintenance & Facility Operations: Develop preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance programmes; ensure utility availability; maintain equipment records and asset plans; implement AMC/CAMC; coordinate calibration and statutory compliance; support deviations, change control and CAPA.

6.GMP, Qualification & Compliance: Ensure compliance with WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control; support DQ, IQ, OQ and PQ; coordinate with QA, QC, Validation and Production; support inspections and audits.

7.Tendering & Contract Management: Prepare specifications, BOQs, DPRs, estimates and tender documents; evaluate bids and vendors; monitor contractor performance and handover of completed facilities.

Requirements
Maximum Age: 40 years as on 01.11.2026 for BE / B.Tech holders;
45 years as on 01.11.2026 for Diploma holders

Basic pay range: Rs. 30,000 - 50,000 per month
Gross Salary: Rs. 61,830.00 (Non-Metro) (approx.) at the minimum of the scale.
Annual CTC: 8.82 Lakhs (Non-Metro) (approx.) at the minimum of the scale.

Qualification:
Essential: BE / B.Tech in Mechanical.
OR
Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical).

Post Qualification Experience:
For Degree holders, minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in mechanical engineering for the planning, design, development, execution, installation, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of vaccine and biologicals manufacturing facilities, pharmaceutical or biotechnology facilities, similar institutes. Experience in cleanroom HVAC, GMP-compliant utilities and industrial process systems, and in project execution, installation, commissioning and facility maintenance. Knowledge of WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control requirements.

For Diploma holders, minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience in mechanical engineering for the planning, design, development, execution, installation, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of vaccine and biologicals manufacturing facilities, pharmaceutical or biotechnology facilities, similar institutes. Experience in cleanroom HVAC, GMP-compliant utilities and industrial process systems, and in project execution, installation, commissioning and facility maintenance. Knowledge of WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control requirements.

Essential Technical Competencies
Cleanroom HVAC and controlled environmental systems.
GMP-compliant process utilities.
WFI and Purified Water Systems.
Steam, Pure Steam and Compressed Air Systems.
Chillers, Boilers and Industrial Utility Systems.
Biological manufacturing equipment integration.
Equipment qualification and commissioning.
Preventive and predictive maintenance.
Technical tendering, procurement and project management.
AutoCAD, P&ID and engineering drawing interpretation.

Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and target-driven Assistant Manager – Key Accounts (Inside Sales) to lead a high-performing team of 15-20 associates and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and own end-to-end account management
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Customer Retention, and Account Management, with a proven track record of achieving challenging business and growth targets. You should have a strong understanding of the sales funnel and complete sales lifecycle, along with the ability to coach and develop large sales teams that become trusted advisors for our client partners.
Key Responsibilities
Lead, manage, and motivate a team of 15-20 Inside Sales/Key Account associates.
Own and deliver revenue, sales, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the team.
Develop and execute strategies to drive account growth, upselling, cross-selling, and customer retention - own the sales retention funnel to drive SoW gain and increase order frequency 
Drive performance across the entire sales lifecycle and identify opportunities to improve conversion at each stage.
Analyze sales metrics, team productivity, revenue performance, conversion ratios, retention, and other key KPIs. Identify performance gaps and implement structured sales training, coaching, and improvement plans.
Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles to improve individual and team performance.
Work closely with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to improve customer experience and business outcomes.
Build forecasting mechanisms and ensure accurate tracking of pipeline, revenue, and growth targets.
Establish a strong performance-oriented culture focused on customer retention, revenue growth, productivity, and conversion.
Have a pulse on the voice of the customer that could help build critical product/experience improvements to build client stickiness on the platform 
What We’re Looking For
3+ years of overall experience, with significant experience in Inside Sales / Account Management / Key Account Management / Customer Retention.
Prior experience managing a large sales team of 30+ members is highly preferred.
Proven experience of managing and delivering revenue and growth targets.
Strong understanding of the inside sales process, sales funnel, and end-to-end sales lifecycle.
Demonstrated experience in customer retention, account growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
Strong analytical and data-driven approach to sales and team management.
Excellent people-management, coaching, and communication skills.
Ability to work in a high-pressure, target-driven environment.
Strong understanding of sales metrics such as conversion rate, revenue per associate, productivity, pipeline, retention, churn, and achievement against target.
Strong stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities.

Description:
The position is accountable for proactively soliciting and handling sales opportunities.
Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery.
Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives.
Achieves personal sales goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings.
Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (eg, generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Summary
Designation - Product Sales Executive - Institutional Sales
Location: Mumbai, Guwahati, Kolkata, Lucknow Patna
Qualification: Graduate
Experience: Minimum 1 year in Medical Equipment Sales.


Responsibilities
Identify and develop new institutional customers and business opportunities.
Manage relationships with existing institutional clients and ensure repeat business.
Conduct regular customer visits and understand product requirements.
Generate leads through market visits, references, networking and other business-development activities.
Present and demonstrate products to institutional customers as required.
Prepare and submit quotations, proposals and commercial offers.
Coordinate with internal teams for pricing, product availability, dispatch and delivery.
Follow up on enquiries, quotations and orders to ensure timely conversion.
Negotiate with customers within approved company guidelines.
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
Maintain an updated database of institutional customers, prospects and sales activities.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer requirements.
Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments in coordination with the finance team.
Handle customer queries and coordinate for resolution of complaints.
Maintain regular sales reports, visit reports and pipeline updates.
Support the organization in developing new territories, accounts and product opportunities.


Key Accountabilities / KPIs
Achievement of assigned sales targets.
New institutional customer acquisition.
Revenue and product-wise sales growth.
Enquiry-to-order conversion.
Number and quality of customer visits.
Development of active sales pipeline.
Customer retention and repeat orders.
Timely payment/collection follow-up.
Gross margin as per company guidelines.
Accuracy and timely submission of sales reports.


Target Customer Segments
Corporates and large organizations
Educational institutions
Hospitals and healthcare institutions
Government/semi-government institutions
Hotels and hospitality organizations
Dealers/distributors and institutional buyers
NGOs and other bulk purchasers
Other B2B/institutional customers relevant to the companys product portfolio


Qualifications
Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Sales Marketing will be an added advantage.


Experience
1-3 years of experience in B2B, institutional sales, corporate sales or field sales.
Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude may also be considered.


Skills Required
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills.
Ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
Target-oriented and self-motivated approach.
Good presentation and convincing skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Office/Excel and CRM systems.
Willingness to travel extensively for customer meetings.
Ability to work independently.


Desired Competencies
Business development
Customer relationship management
Sales planning and execution
Negotiation skills
Market intelligence
Follow-up and closing skills
Problem-solving ability
Time management
Result orientation

Description:
Role & responsibilities:
Vendor Acquisition & Onboarding: Identify, evaluate, and onboard fleet vendors to support business expansion and operational efficiency.
Scaling & Network Expansion: Develop strategies to scale vendor partnerships across multiple regions, ensuring adequate fleet availability.
Community Engagement: Organize and lead community meetups in Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities to educate and encourage drivers to transition into fleet ownership.
Government Coordination: Work closely with government agencies and employment programs to source and hire blue-collar drivers efficiently.
Performance Management: Track vendor performance metrics (SLAs, compliance, cost efficiency) and implement improvement initiatives.
Process Optimization: Streamline vendor onboarding, contract management, and operational workflows to reduce inefficiencies.
Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure all fleet vendors adhere to regulatory requirements, safety standards, and company policies.
Stakeholder Coordination: Work closely with internal teams (Operations, Finance, Compliance) to align vendor strategies with business goals

Person Specifications- Skillsets/Education:
Functional Skills Operations Management, Data Analysis, Stakeholder Management
Experience - Relevant experience in Logistics/ Manufacturing industry.
Behavioral Skills - Good communication and people management, analytical skills, task prioritization and follow-up, Hustler, Go-Getter attitude
Exposure to work in /Ability to work well in a team environment. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders for business purposes/in order to gain credibility with senior management.

*Should be open for extensive travel.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high.
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner.
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Description:
1: Job Purpose Statement
The Customer Relationship Manager is responsible for managing customer relationships, driving business targets, and ensuring operational compliance at the branch level. This role focuses on achieving product-specific goals, maintaining audit standards, and delivering superior customer service while adhering to regulatory and process requirements.
2: Duties & Responsibilities
1. Drive ACH activation for customers as per defined targets.
2. Ensure desired audit ratings and timely ATR submission in the audit portal.
3. Maintain DWM discipline through daily reporting and adherence to operational standards.
4. Handle exceptions related to KFS upload and CSS creation within defined TAT.
5. Achieve fee-based business targets (MI, HI, AFC) and investment business targets (FD, MF).
6. Deliver loan business targets (PAPQ, Suvidha, Wheels Loan) as per annual plans.
7. Ensure timely PDD updation (RC, Invoice, Insurance) within SLA.
8. Improve QRC resolution within TAT to enhance customer satisfaction.
9. Ensure timely file movement/dispatch to RMC before the 20th of the next month.
10. Provide personalized service to customers and resolve queries promptly.
11. Support Branch Head in achieving overall branch business and compliance objectives.

Mahindra Finance is Indias leading financial services provider committed to the needs of underserved customers in rural and semi-urban markets. We are on a journey to transform lives and uplift communities through financial growth.

Description:
Programme Overview
India has the world's highest burden of tuberculosis (TB). The National TB Elimination Program (NTEP), led by the Central TB Division (CTD), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, aims to end TB, and expanding access to rapid molecular testing is central to that goal. WJCF has supported the CTD and state health departments on TB, across case detection, access to diagnostics, preventive therapy, private-sector engagement and technical support to governments.
India built a large network of RT-PCR laboratories during COVID-19, and much of it now sits underused. With ICMR having validated an open RT-PCR kit for TB, this network could substantially expand rapid molecular testing for TB. WJCF has supported the Central TB Division's operational feasibility assessment of open RT-PCR for TB, including at IGIMS Patna and Siwan District Hospital.
Before the feasibility assessment was conducted, sites collocated with open real time PCR and NAAT (currently used under the programme) were identified by the State and CTD. These facilities were individually assessed on site by a team of technical experts using a detailed structured checklist. The non-conformities were addressed; kits and consumables were procured; the lab personnel trained subsequently on laboratory practices by the microbiologist followed by demonstration and hands-on practice facilitated jointly by a microbiologist and the manufacturers technical representative.
Learnings from the feasibility assessment encourage scale up of Open Real Time PCR-based testing for TB.

About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving B2B customer acquisition for PTL vertical. As a sales professional, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
New Business Development: Identify and onboard new B2B clients manufacturers, traders, distributors, and retailers who have regular
PTL freight movement needs.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
1+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Job Description - Agency Manager

Position: Agency Recruitment Development Manager

Channel: Integrated Agency
Location: Patna

Role Overview:
To recruit, train, and develop a team of Insurance Advisors / Agents and generate business through them. The role involves both recruitment and field sales management to achieve monthly business targets.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Agent Recruitment
- Source and recruit new Insurance Advisors from the local market
- Conduct 2-3 recruitment interviews daily
- Assist candidates with IRDA examination, Licensing, and Code generation
- Recruit a minimum of 4-5 quality Advisors per month

2. Agent Activation & Development
- Ensure new Advisors issue their first policy within 30 days of joining
- Train Advisors on products, sales pitch, and objection handling
- Conduct joint calls and accompany Advisors for customer meetings
- Re-activate inactive Advisors

3. Business Generation
- Achieve monthly targets for Premium and Number of Policies (NOP) through the team
- Track daily Advisor activity - Calls, Meetings, and Follow-ups
- Participate in branch campaigns, contests, and drives

4. Agent Engagement & Retention
- Conduct weekly Advisor meetings, training, and motivation sessions
- Recognize and nominate top performers for R&R and contests
- Resolve Advisor queries related to commission, payouts, and processes

5. Compliance
- Ensure all business is done as per IRDA guidelines
- Verify Advisor KYC and documentation

Requirements:
- Strong interest in sales and people management
- No job gaps in last 2years
- Two-wheeler preferred for field work
- Local market knowledge will be an added advantage

Description:
Job Purpose Statement
Understand and deploy the organization strategies issued by Circle Head, DV, as per management directives
Responsible for meeting target collections and recoveries
Ensuring productivity on a continual mode
Ensuring recoveries with minimum delinquency
Ensuring portfolio quality in line with organizational objectives
Ensuring minimal conversions of Soft repayment to field collection
Ensuring maximum provisioning reversal
To monitor, measure and restrict forward flow of contracts
To ensure contract allocation completion within 7 days of 1st month of every Quarter
Ensuring timely repossession, efficient disposal mechanism, stockyard management
Providing inputs to Divisional Head on business, basis collection comforts on profiles, models, geographies.
To be abreast with competition practices
To visit all branches in the circle atleast once a month

2: Duties & Responsibilities ( List in the order of importance the duties & responsibilities of this job)
1. Strategy formulation and implementation:
To achieve goals set by organization in terms of collection efficiency, provision reversals, etc
To keep the team motivated at all times
To develop liaison with alternative channels Authorities, Influential Personalities, Prominent Lawyers etc. so as to be able to handle contingencies and facilitate efficacious functioning of the recovery department , in line with company’s rules and regulations
Maintain an effective review mechanism to monitor results
Educating executives on increasing collection effectiveness through field collection,repossessions,guarantors etc.
Ensuring and leveraging productivity of executives right from inception
2. Budget & Profitability:
To monitor , drive and review the field force towards achieving the budgeted recovery
Ensure effective recovery of debt and NPA management
Drive Profitability & Ensure Portfolio Quality Maintenance
Timely repossession to ensure minimal disposal losses, as per management norms
3. Product & Process related:
To understand reports and review team basis of reports and data
Identifying factors which can improve collection output
Identify non-performers and report to Divisional Head
Devise and develop process & procedures aimed at reducing cost of collections
Ensure audit compliance and rating parameters are met
4. HR & People management:
Provide guidance to teams to maintain an environment that encourages participation, teamwork
Provide training support and content for functional and behavioural training of vertical field executives and managers for their development and retention
Improving engagement of department
To co-ordinate with the Accounts, Legal, Operations, H.R. and all other Functions for inputs and related functional support
5. Customer related:
Addressing customer concerns, pertaining to collections

Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale 
Provide pre-sales support for new business deals and post-sales support for the new projects assigned
Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets
Act as a bridge between customer, sales organization and global technical teams
Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
Review technical scoping, estimation, fitment and feasibility studies, mapping customer expectations and solution design, prepared by Program Managers and Project Leader
Degradation evaluations related to pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping circuits, fired equipment, flares, above ground storage tanks, and/or pressure relief devices.
Monitoring and surveillance of integrity parameters to ensure reliable operations.
Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.
Overall integrity effectiveness and management which includes, criticality assessments, consequence/ complexity rating of fixed equipment, development of fit-for-purpose risk based strategies, setting optimum task intervals including considerations to local regulations/ statutory requirements, timely review of inspection findings, and ever-greening of strategies.
Regional oversight and stewardship of integrity work product metrics for quality, effectiveness, and efficiency in achieving business unit/ manufacturing site objectives.

Engineering degree (Mechanical/Materials or Chemical) 3 to 8 years of oil gas experience in related industry (refining/petrochemical/LNG/oil & gas)

- Risk Based Inspection methodologies 
- Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures 
- Inspection Optimization
- Piping Circutization/TML development 
- API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals 
- In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment 
- Knowledge of materials and standards 
- Knowledge of corrosion & welding
- Knowledge of NDTs
-Thickness inspection management and analysis
- Corrosion management and analysis
- Inspection plan development/ optimization.
- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) 
- Ability to lead teams 
- Excellent communication 
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations 
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities 
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site 
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy 
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Good verbal and written communication skills.

Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office applications.

Commerce background candidates.

Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide
Career Development Ocer (CDO)
1. About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive
and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self-
funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership
Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress.
Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious
professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C-
Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools,
including:
IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli,
IIM Visakhapatnam
IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee,
E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras
Technology Innovation Hub
Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business
Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership,
MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University
Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology
Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU,
Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth
Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN
Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University
Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) /
SSODL
Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG
in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman
School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive
Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals
around the world.

Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every
student and professional at all stages of their career.
2. Role Overview & Snapshot
The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.
Designation
Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist
Admissions & Executive Education Sales
Department
Target Audience
Working Days
Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers
Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O)
10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business
requirements)
Working Hours
Dress Code
Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals
Primary CRM Tool
LeadSquared
3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations
High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting
¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM
database to build a healthy sales pipeline.
¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport
with high-potential prospects.
Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis
¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career
aspirations.
¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or
certications from Jaros university partners.
¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum
highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes.
Page 2 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment
¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection
handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures.
¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion
rates.
¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue
metrics.
Operations & Data Management
¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment
stages in LeadSquared.
¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a
seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners.
¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor
oerings.
4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites
¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional
communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred.
¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation
capabilities.
¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort
working in target-driven environments.
¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to-
senior working professionals.
¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like
LeadSquared.
5. Career Growth Pathway
¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader,
Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements.
Page 3 of 5

Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.
Page 4 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!

Job Description Factory / Plant Manager:
Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced Factory / Plant Manager to lead the overall operations of our manufacturing plant. The role will be responsible for ensuring efficient production, quality, safety, regulatory compliance, cost control, and effective people management.
The incumbent will work closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Supply Chain, HR and other functions to ensure smooth and efficient plant operations while maintaining statutory and company standards.

Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Plant & Production Management
Lead end-to-end plant operations and ensure achievement of production targets.
Plan and monitor production schedules, capacity utilization and operational efficiency.
Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, materials and other resources.
Monitor production losses, downtime, wastage and overall plant productivity.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational costs.
2. Quality, Food Safety & Compliance
Ensure adherence to applicable quality, food safety, statutory and regulatory requirements.
Ensure compliance with company SOPs, quality systems, safety standards and audit requirements.
Coordinate with Quality teams to maintain product quality and hygiene standards.
Ensure timely closure of observations arising from internal, external and regulatory audits.
Maintain necessary plant documentation, records and compliance requirements.
3. Maintenance & Engineering Coordination
Coordinate with Engineering/Maintenance teams to ensure maximum machine availability.
Monitor preventive and breakdown maintenance activities.
Identify recurring equipment issues and drive corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure proper planning of maintenance activities without impacting production.
4. People Management
Lead, develop and manage plant employees across functions and shifts.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective manpower deployment.
Set clear performance expectations and monitor team performance.
Develop a culture of discipline, accountability, safety and continuous improvement.
Identify training and capability-building requirements for plant employees.
Handle employee-related operational issues in coordination with HR.
5. Stakeholder Management
Act as the key point of coordination between the plant and corporate functions.
Work closely with Quality, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain, Sales and other stakeholders.
Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, contractors and relevant authorities as required.
Ensure effective communication and timely resolution of operational issues.
6. Safety & Hygiene
Ensure strict adherence to plant safety, hygiene and housekeeping standards.
Drive awareness and compliance with safety procedures across the plant.
Identify potential safety risks and ensure appropriate corrective actions.
Promote a strong safety culture among employees and contractors.
7. Cost & Resource Management
Monitor plant operating costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Ensure efficient utilization of raw materials, packaging materials, utilities and manpower.
Monitor wastage, energy consumption and other key operating expenses.
Support budgeting and operational planning for the plant.

Computer System Validation (CSV)
FDA 21 CFR Part 11
GxP Compliance
Validation Lifecycle Management
Risk Assessment & Qualification
Audit & Compliance Support
SOP & Documentation Management
Quality Systems

Lead end-to-end IT infrastructure operations supporting plant and business-critical systems.
Ensure high availability of servers, storage, network, end-user computing, and data center services.
Drive incident, change, problem, asset, and service management processes.
Manage IT security, backup, disaster recovery, and compliance initiatives.
Lead site IT teams while supporting uninterrupted manufacturing and business operations.
Key Skills Required
IT Infrastructure Management
Data Center Operations
Network & Server Administration
IT Service Management (ITSM)
Cybersecurity & Compliance
Backup & Disaster Recovery
Vendor Management
Team Leadership

Candidates with hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred:
Computer System Validation (CSV)
IT Infrastructure & Plant IT Operations
Manufacturing Systems (MES, LIMS, Historian)
Industrial Automation & Smart Manufacturing
IT-OT Integration

Data Historian Platforms
Digital Manufacturing & Pharma 4.0 Technologies

as a digital transformation leader and SME in Industrial manufacturing and Cement Manufacturing Industry and Plant Operations domain with good knowledge of day-to-day activities in industry

The role involves assisting shareholders with buying and selling shares in accordance with established procedures and service standards. The candidate will also handle customer queries and provide operational support under appropriate guidance and supervision.

Description:
Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in shifts as required.
Specific Qualifications:
Graduation in any discipline
DELF B1 and above certification in French language
Location: Mumbai/ Chennai/ Bangalore
About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
About BNP Paribas India Solutions:
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations


Your Role

We are looking for experienced Guidewire professionals with strong hands-on expertise across Policy Center and Guidewire Integrations to design, configure, customize, and support scalable solutions for Property Casualty insurance clients. The role involves working across the Guidewire Insurance Suite ecosystem to enable seamless policy administration, claims management, billing operations, and system integrations.
Design, develop, configure, and maintain Guidewire applications across Policy Center.
Customize Guidewire components using Gosu, Java, Guidewire Studio, and configuration tools.
Work on Guidewire Policy Center capabilities including policy administration, product configuration, underwriting rules, rating, pricing, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements.
Design and build integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, including plugins, messaging, web services, batch processes, event triggers, and data exchange pipelines.
Develop and maintain SOAP/REST APIs, XML/XSD-based data exchanges, JSON structures, messaging components, and integration interfaces.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.




Your Profile

6+ years of experience in software development, with strong hands-on exposure to Guidewire Policy Center applications.
Strong experience in one or more Guidewire modules: PolicyCenter
Proficiency in Gosu, Java, XML, JSON, XSD, SQL, SOAP/REST Web Services, and Guidewire configuration tools.
Good understanding of Property Casualty insurance domain processes across policy and policy integration landscapes.
Hands-on experience with Guidewire data models, workflows, rules engine, plugins, messaging, batch processes, and web services.
Experience integrating Guidewire applications with PolicyCenter, comp raters, payment gateways, document systems, accounting platforms, customer portals, and other external systems.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, Git, Jenkins, Maven, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Guidewire Cloud is preferred.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
Guidewire certification in PolicyCenter is preferred.




What you will love about working here

Opportunity to work on large-scale Guidewire Insurance Suite transformation programs for global PC insurance clients.
Exposure to end-to-end insurance technology delivery across policy, claims, billing, and integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevOps, cloud, and integration-led architecture.
Structured learning, certifications, and continuous upskilling opportunities in insurance platforms and emerging technologies.
A collaborative and inclusive culture focused on innovation, delivery excellence, and client value.


We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Join us and help the worlds leading organizations


Your Role

We are looking for experienced Guidewire professionals with strong hands-on expertise across Billing Center and Guidewire Integrations to design, configure, customize, and support scalable solutions for Property Casualty insurance clients. The role involves working across the Guidewire Insurance Suite ecosystem to enable seamless policy administration, claims management, billing operations, and system integrations.
Design, develop, configure, and maintain Guidewire applications across Billing Center, and Integration modules.
Customize Guidewire components using Gosu, Java, Guidewire Studio, and configuration tools.
Configure and enhance Billing Center workflows such as invoices, payments, write-offs, adjustments, refunds, delinquency processes, commissions, payment allocation, and GL postings.
Design and build integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, including plugins, messaging, web services, batch processes, event triggers, and data exchange pipelines.
Develop and maintain SOAP/REST APIs, XML/XSD-based data exchanges, JSON structures, messaging components, and integration interfaces.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Perform unit testing, support QA/UAT phases, troubleshoot application and integration issues, and assist in production deployments.
Participate in code reviews, Agile ceremonies, documentation, and development best practices to ensure quality and delivery excellence.

Your Profile
6+ years of experience in software development, with strong hands-on exposure to Guidewire Insurance Suite applications.
Strong experience in one or more Guidewire module:Billing Center and Billing guidewire Integrations.
Proficiency in Gosu, Java, XML, JSON, XSD, SQL, SOAP/REST Web Services, and Guidewire configuration tools.
Good understanding of Property Casualty insurance domain processes across billing and integration landscapes.
Hands-on experience with Guidewire data models, workflows, rules engine, plugins, messaging, batch processes, and web services.
Experience integrating Guidewire applications with Billing Center, comp raters, payment gateways, document systems, accounting platforms, customer portals, and other external systems.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.

Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, Git, Jenkins, Maven, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Guidewire Cloud is preferred.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
Guidewire certification in BillingCenter is preferred.

What you will love about working here
Opportunity to work on large-scale Guidewire InsuranceSuite transformation programs for global PC insurance clients.
Exposure to end-to-end insurance technology delivery across policy, claims, billing, and integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevOps, cloud, and integration-led architecture.
Structured learning, certifications, and continuous upskilling opportunities in insurance platforms and emerging technologies.
A collaborative and inclusive culture focused on innovation, delivery excellence, and client value.

We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.

Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications

2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.

Description:
Key Responsibilities
Act as the primary bilingual liaison between Japanese client stakeholders (HQ and regional teams) and the Oracle Cloud delivery team across requirement workshops, CRP/UAT cycles, and steering committee updates.
Support supply chain process workstreams planning, order management, procurement, inventory, and manufacturing — and, where relevant experience exists, contribute to configuration, testing, and rollout activities on the Oracle Cloud platform.
Translate and localise functional specifications, process flows, test scripts, and training materials between Japanese and English, ensuring technical accuracy is preserved.
Facilitate real-time interpretation during design workshops, CRP demonstrations, and issue-resolution calls with Japanese business and IT stakeholders.
Support fit-gap analysis and solution design for Japan-specific statutory, tax, and reporting requirements within Oracle Cloud (e.g. consumption tax, Japan GAAP nuances, e-invoicing).
Coordinate with onshore Japan-based teams and offshore delivery teams to manage cultural and time-zone alignment, escalations, and status reporting.
Contribute to test scenario validation, data migration reviews, and cutover planning for multi-country, multi-plant Oracle Cloud implementations in the automotive sector.
Support change management and end-user training delivery for Japanese-speaking plant and business teams.

Required Qualifications
Japanese Language Proficiency (Primary requirement): JLPT N3 minimum; N2 or above strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience using Japanese in a professional/business context (client calls, documentation, workshops).
Industry Background (Primary requirement): Prior experience on automotive OEM or Tier-1/Tier-2 supplier programmes — familiarity with JIT/JIS manufacturing, multi-plant/multi-country rollouts, and automotive-specific supply chain processes.
Oracle Cloud Knowledge (Good to have, not mandatory): Exposure to Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules — Supply Planning, Order Management, Procurement, Inventory Management, Manufacturing, Product Hub/PLM — will be viewed favourably but is not a prerequisite.
Consulting Experience: Prior experience with a Big 4, global systems integrator, or automotive-industry consulting/coordination role; comfortable working in client-facing delivery roles.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related field; any ERP or Oracle Cloud certification is a bonus, not expected.
Willingness to travel to client sites (India and potentially Japan) as required by programme milestones.

Preferred / Good to Have
Prior experience specifically supporting Japanese automotive clients (e.g. DENSO, Toyota Group, Honda, Nissan, Suzuki, or their Tier-1 supplier ecosystem).
Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules from prior implementation, support, or super-user experience.
JETRO or other formal bilingual business-communication certification.
Prior experience as a bridge engineer, IT coordinator, or business analyst in a Japanese-client environment — candidates strong on language and automotive-industry fit will be considered even without direct Oracle exposure, with structured platform training provided on the job.
