Description:
Role & responsibilities
Requirement - Business Analyst
Hexagram FinTech, a products company in the Investment Management space is looking for young and energetic Functional Specialists to supplement the current product team. The product is deployed in several of the top mutual fund and insurance companies in India and South East Asia and will expose you to the capital markets in these regions.
Finance professional with 2+ years of experience in any Financial Services Industry viz; Asset Management / Portfolio Management / Wealth Management / Mutual Fund / Treasury and other related industry are preferred.
Exposure / Understanding of the following areas is a pre-requisite:
• Understanding of all asset classes (Equities, Bonds, Derivatives, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds , Forex etc.) and examples of each type
• Attributes of each of these asset classes.
• Investment Accounting (General Ledger)
• Understanding of various types of corporate actions
• Understanding of NFO, IPO, Primary Market, Secondary Market etc
• NAV Calculation
• Various types of fees associated with a trade and basic understanding of each fees
• Basic understanding of how accounting is done for each type of transaction.
• Knowledge of Pricing, Valuation, Gain / Loss computation, Interest computation, Amortization, Reconciliation and Reporting
• Knowledge of SQL / Microsoft Excel / Microsoft PowerPoint / Microsoft Word.
Role and Responsibilities:
• Part of the Functional team at Hexagram and will be responsible for Implementation of Hexagrams software products at its client sites
• Assisting the product development team in Testing and validation of functionality
• Providing support to existing clients on the products
• As part of Implementation, will be responsible for supporting the users in user acceptance tests, conducting user training, coordinating with Technical teams, documenting user requirements, assisting in data reconciliation and reporting
• Manage releases from the product team to the client installations, conduct detailed tests, contributing to continuous enrichment of user guides / manuals
• Ability to work as per clients working hours.
Educational Background: Graduate / Post Graduate in Finance
Should be either from BA background or accounting background.
Experience in Front/ Mid /Back end roles on Investment System is a plus.

Mail your resume to rizwan.basha@kfintech.com
AboutCompany: KFintech serves the mission-critical needs of asset managers with clients spanning mutual funds, AIFs (alternative investments), pension, wealth managers and corporates in India and abroad. The company provides SaaS based end-to-end transaction management, channel management, compliance solutions, data analytics and various other digital services to asset managers across segments, as well as outsourcing services for global players.

Description:
Job Title: Senior Salesforce Developer
Experience: 6+ Years
Job Locations: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad
Notice Period: Immediate joiners preferred

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development, customization, and implementation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, Visualforce, and Aura Components.
The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, customizing, and maintaining scalable Salesforce applications while collaborating with business stakeholders, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Roles and Responsibilities
Design, develop, customize, and maintain Salesforce applications based on business requirements.
Work extensively with Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud implementations and enhancements.
Develop reusable and responsive user interfaces using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Aura Components.
Write, test, and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch Apex, and asynchronous processes.
Develop and maintain Visualforce pages and controllers as required.
Implement Salesforce workflows, validation rules, flows, and process automation.
Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST and SOAP APIs.
Follow Salesforce development best practices, including bulkification, governor limit management, and secure coding standards.
Participate in requirement analysis, technical design, code reviews, unit testing, and deployment activities.
Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and optimize application performance.
Manage deployments using Salesforce change sets, Salesforce CLI, or CI/CD tools.
Collaborate with business analysts, QA teams, architects, and other developers to deliver reliable solutions.
Maintain technical documentation and ensure adherence to Salesforce coding standards.

Required Technical Skills
6+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development.
Strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
Proficiency in Lightning Web Components (LWC) and JavaScript.
Strong programming experience in Apex Classes, Apex Triggers, Batch Apex, and asynchronous Apex.
Hands-on experience with Visualforce Pages and Controllers.
Experience developing and maintaining Aura Components.
Good understanding of Salesforce data modeling, objects, relationships, security, profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules.
Experience with Salesforce APIs and third-party integrations using REST/SOAP.
Knowledge of SOQL, SOSL, governor limits, and Salesforce platform best practices.
Experience with Salesforce deployment tools and version control systems such as Git.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and the software development lifecycle.

Description:
Data Engineer
Location:Chennai | Bangalore | Hyderabad | Mumbai
Engagement model: Full-time
Immediate Joiners Preferred
Role Summary
Timely, reliable data pipelines are what turn a platform design into business value. The Data Engineer
builds and operates the pipelines that move data from source systems into the lakehouse and on to analytics and AI consumers. They ensure that the pipelines are automated, performant, secure and governed.
The role works alongside the data architect, data quality engineer, business analysts and AI engineers. Its
job is to deliver production-grade pipelines on Azure / Microsoft Fabric, with metadata and lineage
captured in Microsoft Purview.

Build batch, incremental, CDC and streaming ingestion pipelines from source systems into the Bronze layer, using Azure Data Factory and Fabric pipelines.
Develop Silver- and Gold-layer transformations in SQL, PySpark and Spark notebooks, including cleansing, conformance, enrichment and business-rule logic.
Implement dimensional models, SCDs, surrogate keys and data marts according to the architect's designs.
Integrate DQ checks, validation, quarantine and reconciliation into pipelines in partnership with the Senior Data Quality Engineer.
Ensure that pipelines publish metadata and lineage to Microsoft Purview.
Implement scheduling, dependency management, parameterization, error handling and alerting.
¢ Optimize pipelines, partitioning, file formats (Delta/Parquet) and compute usage for performance and cost efficiency.
¢ Apply access controls, masking, encryption and secure credential management in line with UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR.
¢ Maintain code in source control and deploy through CI/CD pipelines, with automated tests and environment promotion.
¢ Support production operations, incident resolution and runbooks, and coach SUTHERLAND engineers so that the pipelines can be sustained after
handover.

¢ 4+ years in data engineering, preferably within UAE government or regulated-sector environments.
¢ Advanced SQL, Python and PySpark/Spark skills.
¢ Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or Synapse.
¢ Strong understanding of Lakehouse/Medallion architecture, Delta/Parquet formats and
dimensional modelling, including SCDs and surrogate keys.
¢ Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub), source control and DataOps practices.
¢ Familiarity with Microsoft Purview metadata and lineage, and with DQ tooling.
¢ Awareness of UAE data regulation, including UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR.
¢ Excellent English communication and documentation skills; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.

Description:
SAP Analytics Cloud & Datasphere Consultant
Location: Bangalore or Chennai
Duration: Contingent Worker (6 Months)
AstraZenecas Global Business Services (GBS) Process & Analytics Services capability is at the forefront of transforming our business processes through innovation in automation, analytics, and artificial intelligence. As part of the Process Insights team, we are scaling our SAP analytics expertise to deliver best-in-class solutions. We are seeking a talented SAP Analytics Cloud & Datasphere Consultant to drive analytical initiatives and empower data-driven decision-making across AstraZeneca.
Main duties and responsibilities
The role will be responsible for the following activities:
Own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of analytics solutions, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Design, build, and maintain scalable data models in SAP Datasphere to support reporting and analytics requirements.
Develop analytical datasets, views, and business-ready data models following governance and best practices.
Integrate and harmonize data from SAP and non-SAP sources within Datasphere.
Create and enhance SAC dashboards, stories, and KPI reports using Datasphere as the primary data source.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical designs and scalable analytics solutions.
Perform unit testing, support SIT/UAT activities, and ensure successful deployment to production.
Troubleshoot and optimize data models, queries, and SAC reports for performance, usability, and data quality.
Ensure adherence to data governance, security, and development standards.
Provide ongoing support and continuous improvement for delivered analytics products.
Prepare technical documentation and contribute to Agile delivery ceremonies.
Essential requirements
Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics or a comparable degree.
Overall, 8-12 years of experience and at least 2-3 years experience working on SAP SAC / Datasphere solutions as a Consultant, Analyst, Developer or relevant role.
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Datasphere data modelling (Analytical Models, Views, Data Flows, Replication Flows, SQL Views).
Experience developing SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) stories, dashboards, and visualizations.
Good understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, and ETL/ELT concepts.
Experience integrating data from SAP S/4HANA, BW, and non-SAP systems.
Strong SQL and analytical problem-solving skills.
Business process knowledge in Finance (P&L, Cost Centers, Budgeting, Forecasting, Procurement, Spend Analytics) and/or Operations/Supply Chain (Inventory, Logistics, Manufacturing, Order Management, Service Operations).
Ability to engage with business users and convert business requirements into technical data models and reports.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work in an Agile environment.
Energetic, organised and self-motivated.
Fluent in business English.

Quadient Inspire Developer - Job Description
Position: Quadient Inspire Developer
Experience: 3-5 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai (or as per project requirement)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Quadient Inspire Developer to design, develop, and implement Customer Communications Management (CCM) solutions using the Quadient Inspire platform. The ideal candidate should have expertise in document composition, template development, workflow automation, data processing, and multichannel customer communication solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain customer communication solutions using Quadient Inspire.
Create and modify templates for print, email, SMS, and digital communications.
Develop dynamic document generation and personalized customer correspondence.
Build and maintain Inspire Scaler workflows and automation processes.
Integrate Quadient Inspire with enterprise applications, databases, and third-party systems.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical design solutions.
Perform data mapping, transformation, and document formatting.
Optimize document generation performance and batch processing.
Conduct unit testing, system testing, and production support activities.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Job Title: Automation QA- Tosca
Position: Senior Software Engineer
Experience: 5 - 12 Years
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
Shift: General
Main location: Chennai/Bangalore/Hyderabad
Position ID:
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 6 years of relevant experience.
Position Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled TOSCA Automation Testing Specialist to join our project team supporting a leading US-based client in the Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance domain. The role involves designing, developing, and executing automation test strategies for modern applications as well as legacy systems, ensuring seamless integration and quality assurance across diverse technology landscapes.
Responsibilities:
Design and implement automation frameworks using Tricentis TOSCA for insurance applications.
Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and QA teams to understand requirements and translate them into automated test cases.
Conduct feasibility analysis for automation in legacy systems and propose effective solutions.
Develop and maintain test assets, reusable modules, and regression suites.
Execute automated test cases, analyze results, and report defects with clear documentation.
Integrate automation testing with CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation.
Provide knowledge transfer and training to team members on TOSCA best practices.
Ensure compliance with insurance industry standards and client-specific quality benchmarks.
Must-Have Skills:
5-10years of experience in automation testing with Tricentis TOSCA.
Strong understanding of P&C Insurance domain workflows (policy administration, claims, underwriting, billing).
Hands-on experience in test case design, test data management, and test execution using TOSCA.
Exposure to legacy systems (mainframe, AS/400, or other custom-built platforms) and strategies for automation enablement.
Familiarity with API testing, web applications, and database validations.
Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, AWS DevOps, GitLab) and integration of automation frameworks.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and client-facing skills.
Good-to-Have Skills:
TOSCA Certification (Automation Specialist Level 1 & 2).
Experience in insurance product implementations or modernization projects.
Knowledge of test management tools (JIRA, ALM, qTest).
Ability to work in Agile/Scrum environments.
CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.
Life at CGI:
It is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, youll reach your full potential because
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons
Come join our team, one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world

Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) / Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) Developer - Job Description
Job Title: AEP Developer / AJO Developer / Adobe Experience Cloud Consultant
Experience: 4-8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai / Remote
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) Developer to design, implement, and optimize customer data platforms, audience management, real-time personalization, and cross-channel customer journeys. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, Real-Time CDP, customer profiling, journey orchestration, and marketing automation.
Key Responsibilities
Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)
Design and implement customer data solutions using Adobe Experience Platform.
Create and manage XDM Schemas, Datasets, and Dataflows.
Configure data ingestion methods including Batch, Streaming, and API-based integrations.
Build and manage Real-Time Customer Profiles.
Perform identity resolution and profile stitching.
Create and optimize audience segments for activation.
Integrate AEP with Adobe Experience Cloud and external systems.
Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO)
Design and implement customer journeys across multiple channels.
Configure and manage Email, SMS, Push Notifications, In-App, and Web campaigns.
Create event-driven and audience-based journeys.
Implement personalization and offer decisioning strategies.
Configure triggers, actions, conditions, and journey workflows.
Monitor campaign performance and optimization opportunities.
Collaboration & Delivery
Partner with marketing, analytics, and technical teams.
Translate business requirements into scalable AEP/AJO solutions.
Troubleshoot production issues and optimize platform performance.
Support governance, security, and data privacy requirements.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Sr. Associate Operations.

About the role:
Own the end-to-end order journey for steel and bitumen raw material orders, from order verification to delivery and proof of delivery. You will be the face of Tata nexarc Operations for customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the full supply chain lifecycle of assigned orders: order verification, documentation checks and seller dispatch coordination.
Monitor deliveries, collect Proof of Delivery (POD), and ensure quality and compliance requirements are met.
Track payments and customer credit limits as per SOPs and payment terms.
Maintain OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance of 85% or higher, and escalate exceptions early.
Validate documents: customer and seller POs, proforma and tax invoices, e-way bills, Mill Test Certificates (MTC) and delivery proofs.
Coordinate with transporters, fleet owners and drivers, and visit seller locations and transporter hubs when needed.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Engineering.
2–6 years in operations, supply chain, logistics or customer operations; steel experience preferred, bitumen or commodity exposure a plus.
Working knowledge of ERP, CRM and AI-enabled productivity tools.
Strong English and Hindi communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail and a bias for action.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include a hybrid work model, need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.


Skills: Order Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, OTIF, E-way Bill, MTC, Steel, Bitumen, ERP, Stakeholder Management .

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Description:
Purpose of the role

The face of the D2C platform in the physical market. Visit mechanics, roadside garages, small workshops, and truck operators in an assigned territory. Demonstrate the platform, register new buyers, facilitate the first purchase, and ensure the buyer can use the app independently. This role converts an unorganized market buyer into a digital platform user.

Key Responsibility
Cover assigned pin codes daily visit mechanics, garages, and small fleet operators to introduce the D2C platform
Register new buyers on the platform (app install + profile creation) target 15+ new registrations per day
Demonstrate app search (by vehicle model and part name), part selection, payment, and delivery tracking
Facilitate the buyer's first online spare parts purchase stay with them through the transaction
Follow up within 7 days of first purchase to ensure delivery satisfaction and resolve any issues
Capture buyer feedback on platform gaps: parts not found, confusing UX, delivery complaints report weekly
Maintain a daily activity log: shops visited, registrations done, first purchases facilitated
Attend weekly territory review with Category Manager / Lead BD
Participate in platform training sessions when new features or categories are launched

Qualification & Experience

13 years in field sales, FMCG distribution, insurance agency, or fintech outreach roles
Knowledge of commercial vehicles or spare parts market strongly preferred
Smartphone proficiency; able to demonstrate app fluently in local language
High energy and comfort with ground-level market work workshops, roadside interactions
Local language fluency essential; Hindi and regional language preferred
Diploma Holder from Mechanical Background

Job Description
Overview
A Growth Associate owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Responsible for efficiency of Operations of 108/112 Ambulances in the assigned Cluster, comprising 3-4 districts.

Ensure cordial relations with the Media, conduct Press meets periodically and ensure optimal media coverage about 108 services in the assigned area of operations.
Develop comprehensive plans to conduct EM training programs in the assigned territory
Responsible for conducting brand awareness campaigns/activities/public engagement activities Presentations, Events, co- branding etc.

POSITION SUMMARY
Promote awareness of brand image internally and externally. Use sales techniques that maximize revenue while maintaining existing guest loyalty to Marriott. Communicate with potential owners via telephone to set up preview package sales/tours. Encourage guests or callers to purchase or schedule preview package sales/tours. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

Lead and supervise shift personnel, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback.
Maintain accurate operational records, prepare shift reports, and communicate critical information to management.
Collaborate with quality control teams to ensure compliance with product specifications and standards.
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process efficiency and reduce operational costs.
Implement and enforce standard operating procedures and best practices within the department.

Job Purpose
"This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd."
Engage with channel partners to build and strengthen relationship. Build distribution for Rural consumer Product Finance and distribution mapping for Rural consumer Product Finance. Duties and Responsibilities
Achieving exceeding Business goals and targets for Consumer Durables -Creating a strong compliant sales culture to drive acquisitions, profitability and employee development-Manage the Distribution through Dealer relations and servicing the Dealers, and their concerns in an appropriate manner.-Managing the Delinquency of the business sourced to ensure health of portfolio
-Effectively engage Operations Risk teams to understand and contribute to overall processes profitability across locations
-Identifying the need of sales training, analyzing changing market trends, channel deployment etc. Also giving feedback suggestions to the RSM/NSM -Ensure implementation of promotional plans contests and suggesting new and innovating promotion plan for the area of work.-Recruiting and Retaining high performers. -Ensuring highest levels of employee relationship, motivation engagement to drive results high levels of employee satisfaction.-Supporting collections team in ensuring 100% collections MAJOR CHALLENGES:
-struggling to find and keep talented employees. -Customer always seeking the latest technology, most efficient service, instant gratification, and a customized experience. -Retaining employees as they have banking sector as an option available.
-Online Market as well effected / impacted in filed. DECISIONS ; - Implement a sales management process that guides the team's decision on how to effectively manage this time and decide who to spend with. -Connect with field Teams Spending the Maximum time to Our Team. Link performance with rewards and recognition as par their achievement. -Design and Develop a Customer (Dealer and Business Partner's) Visit frequency plan for their field. INTERACTIONS: Internal Clients:Roles you need to interact with inside the organization to enable success in your day to day work - Provide market and product related feedback to HO (Managers / Senior hierarchy )-Credit Team for high ticket approvals -Operation for customer services and file disbursement -Risk team for approval declined cases due to specific reasons e.g. policy-FCU Team for fraud cases validation -Collections for bucket cases and FEMI cases or problematic cases External Clients: Roles you need to interact with outside the organization to enable success in your day to day work :External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales by Achieving Origination Targets. ASSC (Authorized Sales Service Center), Serving the existing external walk in customers at dealers and Increasing business opportunities.
a) Qualifications :
- Graduation / Post graduation
- Strong analytical skills to drive channel performance and drive profitability
- People Relationship Management skills
- Excellent Communication and Negotiation Skill
b) Work Experience:
- Graduation / Post graduation with 4 to 6 years and MBA with 3-4 years of relevant experience in sales

Financial Dimensions

As a manager, you'll need to define Business scope. Defining what is needed is the first step. setting Business goals and allocating to Team. the Business scope should have a tangible objective for the organization
- In Festive seasons minimum 15k cases in a quarter
- Normal days minimum 9K cases in a quarter
- Cross sell targets 650 IPC to be maintained



Other Dimensions

Total Team Size: 29
Number of Direct Reports: 6
Number of Indirect Reports: 23 (off role)
Number of Outsourced employees: 18 (ASCC)

JOB SUMMARY
The position assists with the soliciting and handling of sales opportunities. Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives. CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.

Managing Sales Activities

- Assists in closing the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

Description:
About the Job:
We are looking for a dynamic and entrepreneurial Unit Sales Head to drive business growth and revenue for Manipal Hospitals. The role will focus on building and managing relationships with Corporate Clients, TPAs, Insurance Companies, Referral Networks, and Channel Partners, while identifying new business opportunities and strengthening sales channels. The ideal candidate should have strong healthcare sales experience, excellent relationship-management skills, and a proven track record of achieving business growth.

About Manipal Hospitals:
As a pioneer in healthcare, Manipal Hospitals is among the top healthcare providers in India serving over 8 million patients annually, with a focus on providing affordable, highquality healthcare services. Manipals integrated network today has a pan-India footprint of 49 hospitals across 24 cities with 12,600 licensed beds, and a talented pool of 11,000+ doctors and an employee strength of over 34000.
Manipal Hospitals provides comprehensive curative and preventive care for a multitude of patients from around the globe. Manipal Hospitals is AAHRPP accredited and most of the hospitals in its network are NABH, NABL, ER, Blood Bank accredited and recognized for Nursing Excellence.
AboutCompany: Manipal Hospitals, Bhubaneswar (formerly AMRI Hospitals) is a leading 400-bed multi-specialty tertiary care hospital located in Khandagiri, Odisha. Accredited by NABH, the facility provides round-the-clock emergency, trauma, and critical care services alongside advanced medical treatments across key specialties like cardiology, neurology, oncology, orthopaedics, and nephrology. Equipped with modern diagnostic technology such as PET-CT scanning and minimally invasive surgical setups, it serves as a major healthcare hub for patients across eastern India.

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The position will be responsible for driving retail sales of Passenger Electric Vehicles to personal customers in assigned regions to achieve business objectives in terms of volumes, market share and customer experience; the incumbent is to provide focus to EV retail efforts, including market activation, tie-ups, customer & pipeline management
Lack of focus for EV retail in a primarily ICE focused dealership structure; limited EV ecosystem development and activation for personal segment EV buyers
Job Responsibility
1. Driving EV Retail Sales volumes & Market Share:
Deliver Retail targets for the city/region through dealership as well as alternate channel sales teams
Direct responsibility of managing sales in Store-in-Store/Experience Centres
Micro-market activation: Identify, optimize and conduct micro market activations within the region to optimize lead generation and conversion
Interface with dealerships through PV TSMs to seek dealer support & ensure dealer focus to achieve retail targets
Optimize test drives and conversion through special initiatives executed through dealers and alternate channels
Develop market intelligence on customer preferences, competitor offerings, key opportunities, etc. and share with Head – EV Retail Sales
Develop and manage region specific tie-ups to increase value proposition of EVs
2. Manage Customer Relationships:
Engage frequently with EV customers & serve as first point of escalation for customers (adhering to SLAs)
Share feedback with Charging Solutions & Customer Experience teams
3. Team Management:
Monitor Sales funnel and direct Product Specialists to Manage pool of TML Sales executives deployed in alternate sales channels to take appropriate follow-up actions to ensure retail customer satisfaction.
Onboard and manage product specialists across relevant sales channels
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
Regional Customer Care Manager
Specific service campaigns/ communicate service-related issues being faced by retail customers in the region
Sales Planning
Providing inputs on the sales forecast and tracking delivery
Zonal Retail Marketing
Align on EV specific offers
Charging Solutions/
Customer Experience
Communicating product/service feedback received on-ground to charging/customer experience team
PVBU TSM
Interface with TSMs to seek dealer support and ensure dealer focus to achieve retail targets

External:
Channel Partners
Direct Feedback/ daily assistance to them to sort issues.
Financial Institutions
For financial offerings as required by retail customers (along with RCFI, at times directly)
Desired Candidate Profile
Education: B.E/ B. Tech & MBA - Sales & Marketing
Relevant Experience: 5-6 years of Sales & Marketing experience with a focus in EV/PV sales.
Understanding of Competition Product Portfolio and own competitive advantage.
Ability to communicate with learned and environmentally conscious set of Customers.
Experience in Value Selling concept of Sales.
Ability to lead and manage teams and achieve targets; drive product specialists and dealerships to achieve retail targets
Strong Oral & written communication with good fluency in English language and local language of relevant city/region
Ability to guide teams in prioritizing and managing customer pipeline without losing sales
Strong planning & problem solving skills to create city specific market activation plans, tie-ups and customer schemes
Knowledge of EV/PV sales process and sales resource allocation
Ability to influence colleagues/ other BU manpower without direct reporting relationship
Strong sales team leadership experience/ skills, evidenced through track record or references
Strong experience in Retail customer management, handling escalations and working with multiple internal stakeholders etc.
Knowledge of EV/PV sales process and sales resource allocation
Good technical knowledge of EV/PV products along with product features
Skills & Competencies
Effective Communication and Influencing Skills
Ability to drive teams to meet targets
Result Oriented approach
Accountability & Ownership
Ability to change user behaviour
Data Driven

Description:
Job description: The FSE will be responsible for acquiring new clients, maintaining relationships with existing clients, and drive revenue growth for advertising space in print media. The role involves field visits, client meetings, proposal pitching, post sales support, and internal coordination. This is an Individual Contributor role.


Roles and Responsibilities:
Sales & Revenue Growth:
Achieve sales targets as defined by the organization.
Motivate clients to choose bigger ads and run them more often to increase revenue.

• Client Acquisition & Relationship Management:
Identify and visit prospective clients through internal database or internal references.
Offer print advertisement solutions that match the clients business goals.
Build and maintain strong long-term client relationships.
Win repeat business from Clients by giving steady, reliable service.


Solution-Oriented Pitching:
Understand the clients business needs and develop customized marketing proposal.
Use data insights, wherever possible, to help clients reach more customers in new areas.
Encourage client participation in Special Initiatives (festive editions, theme-based ads, etc.).
Support in field marketing activities related to SIs

Campaign Execution, Collections & Coordination:
Act as the point of contact for clients on all post-sale support (creatives, deadlines, placements).
Collect advertisement materials/creatives and ensure timely submission for publishing.
Coordinate with internal departments (Billing, RO Generation, Scheduling) to ensure smooth ad execution.
Follow up for payments and ensure timely collections.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

About the Role : Dainik Bhaskar is looking for a highly driven sales professional to lead and grow advertisement revenue across key business categories. The role requires a blend of sales leadership, client relationship management, category understanding, and revenue generation capabilities. The incumbent will be responsible for managing a sales team, acquiring new advertisers, retaining existing clients, and achieving assigned revenue targets.


Key Responsibilities:
1.Sales Leadership & Team Management
Lead and manage a team of Field Sales Executives (FSEs) and sales professionals.
Set monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for the team. Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews, and coaching sessions.
Drive accountability through daily activity tracking and sales monitoring. Develop team capabilities through mentoring and field accompaniment.

2.Revenue Generation & Business Development
Achieve and exceed assigned revenue targets.
Build and manage a robust 90-day sales pipeline.
Identify and acquire new advertisers across categories.
Drive client retention, renewal, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities.
Ensure strong conversion rates from prospecting to closure.


3. Client Relationship Management
Build strong relationships with business owners, CXOs, marketing heads, and decision-makers.
Understand client business objectives and recommend suitable advertising solutions.
Conduct effective sales presentations and proposal discussions. Handle negotiations, pricing discussions, and contract closures professionally.
Maintain long-term advertiser relationships and enhance client satisfaction.


4. Category Development & Market Intelligence
Develop strong understanding of key categories such as: Education / Real Estate / Automobile / Retail / FMCG / BFSI
Track market trends, competitor activities, launches, and promotional opportunities.
Identify category-wise revenue opportunities and develop growth strategies, Prepare category acquisition and retention plans.

5. Media Sales & Advertising Solutions
Promote print advertising solutions and integrated media offerings. Understand ad inventory, pricing structures, packages, and campaign planning.
Guide clients on campaign execution, visibility, reach, and impact. Coordinate with internal stakeholders for seamless campaign delivery.

6. Communication & Presentation
Prepare client-specific proposals and sales presentations.
Conduct effective client meetings, pitches, and business reviews. Communicate professionally in Hindi and English, both written and verbal.
Deliver regular sales updates and business reports.

7. Planning & Business Analytics
Track sales performance using Excel, CRM, and reporting tools.
Analyse category trends, revenue performance, client retention, and market opportunities.
Prepare monthly and quarterly business plans. Develop action plans to improve productivity and revenue realization.

8. Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline / MBA in Marketing / Sales / Business Development preferred.

9. Preferred Additional Skills:Exposure to print advertisement sales, Experience handling multiple categories or markets, understanding of digital advertising platforms, Ability to design integrated advertising solutions combining print and digital media.

Summary
We are currently seeking dedicated and detail-oriented individuals to serve as Off-Role Quality & Process Control Representatives (OPC) for a leading paints manufacturing firm across various locations throughout India. This role offers an excellent opportunity for professionals with a background in quality control, production, or manufacturing operations to contribute to maintaining high standards within a respected industry name. The position is pivotal in ensuring product integrity and operational compliance from raw material sourcing through to final dispatch.

Responsibilities
Oversee the quality of raw and packaging materials at vendor sites to ensure they meet established standards.
Execute quality inspections, sampling procedures, and testing protocols in strict accordance with approved specifications.
Supervise production workflows to guarantee adherence to approved formulations and recipes.
Validate batch charging procedures, premix measurements, and the accuracy of production records.
Manage token systems effectively and reconcile them against finished goods shipments.
Perform final quality assessments on completed goods and maintain comprehensive batch-specific documentation.
Track filling weights, verify laboratory equipment calibration, and monitor critical quality parameters.
Generate and submit daily activity reports via a mobile application equipped with geo-tagging capabilities.
Detect any deviations in quality standards and promptly escalate significant findings to management.
Assist in scheduled quality audits and ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory and internal activities.



Requirements
Possess a Graduate degree or Diploma in Science, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
Have between 0.6 to 3 years of professional experience in quality control, production, manufacturing, or conducting plant and vendor audits.
Demonstrate practical knowledge of quality testing methods, sampling techniques, and documentation processes.
Exhibit strong observational, reporting, and analytical capabilities.
Be willing and able to work at external vendor or plant locations and utilize mobile applications for reporting tasks.

Location: Raipur

Graduate/Diploma in Science, Chemistry or a related discipline.
0.6 3 years of experience in Quality Control, Production, Manufacturing or Plant/Vendor Audits.
Knowledge of quality testing, sampling and documentation
Good observation, reporting and analytical skills.
Comfortable working at vendor/plant locations and using mobile applications.

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.
Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
State Product Manager (Product Line), State Head
Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Product Knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Communication Skills

Job Summary
The Deputy Relationship Manager for Fast Track Loan within the South Business department at Ujjivan Small Finance Bank plays a pivotal role in driving the growth and management of the bank's fast track loan portfolio. This position requires a strategic and customer-centric professional who can effectively manage client relationships, assess creditworthiness, and ensure timely disbursal of loans while adhering to regulatory and internal compliance standards. The role demands collaboration with cross-functional teams to optimize loan processing, mitigate risks, and enhance customer satisfaction in a competitive banking environment focused on financial inclusion and rapid service delivery.
Job Type: Full-time


Key Duties and Responsibilities
Manage and nurture relationships with existing and prospective clients to promote fast track loan products tailored to their financial needs.
Conduct thorough credit appraisals and risk assessments to ensure the quality and profitability of the loan portfolio.

Collaborate with marketing and product teams to develop and implement strategies that increase loan penetration in the South Business region.
Train and mentor junior relationship managers and field staff to improve team effectiveness and customer engagement.
Stay updated with industry developments, regulatory changes, and competitive landscape to adapt strategies accordingly.


Minimum Requirements of Knowledge and Skills

Educational Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.
Minimum of 4-6 years of experience in retail banking or microfinance, with a focus on loan portfolio management and customer relationship management.

Credit Risk Assessment
Loan Portfolio Management
Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
Regulatory Compliance in Banking

Cross-selling and Upselling Techniques
Negotiation and Conflict Resolution
Team Leadership and Mentoring

Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecyclefrom concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore & Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.

Your Role
Roles & Responsibilities
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices & methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.

About the Role
Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.
You will operate as a full-stack sales owner — from identifying opportunities within SMEs and enterprises to closing deals and ensuring long-term account success. The role requires a mix of hunting (acquisition) and farming (growth & retention), with a strong bias toward building from scratch.

What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhivery’s hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers
Who We’re Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Location:

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

The ideal candidate should possess strong technical and functional expertise in OTM and be capable of supporting AMS operations, enhancements, integrations, and production support activities.

Strong knowledge with OTM integrations, Agent creation and modification.
Troubleshooting in the XML, XSLT, and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) issue.

Support inbound and outbound integrations between OTM and ERP/WMS systems.

Gather and analyse business requirements and translate them into OTM solutions.
Strong knowledge of OTM configuration and administration.

Perform incident triage, impact assessment, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.

About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

Working at the heart of a fast-paced fashion business, a Visual Merchandiser will create an environment that inspires customers to explore their personal style. A multi-tasker who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment with an eye for detail, who puts creativity inclusivity together.
1-2+ years of transferrable experience welcome
Ability to stand for long periods of time, bend, stretch, engage in repetitive motions, push, pull and carry items (mannequins, clothing, totes, torsos, etc.) for a short distance
Must be able to work with hand and power operated tools (Iron, Steamer, etc) and lift in order to execute display setups
Must be able to work a flexible work schedule, including nights, weekends and support other stores

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Senior Resident

Department Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT)

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super Speciality Teaching Hospital.

Employment Type Full-Time | Resident Medical Officer (Teaching Hospital)

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Senior Resident in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim, is a pivotal training and operational role for postgraduate-qualified doctors seeking structured hands-on experience in forensic medical practice within a university teaching hospital. The incumbent will contribute to undergraduate MBBS teaching, forensic laboratory operations, mortuary supervision, and medico-legal documentation under the guidance of senior faculty. This role serves as a critical stepping stone toward an academic career as Assistant Professor, fulfilling the NMC-mandated Senior Resident experience requirement in a recognized medical institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and tutorial classes in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as assigned by the Head of Department.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes, practical demonstrations, and case-based learning sessions for MBBS students and interns.
Assist senior faculty in postgraduate teaching activities including seminars, journal clubs, and case presentations.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required to ensure uninterrupted academic programme delivery.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Collect, record, and maintain accurate patient and case information in accordance with institutional and medico-legal documentation standards.
Assist in forensic laboratory activities including collection of forensic samples such as viscera, blood, and tissues for toxicological analysis.
Ensure proper preservation and timely dispatch of forensic samples for toxicology analysis, adhering to institutional and legal protocols.
Maintain strict chain of custody for all forensic evidence ensuring proper labelling, packaging, documentation, and secure transfer at every stage.
Supervise mortuary operations and enforce safety protocols including infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling procedures.
Assist in medico-legal autopsy procedures under the supervision of faculty, including documentation of findings.
Support preparation of medico-legal certificates, injury reports, and other forensic documentation as required.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required, ensuring continuity of clinical and forensic operations.

C. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Maintain meticulous records of all forensic cases, samples, and medico-legal proceedings handled by the department.
Participate in departmental quality improvement initiatives and NABH compliance activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes, workshops, and departmental academic activities.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Department or senior faculty.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a permitted/recognized medical college or institution, as per NMC guidelines.
Regulatory & Compliance Requirements
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Appointment must comply with current NMC guidelines for Senior Resident positions in recognized medical institutions.
Must complete or be willing to complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (NMC-mandated) during the tenure.
Preference for candidates seeking to fulfill NMC-recognized SR experience for future Assistant Professor eligibility.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Forensic & Clinical Skills
Forensic sample collection & handling
Toxicology sample preservation & dispatch
Chain of custody maintenance
Mortuary supervision & safety
Post-mortem assistance & documentation
Medico-legal record keeping

Academic & Technical
UG MBBS lecture & clinical teaching
Practical demonstration skills
NMC regulatory awareness
Medical documentation & reporting
Forensic laboratory procedures
Biomedical research basics

Interpersonal & Soft Skills
Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Detail-oriented & organized
Ethical & professional conduct
Team collaboration skills
Composure in forensic environments

Description:
Senior Resident Paediatrics

Role Overview
The Senior Resident Paediatrics is a full-time, post-MD/DNB clinical and academic tenure position at a leading university-run super speciality teaching hospital and medical college integrating compassionate care, advanced medicine, teaching and research. The role delivers round-the-clock paediatric and neonatal care across the wards, emergency, NICU, PICU and outpatient services, while supporting the training of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of the Department of Paediatrics through the assigned unit faculty and supervises Junior Residents, interns and nursing teams on duty. It is a tenure position of up to 3 years under National Medical Commission (NMC) norms, suited to a qualified paediatrician seeking clinical depth alongside teaching and research exposure.

Work Mode
Work mode: work from hospital (fully on-site), with working days per hospital/NMC norms, including duty, on-call and emergency rosters as assigned by the department. No travel requirement has been specified for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Provide first-line senior clinical care to neonates, infants, children and adolescents admitted to paediatric wards, NICU and PICU, including daily rounds and clinical decision-making.
Assess, stabilise and manage paediatric and neonatal emergencies, including resuscitation, shock, respiratory distress, seizures, sepsis and poisoning.
Lead neonatal resuscitation at high-risk deliveries and caesarean sections in coordination with the obstetrics team.
Perform and supervise essential procedures such as endotracheal intubation, umbilical and peripheral vascular access, lumbar puncture, intraosseous access and surfactant administration, as clinically indicated.
Initiate and monitor respiratory support, including oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation, under faculty guidance.
Conduct paediatric outpatient and specialty clinics, including growth and development assessment, nutrition counselling, well-baby care and follow-up of high-risk newborns.
Implement immunisation services in line with the national immunisation schedule and Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) recommendations, including counselling of parents.
Take on-call and emergency duties as per the departmental roster, ensuring timely handover and continuity of care across shifts.
Teach and mentor MBBS students, interns and Junior Residents through bedside teaching, case presentations, skills sessions and assessments under competency-based medical education.
Maintain accurate, timely and legally sound medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, consent, discharge summaries and death certification.
Communicate clearly and compassionately with parents and families on diagnosis, prognosis and treatment plans, including breaking difficult news and obtaining informed consent.
Adhere to infection control, antimicrobial stewardship, patient safety and quality protocols, and participate in clinical audits and mortality and morbidity reviews.
Participate in departmental academic activities and clinical research, including journal clubs, seminars, case reports and approved research projects.
Coordinate with paediatric surgery, obstetrics, radiology, laboratory and other super speciality teams for multidisciplinary care and timely referrals.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical college recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MD (Paediatrics) or DNB (Paediatrics) from an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited institution, completed with results declared by the date of joining.
Valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, with the postgraduate qualification registered or eligible for registration.
Age below 45 years at initial appointment, as per prevailing NMC norms for Senior Residents in broad specialties.

Required Experience
Experience range: 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB paediatric clinical experience. Freshly qualified MD/DNB Paediatrics doctors are eligible to apply.
Relevant experience: postgraduate residency in Paediatrics with substantial rotations in NICU, PICU, paediatric emergency and general paediatric wards in a tertiary care or teaching hospital.
Preferred experience: prior work as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in Paediatrics in a medical college, teaching hospital or multi-specialty tertiary care hospital.
Industry preference: medical colleges, university teaching hospitals, super speciality hospitals and high-volume tertiary paediatric or neonatal care centres.

Technical and Functional Skills
Neonatal resuscitation and stabilisation in line with Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and National Neonatology Forum (NNF) guidelines.
Paediatric emergency and critical care management in line with Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) principles, including airway, breathing and circulation support.
Working knowledge of respiratory support: oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation.
Procedural competence: intubation, umbilical venous and arterial catheterisation, intraosseous access, lumbar puncture, surfactant administration and exchange transfusion.
Fluid, electrolyte and nutritional management, including parenteral nutrition in neonates and critically ill children.
Management of neonatal jaundice, prematurity, sepsis, respiratory distress, malnutrition, diarrhoeal disease and common infectious diseases of childhood.
Interpretation of blood gases, laboratory results and paediatric and neonatal imaging.
Growth monitoring, developmental assessment, immunisation practice and preventive paediatrics.
Clinical documentation on hospital information systems or electronic medical records, and adherence to evidence-based IAP and NNF protocols.
Bedside teaching and assessment methods under competency-based medical education.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Compassionate, family-centred communication with children and parents, including counselling under stress and breaking difficult news.
Composure, sound judgement and rapid decision-making during emergencies and night duties.
Team leadership on duty, guiding Junior Residents, interns and nursing staff with clarity and respect.
Collaboration with faculty, nursing, allied health and other clinical departments.
Strong professional ethics, integrity, patient confidentiality and respect for child rights and safeguarding.
Teaching aptitude, patience and a willingness to mentor learners.
Time management, reliability on rosters and accountability for patient outcomes.
Cultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate with patients from diverse linguistic and social backgrounds.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Valid NRP, PALS and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications.
Fellowship or certificate training in Neonatology, Paediatric Critical Care or a related paediatric subspecialty.
Publications, case reports or conference presentations in Paediatrics or Neonatology.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and exposure to medical education workshops.
Membership of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) or National Neonatology Forum (NNF).
Exposure to hospital quality, accreditation and patient safety programmes.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate has completed MD or DNB Paediatrics at a reputed NMC-recognised medical college or NBEMS-accredited hospital with a high patient load, and has trained across neonatal, paediatric intensive care, emergency and general paediatric services. Candidates with 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB experience as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in recognised teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary care centres are preferred, as are those with a stable, verifiable work record. The role suits doctors building a career in academic paediatrics or preparing for super-speciality training, as Senior Resident experience in a recognised teaching institution is relevant to NMC eligibility norms for teaching faculty positions.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is offered as a competitive annual CTC (Total Cost to Company) in Indian Rupees (), commensurate with qualification, experience and institutional norms. Benefits follow institutional policy and are shared with shortlisted candidates at the offer stage. The role offers structured clinical exposure across neonatal and paediatric critical care, protected involvement in teaching and research, and the experience of working in a super speciality academic environment.

Application Instructions
Send your resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – Paediatrics", via email to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message, or by WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include copies of your MBBS and MD/DNB certificates, your medical registration, a summary of NICU and PICU exposure, and your current notice period. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete the screening questionnaire and appear for an interview.
