Description:
Role Summary / Purpose

The Manager Workforce Solutions (ADP WorkForce Software Configuration) leads the design and delivery of client workforce management transformation and implementation engagements. The role owns ADP WorkForce Software (WFS) solution design and configuration governance, guides integration and testing strategy, manages delivery teams and senior client stakeholders, and ensures workforce policies and payroll requirements are translated into sustainable, controlled solutions.
Essential Responsibilities
Lead ADP WorkForce Software implementation and optimization workstreams from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, cutover and stabilization.
Own solution design for time and attendance, workforce scheduling, leave/accruals, approval workflows and workforce-to-payroll integration within the contracted scope.
Facilitate senior client design workshops and translate complex workforce policies, collective bargaining rules and pay practices into scalable configuration standards.
Provide expert oversight of rule configuration for overtime, premiums, shifts, breaks, rounding, holidays, exception management and pay code mappings.
Guide the design of organizational structures, security roles, manager workflows, reporting and control frameworks, balancing standard functionality with business needs.
Oversee HR and payroll integration design, interface specifications, end-to-end data flows, reconciliations and defect resolution with technical teams and vendors.
Approve configuration workbooks, design decisions, testing strategy, traceability and deployment readiness; manage scope changes and design trade-offs.
Direct system integration testing, user acceptance testing and parallel validation where relevant; ensure critical defects and payroll-impacting issues are resolved.
Manage project plans, resourcing, budgets, risks, dependencies, quality and client communications for assigned engagements.
Scheduling Go-Live Review Board and presenting configuration, audits and cutover plan to ADP WorkForce Software Enablement Services
Advise client leadership on workforce management operating models, controls, compliance considerations and opportunities for automation and standardization.
Lead, coach and review the work of Senior Associates and Associates; develop reusable accelerators and strengthen the WFS configuration capability.
Support proposals, estimates, statements of work, solution demonstrations and practice development activities as required.
Partner with HR, payroll, finance, operations and technology stakeholders to map workforce management processes, policies, controls and integration dependencies.
Assess workforce management and payroll impacts of time capture, attendance exceptions, scheduling, leave, overtime and premium pay rules.
Maintain configuration decisions, requirements traceability, process flows, test evidence and handover documentation in line with project governance.
Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes, improve data quality and strengthen workforce-to-payroll controls.

Qualifications / Requirements
Bachelors degree in Human Resources, Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance or related discipline; relevant advanced degree is an advantage.
ADP WorkForce Suite Certifications (configuration required)
WorkForce Time Configuration through Time201
WorkForce Reports
WorkForce Time Integrations
Approximately 8-12+ years of experience in workforce management, HR technology or payroll transformation, including leadership of implementation workstreams.
Demonstrated experience leading ADP WorkForce Software (WFS) solution design and configuration, ideally across multiple client implementations.
Deep knowledge of complex time and attendance rules, workforce scheduling, accruals, labor policies and downstream payroll impacts.
Experience overseeing integrations, configuration governance, test strategy, cutover and production stabilization.
Proven ability to manage client executives, cross-functional delivery teams, project risks, quality and commercial expectations.
Desired Skills
Experience delivering enterprise-scale, multi-location or multi-jurisdiction WFS implementations and optimization programs.
Ability to define standard design patterns, configuration governance, reusable assets and quality review checkpoints.
Knowledge of workforce compliance, payroll controls, data privacy, role-based access and audit requirements.
Experience with complex HR/payroll ecosystems and vendor-led integrations.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, team leadership, commercial and problem-solving skills.
Grade / Level
Manager

Job Summary

Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.

Job Summary
The Builder - Logistics is a high-agency, 0-to-1 role embedded within Ca's GS Retail Logistics function in the South. Based out of Bengaluru and working closely with the Regional Head - South, you will build new programs, ship new tools, and run controlled experiments across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala. This is not a steady-state ops role - you'll spend most of your time defining problems, prototyping solutions, and turning what works into repeatable playbooks that city teams can run at scale. You'll operate at the intersection of ops, data, product, and AI.
Key Responsibilities
New Program Design - Identify gaps across pilot supply, CSP adherence, auto-allocation, and fulfilment. Design new programs from scratch, run pilots, and hand off winning plays to city teams.
Ops Diagnostics Deep Dives - Own regional data - cut it by city, cohort, and process step to surface what's broken and where the fastest wins sit. Convert findings into structured action plans.
Product Specs Tool Building - Write clear specs for internal tools and dashboards. Partner with Product and Tech to ship what the region needs; use no-code and AI where full builds are overkill.
Automation of Manual Workflows - Map the region's sheet-heavy workflows and lead their transition to automated systems. Ship quick wins with Apps Script, Zapier, or AI copilots before scoping full products.
City-Level Experimentation - Run controlled A/B tests across cities to validate whether a new process, script, or intervention actually moves the KPI. Kill what doesn't work, scale what does.
Cross-functional Execution - Work directly with city heads, Category Managers, Product, and Tech to unblock progress. Translate ground-team pain-points into shipped fixes fast.
Qualifications Experience
2-4 years in high-agency roles - startup ops, strategy consulting, category management, or founders office.
Track record of shipping something end-to-end - a program, a tool, a dashboard, a new city launch - that survived after you moved on.
Comfortable in ambiguity - can walk into a messy problem and leave with a structured plan.
Strong first-principles thinking; happy to visit yards and talk to pilots before writing a single line of a proposal.
Bengaluru-based or willing to relocate; comfortable travelling across Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala.
Data AI Skills
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets - pivots, lookups, and formula-based analysis at scale.
SQL fluency for querying large operational datasets; Python or R for deeper analysis is a strong plus.
Comfort building dashboards (Looker, Data Studio, Tableau) that drive city-level decisions.
Hands-on with AI copilots (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate analysis, drafting, and prototyping.
Familiar with no-code automation (Apps Script, Zapier, Retool) to ship quick wins without engineering support.

Description:
Location: Bangalore, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Thales India Engineering Competency Center in Bangalore is seeking a HW Test bench Lead- maintenance role.
In this role, you will manage Test Bench/ Automated Test Equipments maintenance and sustenance activities, which includes conducting scheduled maintenance procedure, inspecting, and troubleshooting test bench equipment.
These test benches primarily support various Thales defense applications and its products.

Essential skills:
Test Bench Hardware systems knowledge such as COTS Test and measurement instruments from different OEMs including NI Hardware including PXI systems, Industrial PC (PICMG SBC ) and VME systems.
5 +yrs Experience in handling various interface form factors such as PCI, PCIE, PCIe, CPCI, PXI, PXIe, VME etc.
Experience in Test Bench development or maintenance using COTS test measurement equipment, custom designed interface test adapters, PCBAs
Experience of testing avionics communication interfaces/buses such as MIL-STD-1553B, ARINC 429 , Serial RS 485 / 422, CAN etc is desirable.
Experience on interface cards such as Discrete IO, Analog, serial (RS232/422/482), synchro etc on various form factors listed above.
Problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
Experience in testing and knowledge of test equipment for measurement and control.
Hands on experience in handing various measuring tools such as Digital Oscilloscope, Function / wave generators up to 18GHz, Spectrum Analyzers, RF power meters etc.
Experience in analyzing / understanding electrical schematics, Cable Harness drawings and block diagrams.

Responsibilities:
As a maintenance engineer you will be responsible for undertaking periodic maintenance procedure and ensure the test system / bench are reliable.
Identify faults, efficiency and safety issues.
Respond to equipment breakdowns, provide first line diagnostic and arrange repairs or replacements.
Execute functional tests and validate the results against established standards
Perform quality inspections to ensure compliance with safety regulations.
Should work closely with multi discipline teams and organize to fix the issues.
Preparation of the associated report and log maintenance to keep track of tasks
Collaborative work applying quality standards and internal processes
Should be able to estimate and monitor costs of maintenance.

Job Description


Overview


Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.




Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


About you
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Management/Hydrology, with 8 to 15 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in 2D modelling using TUFLOW.
Significant experience with 1D-2D modelling using FMP-TUFLOW, ESTRY-TUFLOW, Infoworks ICM, especially with UK clients.
Build, refine and analyse hydraulic models (1D, 2D, and 1D2D) to represent river channels, floodplains, and potentially pipe networks.
Experience in leading flood modelling projects and managing a small team.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the production of Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for planning applications.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including QGIS, MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall fluvial model development process.
Experience in undertaking Flood Risk Assessments and developing drainage strategies.
Familiarity with FEH (Flood Estimation Handbook) methods.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.

Job Title: Circuit Design Engineer
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM
Job Summary
The Circuit Design Engineer will be responsible for designing and augmenting network circuits to support existing and new voice network connectivity. The role requires a good understanding of telecom network architecture, DS0/DS1/Ethernet circuits, POI connectivity, Network product requirements, and circuit inventory.
Key Responsibilities
Proficient in basic telecom and transmission concepts.
Good understanding of Transmission architecture and Network connectivity.
Design and augment DS0/DS1/Ethernet/IP circuitry for existing and new Customer /Network connectivity.
Translate network and transport requirements into appropriate circuit designs.
Review engineering requirements and validate circuit design information.
Coordinate with Planning, ASR, Implementation, Operations, and vendor teams for circuit provisioning.
Support new circuit installation, augmentation, migration, and disconnect activities.
Maintain accurate circuit and network inventory in Granite/XNG/PRO or applicable inventory systems.
Analyze network design issues and provide timely recommendations or solutions.
Maintain engineering documentation and update order/design status.
Support Customer Sales and network optimization activities when required.
Required Skills
Experience or good understanding of telecom circuit design.(SDH/SONET/WAVE)
Knowledge of DS0, DS1/T1,IP/Ethernet transport circuits, and Network architecture.
Understanding Network connectivity and circuit configurations.
Ability to interpret network diagrams, circuit information, and engineering requirements.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Microsoft Excel knowledge including PivotTables, formulas, and lookups.
Good to Have
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom inventory systems.
Understanding of Access Service Requests (ASR) and carrier provisioning.
Experience supporting network migrations, grooming, optimization, or decommissioning.
Power BI, VBA, Power Automate, Python, or other automation skills.

Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM
Job Summary
The ASR Engineer will be responsible for creating, submitting, tracking, and completing Access Service Requests with telecom carriers/LECs to support network provisioning requirements. The role requires good knowledge of carrier ordering processes, circuit configurations, and end-to-end ASR lifecycle management.

Create and submit Access Service Requests (ASRs) using carrier/LEC web portals.
Translate engineering and transport requirements into accurate ASR submissions.
Understand ASR ordering requirements for DS0, DS1/T1,Ethernet and Customer Circuits and associated access services.

Track submitted ASRs and follow up with carriers/LECs through completion.

Hands-on Access Service Request experience.
Knowledge of ASR ordering requirements and carrier/LEC processes.
Experience using LEC/carrier web ordering tools.(VFO)
Ability to translate network/transport requests into ASR submissions.
Knowledge of TDM and IP network circuit configurations.
Understanding of FOC, DLR, due dates, and carrier provisioning milestones.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Microsoft Excel knowledge, including PivotTables and formulas.
Good to Have
Experience with PRO/Flightdeck or similar telecom provisioning/inventory tools.
Knowledge of Telecom network architecture and planning.
Experience in carrier/vendor coordination.
Power BI, VBA, Power Automate, Python, or other automation skills.

The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.

Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.

Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.

Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.

 Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.

 Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Description:
About Us
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company and a pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution. Paytm builds technologies that empower small businesses with payments and commerce solutions.
Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy through technology.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer a world-class, frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups, including well-known unicorns. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler to a driver of revenue and growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI, and this team is responsible for growing penetration of Paytms PA–PG business across Indian merchants.

About the Role
Handle merchant escalations and resolve them on a high-priority basis. Proactively assist merchants to ensure timely and effective resolution of issues. Deliver exceptional merchant satisfaction through ownership and accountability of cases.

Key Responsibilities / Expectations
Resolve merchant complaints received through RBI, nodal officers, social media channels, or senior management escalations.
Understand the nature of each query, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and ensure resolution within defined TATs.
Prepare Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for escalations received.
Ensure adherence to agreed turnaround times to meet productivity and quality benchmarks.
Maintain high CSAT scores and ensure no repeat escalations for handled cases.
Demonstrate flexibility to work in rotational shifts.
Exhibit innovation and clarity in both written and verbal communication.

Description:
Job Title: Embedded UI Software Engineer
Experience: 4-9 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Embedded UI Software Engineer to design and develop graphical user interfaces for embedded products. The candidate should have strong expertise in Embedded C/C++, LVGL, TouchGFX, or similar embedded GUI frameworks, along with hands-on experience in ARM-based embedded systems.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop embedded graphical user interfaces using LVGL, TouchGFX, Embedded Wizard, Qt for MCU, or similar frameworks.
Develop UI applications for LCD/TFT touch displays on embedded platforms.
Integrate UI software with embedded platform services and device drivers.
Work on ARM Cortex-M based microcontrollers (STM32, NXP, ESP32, etc.).
Develop and debug embedded firmware using C/C++.
Support display, touch, communication, and peripheral interfaces.
Collaborate with hardware, firmware, validation, and product teams.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and product releases.
Mandatory Skills
4-6 years of Embedded Software Development experience.
Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C++.
Experience with LVGL (mandatory preferred).
Hands-on experience with TouchGFX, GUIX, emWin, Embedded Wizard, Qt/QML, or similar Embedded GUI frameworks.
Experience with ARM Cortex-M platforms (STM32/NXP).
Experience in RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX, VxWorks, or Embedded Linux).
Knowledge of Display Technologies, LCD/TFT Touchscreens, HMI Development.
Experience with UART, SPI, I2C, CAN communication protocols.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.

ASU - Forensics - Discovery :
Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. Support in overall growth and development of regulatory compliance practice.

We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Title
EY - GDS GRC Technology Oracle GRC- Staff
Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too.
Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The Opportunity
We're looking for people with expertise in Oracle GRC Staff Consultant to join our EY-GDS GRC Technology Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.
Your Key Responsibilities
Reviews materials and supports in meetings and workshops with business stakeholders to understand and gather business / functional requirements, undertaking client assessments and building relationships with business stakeholders.
Builds relationships and collaborates with the wider team to understand business requirements and translates these into complex technical requirements.
Produces technical specifications to guide system architectural design and development and conducts quality assurance tasks to ensure completeness of requirements, peer reviewing the work of more junior members of the team.
Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and forms recommendations for system and technical components based on understanding of business requirements, reviewing and supporting with process modelling and improvement.
Contributes to the design and review of test cases to ensure tests adequately meet the requirements and coordinates with infrastructure and operations teams to resolve system issues, contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project.
Provides insights on whether solutions and technologies being implemented are meeting business requirements.
Contributes to business case development and completes RFP responses, exploring and experimenting with new and existing data to tackle defined business problems.
Skills and attributes for success
Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.
Proven experience developing technical requirements and specifications, including knowledge of software engineering methodologies, reporting tools, modelling and testing.
Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.
Ideally, you'll also
Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 1 to 3 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:
Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
System role-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.
Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions.
Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
Some stakeholder management experience.
Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre-requisite.
Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power-point presentations is highly desirable.
Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) & Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer you
At EY, we will develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences.

Job Summary
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.


Role Title
EY- Assurance Senior Associate


The Opportunity
We're looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.


Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.


Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.


To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.


Ideally, youll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.


What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization
Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP
Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook.
Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.

2. Production Planning & Control
Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.

3. Material Planning & MRP
Existing responsibilities plus:
Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:
Lead times
Lot sizes
Safety stocks
Reorder levels
MOQ
Supplier lead times
Planning horizons
Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

4. Procurement & Supplier Management
Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.

5. Inventory Management
Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
Drive reduction of:
Excess inventory
Obsolete inventory
Slow-moving inventory
Uncontrolled WIP
Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes.
Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity.

6. Warehouse & Logistics
Existing responsibilities plus:
Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations.
Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production.
Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable.
Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials.
Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability.
Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments
Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes.
Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site.
Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch.

Support implementation of traceability systems.
Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements.
Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions.
Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions.
Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions.
7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain

Job Title: Semi Technical Customer Support Associate

Locations: Pune / Noida

Experience: 6 Months – 5 Years
Process: Semi Technical Voice Customer Support
Work Model: 100% Work from Office
Process Type: US Process
Shift: Night Shifts Only
Working Days: 5 Days Working | 2 Rotational Offs
Training: No leaves allowed during training

Job Summary

We are hiring Semi Technical Customer Support Associates for our US Voice Process in Pune and Noida.

The ideal candidate should have excellent English communication skills, strong customer service abilities, and basic technical troubleshooting knowledge. The candidate should be comfortable working in a high-volume customer support environment and willing to work in night shifts.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle inbound and outbound customer interactions through voice support.
* Resolve customer queries, complaints, and basic technical issues effectively.
* Troubleshoot basic to intermediate technical issues using available knowledge bases.
* Provide accurate information and appropriate resolutions to customers.
* Handle approximately 40–50 calls per shift while maintaining service quality.
* Document customer interactions, resolutions, and follow-up actions in CRM/ticketing tools.
* Escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate teams as per process guidelines.
* Coordinate with internal teams for timely issue resolution.
* Maintain professionalism, empathy, and a customer-focused approach.
* Follow company policies, compliance requirements, and operational procedures.
* Maintain required productivity, quality, attendance, and schedule adherence.
* Candidates must be comfortable working on Indian holidays.

Key Performance Metrics

Candidates will be measured on:

* AHT – Average Handle Time
* CSAT / CCR – Customer Satisfaction
* FCR – First Call Resolution
* Quality Score
* Schedule Adherence
* Attendance & Productivity

Salary

* 6–12 Months Experience: Up to 4.5 LPA
* 12–18 Months Experience: Up to 5 LPA
* 18+ Months Experience: Up to 6 LPA

Important: Salary will be offered with a maximum 25% hike on the candidate’s last drawn salary, subject to eligibility and company norms.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.
* Basic technical troubleshooting knowledge.
* Good listening and analytical abilities.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Experience with CRM/ticketing tools is preferred.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable handling high-volume calls.
* Basic typing skills.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Willingness to work in night shifts.

Eligibility

* Graduate / Undergraduate candidates can apply.
* Minimum 6 months of relevant experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, Contact Center, Voice Process, or Technical Support.
* Overall experience considered: 6 months to 5 years.
* Candidates should have a proven ability to meet productivity and SLA targets.
* Strong customer-centric approach.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with experience in international voice customer support / technical support.
* Experience handling US customers will be an added advantage.
* Comfortable working in a high-pressure, target-driven environment.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Team player with a professional and customer-focused approach.

Important Information

Location: Pune / Noida Sector 62
Work Mode: Work from Office – 100%
Shift: Night Shift – US Process
Working: 5 Days Working | 2 Rotational Offs
Training: No leaves during training
Process: Semi Technical Voice Customer Support

OCM Lead Consultant
Location: EMEA / USA / India
Job Summary
The OCM (Organizational Change Management) Lead Consultant is responsible for leading change management, training, and communication activities associated with enterprise-wide transformation programs, including ERP/HRIS implementations and organizational transitions.
This role focuses on the people side of change, helping organizations successfully adopt new processes, technologies, job roles, and organizational structures. The objective is to minimize resistance, maximize engagement, and drive successful adoption of transformational initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement
Develop and execute structured change management strategies, communication plans, and training programs to support organizational transformation.
Conduct change impact assessments and identify stakeholder groups affected by change.
Develop stakeholder maps and engagement plans to effectively manage client audiences.
Identify potential sources of resistance and implement mitigation strategies to encourage positive acceptance of change.
Build, mobilize, and manage change champion/change agent networks to accelerate adoption.
Training & Adoption
Design and implement role-based training strategies and learning programs.
Create employee orientation and onboarding plans related to new business processes and technologies.
Collaborate with client teams and Learning & Development stakeholders to create detailed training schedules and participant plans.
Work closely with Training/Learning Leads to ensure successful training delivery and adoption.
Program Execution & Leadership
Monitor change management and training activities and provide regular status updates.
Adapt change strategies as organizational needs evolve.
Lead and manage large-scale OCM teams consisting of junior, mid-level, and senior consultants.
Ensure alignment of change, communication, and training activities for a seamless end-user experience.
Best Practices & Methodology
Apply industry-leading change management methodologies and frameworks.
Integrate communication, training, and change interventions into a unified adoption strategy.
Recommend and implement best practices to improve transformation outcomes.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM).
Experience supporting large-scale organizational transformation programs.
Digital Transformation implementation experience is highly desirable.
Experience working with global teams, offshore (India) teams, and international client stakeholders.
Change Management Expertise
Strong understanding of organizational change principles and change adoption processes.
Experience with ADKAR methodology.
PROSCI Certification preferred.
CCMP (Certified Change Management Professional) certification is a plus.
Project & Delivery Knowledge
Understanding of software implementation lifecycles and project management methodologies, including:
SDLC
Waterfall
Agile
Core Competencies
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders at all organizational levels.
Ability to drive alignment toward a common vision and business goal.
Preferred Candidate Profile
OCM Lead / Change Management Consultant with experience in ERP, HRIS, or Digital Transformation programs.
Experience leading large change initiatives in global organizations.
Skilled in stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, training strategy, and adoption management.
Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams and client-facing engagements.

Locations: Mumbai/ Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad/Noida/Gurugram

Job Description
We are looking for a Agentic AI Developer with 2+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and deploying intelligent, autonomous AI agents that can plan, reason, and act toward achieving complex goals. This role blends expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and orchestration frameworks to build systems that go beyond static responses enabling dynamic, goal-driven behaviour.
Key responsibilities
Build autonomous agents using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and CrewAI that can plan, reason, and execute tasks iteratively.
Integrate and fine-tune LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, LLaMA) for use in agent workflows, including prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Develop systems where multiple agents collaborate, delegate tasks, and adapt strategies based on real-time feedback.
Enable agents to interact with external systems (e.g., APIs, databases, web apps) to perform actions autonomously.
Use tools like LangSmith, Grafana, and Splunk to monitor agent behavior, performance, and reliability.
Work closely with data scientists, architects, and product teams to align agentic solutions with business goals.
Ensure all solutions are well-documented and comply with data privacy and security standards.
Technical Skills
Languages: Python (mandatory), JavaScript, C# (optional)
Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Hugging Face Transformers
LLMs: GPT-4, GPT- 4o, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral, Gemini
Vector Databases: FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate
Cloud Platforms: Azure (OpenAI, ML Studio), AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker), GCP (Vertex AI)
DevOps & CI/CD: Git, Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes
Monitoring Tools: LangSmith, Grafana, Splunk
Other Tools: Streamlit, FastAPI, Flask for UI/API development
Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field
213 years of experience in AI/ML development, with at least 12 years in Gen AI or Agentic AI
Strong understanding of autonomous systems, planning algorithms, and multi-agent coordination
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

Knowledge of Data Warehouse concepts, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact and Dimension tables.
Experience with databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Teradata, or Snowflake.
Strong understanding of Data Migration and Data Validation techniques.
Hands-on experience with defect tracking tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps.
Understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.
Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Big Data Testing using Hadoop, Hive, Spark, or Databricks.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience in testing data lakes and modern data platforms.
Knowledge of automation tools for ETL validation.
Familiarity with BI reporting tools like Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or Business Objects.
Experience with Python or Shell scripting for data validation.

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Job Summary
The Role: Lead Software Engineer (Data Engineer)
The Team: We are looking for a junior Data Engineer to join our offshore team in India. This role is focused on supporting data onboarding, pipeline support, and basic platform activities. You will work under the guidance of senior team members to assist with routine tasks related to data pipelines, integrations, and cloud-native data platform operations. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role suitable for someone starting their career in data engineering or looking to develop core skills in a modern data platform environment leveraging AWS.


Responsibilities

Data Onboarding & Support
Assist in onboarding new data assets to the enterprise platform following established procedures.
Support existing data pipelines by monitoring, troubleshooting, and performing routine maintenance.
Help ensure data quality and consistency during onboarding and ongoing operations.
Follow documented processes and checklists to support data ingestion and transformation tasks.
Support data storage and processing using Amazon S3 as the core cloud storage layer, ensuring data is organized, secure, and accessible.
Support metadata management and data cataloging using AWS Glue Data Catalog to facilitate discoverability and governance.
Assist in implementing data validation, quality checks, and lineage documentation.
Write and maintain Python scripts and Big data processing engines transformations for data ingestion, processing, and automation tasks.


Platform & Pipeline Maintenance
Support the team in maintaining data pipelines, fixing issues, and implementing small enhancements.
Assist with data validation, metadata tagging, and basic lineage documentation.
Help monitor pipeline health and escalate issues as needed.
Support operational activities such as deployment, testing, and routine monitoring.
Contribute to automation of deployment and operational workflows using AWS CloudFormation, or similar tools.


Collaboration & Documentation
Work with senior engineers to understand platform standards and best practices.
Document onboarding steps, pipeline configurations, and operational procedures.
Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders about progress and issues.


Operational Support
Participate in production incident response and troubleshooting.
Support routine deployment, testing, and monitoring activities.
Contribute to team knowledge sharing and documentation efforts.


Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in data engineering, data support, or related roles.
Basic knowledge of SQL, Python, and Big data processing engines.
Hands-on experience with programming in Python or similar languages for data processing and automation.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Databricks or similar.
Understanding of data onboarding, data quality, metadata, and lineage concepts.
Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue Data Catalog, AWS IAM, and AWS CloudWatch.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.


Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to data pipelines, data onboarding, or data migration projects.
Knowledge of Delta Lake, Iceberg, or similar storage formats.
Basic understanding of data governance and security principles.
Any relevant certifications or training in data engineering or AWS.

Job Purpose


This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.
Engage with channel partners to build and strengthen relationship. Build distribution for Rural consumer Product Finance and distribution mapping for Rural consumer Product Finance.




Achieving exceeding Business goals and targets for Consumer Durables -Creating a strong compliant sales culture to drive acquisitions, profitability and employee development-Manage the Distribution through Dealer relations and servicing the Dealers, and their concerns in an appropriate manner.-Managing the Delinquency of the business sourced to ensure health of portfolio
-Effectively engage Operations Risk teams to understand and contribute to overall processes profitability across locations
-Identifying the need of sales training, analyzing changing market trends, channel deployment etc. Also giving feedback suggestions to the RSM/NSM -Ensure implementation of promotional plans contests and suggesting new and innovating promotion plan for the area of work.-Recruiting and Retaining high performers. -Ensuring highest levels of employee relationship, motivation engagement to drive results high levels of employee satisfaction.-Supporting collections team in ensuring 100% collections MAJOR CHALLENGES:
-struggling to find and keep talented employees. -Customer always seeking the latest technology, most efficient service, instant gratification, and a customized experience. -Retaining employees as they have banking sector as an option available.
-Online Market as well effected / impacted in filed. DECISIONS ; -Implement a sales management process that guides the teams decision on how to effectively manage this time and decide who to spend with. -Connect with field Teams Spending the Maximum time to Our Team. Link performance with rewards and recognition as par their achievement. -Design and Develop a Customer (Dealer and Business Partners) Visit frequency plan for their field. INTERACTIONS: Internal Clients:Roles you need to interact with inside the organization to enable success in your day to day work -Provide market and product related feedback to HO (Managers / Senior hierarchy )-Credit Team for high ticket approvals -Operation for customer services and file disbursement -Risk team for approval declined cases due to specific reasons e.g. policy-FCU Team for fraud cases validation -Collections for bucket cases and FEMI cases or problematic cases External Clients: Roles you need to interact with outside the organization to enable success in your day to day work:External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales by Achieving Origination Targets. ASSC (Authorized Sales Service Center), Serving the existing external walk in customers at dealers and Increasing business opportunities.




a)Qualifications :
-Graduation / Post graduation
-Strong analytical skills to drive channel performance and drive profitability
-People Relationship Management skills
-Excellent Communication and Negotiation Skill
b)Work Experience:
-Graduation / Post graduation with 4 to 6 years and MBA with 3-4 years of relevant experience in sales

Financial Dimensions

-In Festive seasons minimum 15k cases in a quarter
-Normal days minimum 9K cases in a quarter
-Cross sell targets 650 IPC to be maintained

Total Team Size: 29
Number of Direct Reports: 6

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow thebusiness and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

To drive secondary sales and act as interface between distributor and retailers and increase market share for our product at end user
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Financial

Seeking ASMs counsel for resolving retailer/distributor complaints
Internal Business Process

Checking product availability & range and ensuring product visibility & merchandising utilization at Retail outlets
Ensuring demand creation through product sampling for NPDs / Focus Articles and sharing the demand information with distributors and ASMs
Ensuring retailer awareness on company products and trade promotions through market visits, catalogues / leaflets etc.
Driving distributor to purchase articles with market demand and enhancing range selling

Description:
MEGA HIRING DRIVE | TELEPERFORMANCE
International Customer Support Executive Voice | Chat | Email

Company: Teleperformance
Job Role: International Customer Support Executive
Job Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan
Work Mode: Work From Office
Process: International Voice / Chat / Email
Hiring: Freshers & Experienced Candidates
Working Days: 5 Days Working
Shifts: Rotational Shifts
Week Offs: Rotational Week Offs
Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY
Looking for an exciting career opportunity in the International BPO industry? Teleperformance is hiring enthusiastic and customer-focused candidates for International Customer Support operations.
We are inviting applications from candidates across PAN India who are interested in working in Jaipur. Whether you are a fresher looking to start your professional journey or an experienced candidate looking for career growth, this is an excellent opportunity to develop your skills and work with international customers.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES
Handle international customer queries through Voice, Chat and Email support channels, depending on the assigned process.
Assist customers with service-related queries, complaints, account concerns and general support requirements.
Manage inbound customer calls professionally and provide accurate information and effective resolutions.
Respond to customer queries through live chat and email while maintaining professional communication.
Ensure excellent customer experience through active listening, empathy and a customer-centric approach.
Handle customer complaints, escalations and follow-ups within defined turnaround times.
Maintain customer records, update internal systems and follow process guidelines.
Demonstrate strong problem-solving, multitasking and customer-handling skills.
Maintain quality standards and contribute towards customer satisfaction and customer delight.

PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE
Excellent English communication skills are mandatory.
Freshers with strong English communication skills can apply.
Undergraduate candidates with a minimum of 6 months of documented BPO / Customer Support experience can apply.
Graduates and postgraduates from any stream are eligible.
Candidates with International BPO, Voice Process, Chat Support, Email Support and Customer Service experience will be preferred.
Basic computer knowledge and good typing skills.
Strong interpersonal skills, problem-solving abilities and a customer-focused attitude.
Comfortable working in rotational shifts and rotational week-offs.
Must be willing to relocate to Jaipur and work from the office.

EXCITING RELOCATION BENEFITS & FACILITIES
710 Days Complimentary Hotel Accommodation for eligible outstation candidates.
10,000 Relocation Bonus as per company policy.
Travel Ticket Assistance for eligible candidates relocating to Jaipur.
Free Cab Facility as per process and shift eligibility.
Five Days Working.
Professional training and development opportunities.
Career growth opportunities in Quality Analyst, SME, Team Leader and Operations roles, subject to performance and eligibility.
Applicable employee benefits and performance-based incentives as per company policy.

PAN-INDIA HIRING – JAIPUR LOCATION
Candidates from all over India are welcome to apply!
We are sourcing candidates from Delhi NCR, Gurgaon, Noida, Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Kota, Ajmer, Lucknow, Kanpur, Indore, Bhopal, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, Dehradun, Patna, Ranchi, Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kochi and other cities across India.

Important: Candidates must be willing to relocate to Jaipur. This is a Work From Office opportunity.
APPLY NOW!
An excellent opportunity to begin or advance your career in the International Customer Support industry with Teleperformance.

KEYWORDS: International BPO, International Voice Process, International Chat Support, International Email Support, Customer Support Executive, Customer Service Representative, Customer Experience Associate, Inbound Calling, Non-Voice Process, Customer Query Resolution, Customer Delight, Complaint Handling, US Process, UK Process, BPO Jobs Jaipur, Freshers Jobs, Customer Care Executive, International Process Executive.

Job Description (JD)
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit
Location: Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai & Bangalore
Function: Governance, Risk and Compliance Services (GRCS) Department: Risk Consulting
Role Overview
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit will be responsible for managing and executing internal audit, risk consulting and process improvement engagements across multiple industries. The role involves leading project teams, managing client relationships, ensuring quality deliverables, supporting business development activities and contributing to the growth of the GRCS practice
Key Responsibilities
A. Internal Audit & Risk Advisory
Lead risk-based internal audits, process audits and risk consulting engagements.
Conduct Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and risk assessments.
Evaluate business processes, identify operational risks and assess internal controls.
Perform SOX 404, Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and regulatory compliance reviews.
Identify control gaps and recommend process improvements and risk mitigation measures.
Execute control self-assessments, revenue assurance and continuous monitoring activities.
B. Project Management & Execution
Manage multiple internal audit and risk consulting projects simultaneously.
Lead project teams and oversee project planning, execution and delivery.
Ensure project quality, profitability and adherence to timelines and budgets.
Report project progress and key risks to the Director / Partner.
Act as the primary client contact throughout project execution.
C. Client & Stakeholder Management
Manage client relationships and understand business requirements.
Conduct stakeholder discussions and management presentations.
Communicate audit findings, control gaps and recommendations.
Support clients in implementing corrective actions and process improvements.
D. Team Management & Leadership
Supervise, coach and mentor junior team members.
Review team deliverables and ensure quality standards.
Conduct training and support team capability development.
Manage team performance and promote effective collaboration.
E. Business Development & Practice Growth
Identify business opportunities and contribute to lead generation and deal closure.
Support proposals, pre-sales activities and RFP responses.
Identify cross-selling opportunities across KPMG service lines.
Contribute to revenue growth and client relationship development.
F. Thought Leadership
Contribute to developing new solutions and service offerings.
Participate in knowledge management and practice development initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory developments and emerging risks.
3. Key Service Offerings
Risk-Based Internal Audit
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Risk Assessment
Business Process Consulting
SOX 404 and Internal Financial Controls (IFC)
Regulatory and Contractual Compliance
Corporate Governance Advisory
Revenue Assurance and Control Self-Assessment
Continuous Auditing / Monitoring
Accounting Manuals Development
Capital Projects Audits
Project-Focused Control Assessment
Setting Up Internal Audit Functions
4. Educational Qualifications
- MBA / Chartered Accountant (CA)
Preferred Certifications:
CIA Certified Internal Auditor
CISA Certified Information Systems Auditor
CPA Certified Public Accountant
CMA Certified Management Accountant
ACCA Association of Chartered Certified Accountants

*Role: Business Development / Expansion Role – OYO (Field Profile)*

• Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals

• Review agreements and service levels with property owners
• Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

• Number of sellable rooms signed every month
• Number of rooms made live and available for booking
• Gross margin generated from signed properties

• Graduation mandatory

• 1–5 years of relevant experience
• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
• Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
• Analytical and data-driven mindset
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
• Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
• Good Excel skills and professional email writing

*Internal:*
• Business Development Head
• Hub Head
• Central Team
• Operations Team
• Transformation Team
• Legal Team
*External:*
• Property Owners

*In simple words:*
Your role is to *find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable*.

Description:
Roles and Responsibilities :
Ensure accurate tracking, reconciliation, and security of all cash deposit and electronic payments received during regular operation in hospital
Strict internal controls to prevent fraud, coordinates with banking partners, and ensures all related actions to be completed as per compliance
Oversee the counting, verification, and reconciliation of all daily cash deposit, credit card collections from hospital point-of-sale (POS)
Audit and resolve if any cash variances and take action immediately, escalating systemic issues to the Finance head
Train hospital staff on proper cash handling, point-of-collection patient billing
Prepare weekly and monthly cash deposit reports, variance analysis, and transaction logs for senior leadership
Role to play as primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders and also required to handle financial audits regarding hospital revenue collections
Implement and enforce strict separation of duties and financial compliance measures to mitigate fraud risks
Proper duty assignment to team members for Day-Night support
MIS, Presentations & Conducting Review Meetings
Responsible for managing various transformation projects, new process transition support and control checks associated to delivery
Establish individual goals and deliver against the same as per defined service delivery framework and quality processes
 Good analytical/Digital mind set and communication skill with customers and stakeholder handling experience will be preferred
Responsible for resource utilization, productivity, process performance and quality.
Establish team as well as individual goals and deliver against the same as per defined service delivery framework and quality processes
Ensuring Regular Governance in place (Internal & External Governance Meeting with teams and Business)
Need to have functional proficiency and specialized knowledge for own areas of responsibility, fair understanding of end-to-end process and IT systems supporting the same

Job Requirements 
Functional Knowledge of Skills (Must Have)
Proficiency in data management and treasury operation, Good interpersonal skills, Flexible with Job duties, Cash/Collection management and resolve settlement issue
Leadership Behavior
Risk Taking, Accountability, Collaboration
Educational Qualification
MBA - Finance/B.COM.
 Technical Skill required
SAP, MS Office, Advance Excel, GST Knowledge
Language Proficiency
English & Hindi
Experience Required
5 Yrs (Preferred in Cash office – Hospital

About the role:
To sell products or services for a company and represent their brand. Also, to manage relationships with customers, serving as the key point of contact, from initial lead outreach to when a purchase is ultimately made.

If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you.
