Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable. Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the financial performance in areas of responsibility. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Ensures compliance with all food & beverage policies, standards and procedures by training, supervising, follow-up and hands on management.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meets the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Acts as the guest service role model for the restaurants, sets a good example of excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of entry to departure (e.g., greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food and beverage delivery, fulfillment of special requests, collection of payment & invitation to return).
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably. Strives to improve employee retention.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Assistant Restaurant Manager.
- Oversees the financial aspects of the department including purchasing and payment of invoices.

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English

Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
We work in collaboration with State Education Departments to bring reform by implementing large-scale system-led projects, with the goal of improving foundational learning (FLN) outcomes in students. Our team supports the State in designing and implementing an integrated program that encompasses multiple aspects of a reform process - ranging from designing effective classroom pedagogy to building salience and state capacity to deliver FLN at scale, while also strengthening governance and other critical enablers. Room to Read has partnered with the Education Department of Jharkhand on a long-term engagement for system reform and a demonstration program in selected districts.


Responsibilities
The Program Associate will be responsible for the intervention in his / her district and will have the following specific key roles and responsibilities:


Program Understanding
Develop a thorough understanding of Room to Read s Literacy program design and Project Deliverables
S/he has good awareness of Foundational Literacy and Numeracy programs, their design and strategies operating in project region.
Develop a strong understanding of Govt s education policies NEP, NCF, FLN, SIQE, Mission Ankur etc.


On-ground Implementation and Monitoring
Support the quality implementation of the project in the district and blocks, ensuring timely, efficient, and well-coordinated implementation, adhering to the program and budget guidelines.
Complete higher frequency of regular visits to program schools, observe classroom transactions, speak to teachers and head masters and make suggestions for improving quality and utilization of these materials.
Support District Lead collating collated from the field to further communicate the same to SO and CO for necessary changes in the pedagogy and material.
Support in analyzing various data and information emanating from the field, develop programmatic co- relations and flag off issues for a larger discussion.
Participate in any other activities which may be required to be undertaken to fulfil the objectives of the organization.
Support effective utilization of program budget through proper planning and tracking of planned activities. Ensure that financial and procurement norms are adhered to, and efforts are made to reduce cost to the extent possible, without compromising on the quality.
Track program progress on key indicators according to the ME framework during monthly meetings and throughout the project timeline.
Participate actively on social media in all Room to Read (RtR) campaigns.
Stay updated and share this knowledge with the District Lead regarding new programs/interventions of the like-minded organizations in district.
Identify operational bottlenecks and weaknesses, wherever applicable and come up with solutions for the same in consultation with District Lead.
Support the District Lead in the execution of the Project by leading all technical tasks in the district focused on capacity building of stakeholders across all levels (District, Block, Cluster and Schools), support uptake of materials, and establish coordination with various stakeholders at the district level to sustain the impact and interventions from the program.


Government Liaison and Technical Support
Support District Lead in participation of technical assistance discussions at the district level.
Attend government meetings, discussions and committees on foundational literacy as well as Numeracy and use those forums to advocate for enabling policies and government orders in support of RtR literacy program.
Interact with key stakeholders (government departments and officials such as CDEO/ADPC/DEEO/RPs/DIET etc.) as recommended by the District Lead to ensure delivery of program objectives and explore opportunities for systemic integration.
Conduct discussions with stakeholders at multiple levels across the districts reflecting on the insights collated via field visits, monitoring data and interactions to formulate the way forward for the month.


Participation in Meetings/Workshops at State and INCO Level
Participate in IDTS workshops on material development, training module development and training of trainers.
Attend review meetings at the state/national level and provide reflective feedback on program implementation and design issues. At the same time acts as the conduit for transferring innovative ideas and practices from the national level (or from other states) on to the field.


Planning, Reporting and Documentation
Support District Lead for preparing regular (monthly, quarterly, and yearly basis, including program data) qualitative reports and documenting event reports, case studies and best practices.
Support and ensure all data entry and compilation on monthly, quarterly and yearly basis, including GSD, Dashboard data, maintaining high levels of data quality.
Develop actionable insights through analyses of data collected via monitoring visits to further inform the project implementation.
Assist for preparing Implementation calendar, cash forecast, PRs budget outlook, APB and regular tracking of budget management.


Qualifications

Required
Master s degree in education / social sciences or equivalent preferred.
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in the education sector.
In-depth knowledge on foundational literacy, language and reading practices and approaches.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Critical thinking and analytical skills.
Proven track record of achieving results.
Proven ability to work effectively with schools and communities.
Ability to travel regularly to project sites in remote locations.


Preferred
Able to design google forms, sheets, sites, dashboard etc.
Data analysis through advance excel, SPSS etc.
Development of short videos
Able to design workshops session plan.
Able to lead facilitation in workshop for internal team, teachers and officers etc.
Able to design modules, feedback forms, questionnaire, etc.

Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.


Job Summary
Position Overview: The Associate will supports technology adoption, EdTech pilots, and on-ground program delivery for the Prevail Fund Jharkhand Foundational Literacy Program (SFLP) in Jharkhand. The role also feeds into the wider Jharkhand State Project Management Unit (SPMU) technology agenda. The role sits close to field cadres and program teams. It will be a cross functional role involving you moving between a training hall, a school, and a spreadsheet in the same week. This role turns technology into action on the ground: configuring the LMS, running pilots, listening to users, and closing the gap between what a tool promises and what a CRP or teacher actually experiences in the field. This position requires frequent travel and will report to District Lead.
About the Edtech Function in Prevail-Jharkhand: Room to Read uses a blended training framework (Online + Offline) to train and certify field cadres (Program Field Coordinator, Program Associate, Program Officer, District Lead) across multiple districts. The program also testing new EdTech and AI tools to support teacher training, coaching, and classroom practice.


Responsibilities
LMS Management: Manage day-to-day use of the Jharkhand LMS instance for field cadre training and certification.
Set up courses, quiz banks, and completion tracking for each training module.
Coordinate with the Room to Read India LMS administrator for platform changes and upgrades.
Troubleshoot access and login issues for learners and facilitators.
EdTech Pilots and AI App Testing: Coordinate the testing of AI applications and EdTech tools proposed for the Jharkhand program.
Plan and run field pilots from setup through review: install the tool, train the users, observe use, and record results.
Flag technical issues and usability problems to the EdTech Lead and the tool developer.
User Research and Feedback: Plan and conduct user interviews with teachers, CRPs, Master Trainers, and other field cadres.
Collect feedback on the Moodle platform, training content, and EdTech pilots.
Turn raw feedback into clear, short insights the Edtech team can act on.
Use Case Landscaping: Map where technology is already used, and where it could help, across the Prevail Jharkhand project: training, coaching, monitoring, and libraries.
Keep a shared, up-to-date use-case map for the project team.
Flag priority use cases for the EdTech Lead to take forward.
Creation of mockups and prototypes using AI and other design tools
Field and Program Support: Give on-ground support to program staff and government cadres in multiple districts.
Join field visits with the District Lead, CRPs, and Master Trainers as needed.
Support the rollout of training sessions, TLM (Teaching and Learning Material) distribution, and monitoring tools at the school and cluster level.
Technology Facilitation: Act as the first point of contact for field staff questions about LMS, apps, and other digital tools.
Run short orientation sessions on new tools for field cadres.
Write simple, step-by-step guides for tools and workflows.
Reporting and Documentation: Keep clear records of pilot activities, interview notes, and platform issues.
Contribute EdTech updates to monthly and quarterly program reports.
Keep the projects knowledge base current on EdTech status and open issues.


Qualifications
Graduate degree in education, social sciences, computer applications, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in EdTech, LMS administration, or field program support.
Comfort with frequent field travel as needed across multiple districts.
Basic troubleshooting skills with mobile apps and digital tools.
Experience with qualitative research methods, such as user interviews and feedback collection.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English and Hindi.


Preferred
Working knowledge of Moodle or another LMS platform.
Prior experience in the education or development sector.
Exposure to AI tools used in education or training delivery.
Experience working with government education cadres (CRPs, BRPs, Master Trainers) or community-level stakeholders.

Title: Business Development Executive \ Field sales apprentice role
Location: Ranchi (Retail Store Based)
Job Type: Full\-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics \/ Retail \/ FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store\-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast\-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
\- Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
\- Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
\- Conduct in\-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
\- Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
\- Support retail partners with business development strategies and on\-ground execution
\- Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
\- Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass\-out)
\- Freshers are encouraged to apply
\- Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
\- Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
\- Personal two\-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
\- Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty\/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
\- Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
\- Work Schedule: 6 days a week
\- Weekly Off: Sunday
\- Work Type: Retail store\-based with regular local market visits

Benefits
\- Fixed salary: \\u20b911,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 in hand)
\- Daily TA\/DA: \\u20b9200
\- Attractive performance\-based incentives

Description:
Territory-Specific Responsibilities
Drive Cummins aftermarket channel sales across the Bihar and Jharkhand region.
Lead dealer teams to improve per-engine revenue and overall business performance.
Drive sales campaigns, promotional activities, and business growth initiatives through dealer networks.
Act as the key interface between Cummins and customers to ensure superior customer experience and satisfaction.
Manage strategic key accounts, including large industrial and mining customers such as Tata Steel, Thriveni Earthmovers, and other major private mining customers.


Education, Licenses, Certifications:
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Sales, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant sales experience.
Export control or sanctions-related licensing may be required depending on business requirements.

Skills & Experience
Intermediate level of relevant sales or business development experience.
Proven experience in territory sales, account management, or channel sales.
Experience managing dealer networks and driving aftermarket business is preferred.
Strong customer relationship management and key account management skills.
Experience handling commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, and contract execution.
Ability to analyze sales data, forecast demand, and manage sales pipelines effectively.
Working knowledge of CRM systems and sales management tools.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams.
Experience in industrial, automotive, heavy equipment, mining, or related sectors will be an added advantage.

Apart from above pre-requisites, the candidate will have responsibility of below points:-
Driving Cummins after-market channel sales in Bihar & Jharkhand Region
Leading dealer team for improving per Engine revenue
Leading dealer team for running sales campaigns and business initiatives
Ensuring Customer satisfaction by acting as a bridge between Cummins and Customer
Key account management of big ticket customers, such as Tata Steel, Thriveni Earthmovers, Private mining customers etc

Description:
Job Responsibility

1. Grievance handling for all bargainable employees:
Interact with employees to identify and effectively resolve all issues
Effective predicting of issues that pose a threat to smooth functioning of organization & prioritize accordingly
Prevent employee grievances from turning into bigger IR issues that can hamper production
Conduct regular meetings like IRC (Industrial Relations Committee) to capture all employee grievances.
2. Ensure maintenance of Internal Discipline:
Ensure that there is good understanding & acceptance for all rules and regulations mandated by the Management.
Take necessary preventive actions and measures of counselling wherever necessary
Take necessary disciplinary actions wherever required to ensure harmonious and productive environment on the shop floor.
Lead Quality Circle, SDT, improvement projects.
Ensure Statutory Compliance of the factory he/she is responsible for : Monitoring Statutory compliances such as ESI,PF, Minimum wages, maternity benefit, Bonus Act & Submission of returns
3. Liaise with employees, Union Leaders, line managers, divisional heads & factory heads:
Work closely with line managers for improvement in production, interacts with shop supervisors, managers, function heads.
Implement long term settlements, wage negotiations clauses, Bonus settlements, union elections and other critical items as and when they are due & manage industrial relations.
Provide inputs to the ER head for preparing management demands.
Provide cross-functional support to administration, communication and productivity services, safety team.
Resolve ER issues at the plant level striving for no/minimum loss to business/ corporate image.
Maintain cordial relations with all stake holders in order to ensure smooth functioning on the shop floor.
Implement location level ER priorities in consultation with Factory Head, Shop heads & ER Head.
Identify risks and opportunities in the respective factory location and put in place plans to mitigate the same.
4. Drive initiatives to motivate bargainable employees:
Identify and implement welfare activities including sports for blue collar workers in line with organizational guidelines
Organize regular Reward & Recognition functions like the long service awards
Plan and organize various family events or departmental picnics.
Be responsible for a set of employees in shop/area for engagement, growth, recognition,
Self –Directed teams , SQDCME (Safety / Quality/ Delivery/ Cost/ Morale and Environment)
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal
Employees: Regular Liaising & proactive IR
Block Union Representatives / Line Managers/Divisional Heads/Factory Heads : Regular Interaction and communication for smooth functioning.
Shared services, Construction, Safety, Administration, Medical: To assist workmen in resolving their grievances
ER Team: Regular Interaction between factories for good flow of management ideas.
External
Labour Department & Government Agencies: For Statutory Requirements
Industry Associations: Participation in industry associations and forums related to Industrial Relations to stay informed about trends, regulations, and emerging practices.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education : Post Graduate in Human Resources.
Relevant Experience : 5+ years of experience in HR / ER with exposure to handling blue collared workers extensively.
Skills & Competencies
Business Acumen
Change Management
Conflict Management
Influencing Skills
Labour Relations
Strategy & Risk Management
Stakeholder Management

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

SUMMARY
Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. This position demands consistent performance, proactive engagement, and a hands-on approach to achieve and exceed sales targets. The ideal candidate will conduct daily site visits, maintain a strong presence at assigned retail outlets, organize shop meetings, and ensure accurate reporting all contributing to enhanced market penetration and brand visibility. With a focus on customer-centric strategies and performance excellence, this role is essential to sustaining growth and strengthening market position across the assigned territories.

Vijayanagar
Kanakapura Road
Konanakunte
Kolar
Devanahalli
Sarjapur
Whitefield

Responsibilities:
Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets consistently.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key stakeholders.
Conduct site visits per day to identify new opportunities and support customer needs.
Dedicate at least two hours daily to on-site presence at assigned retail stores to drive sales and customer engagement.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to promote product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports through the designated online portal.



Requirements
Valid two-wheeler license is mandatory for field operations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and highly driven by performance goals.
Minimum educational qualification: Graduation (preferred).
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants, Building materials ).
Candidates from insurance or banking backgrounds or from Any other sales background with demonstrable sales aptitude are also encouraged to apply.


Benefits
Net Take Home: 16k to 23k (Negotiable)
MWA: 5,000/ -
Lucrative performance-based incentives
Absorption after 1 year based on performance
Travel allowance: 5000 per month, depending on profile

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
About Organisation
Tata Power runs four electricity distribution companies (Discoms) in Odisha through a public-private partnership with the state government. Formed as 51:49 joint ventures between Tata Power and the Government of Odisha, these utilities supply reliable power to nearly 10 million consumers across the state.

The Four Odisha Discoms
TPCODL (TP Central Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPNODL (TP Northern Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPSODL (TP Southern Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPWODL (TP Western Odisha Distribution Limited)

This Position will be based at TP Central Odisha Distribution Limited, Bhubaneswar, Odisha

Job Purpose
To develop and implement the organization's industrial relations strategy, fostering a positive and harmonious relationship between management and employees, ensuring compliance with labor laws, and effectively managing industrial disputes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

Industrial Relations Strategy Development:
Develop and implement a comprehensive industrial relations strategy aligned with the organization's goals and values.
Establish and maintain effective communication channels with employee representatives, unions (if applicable), and the workforce.
Proactively identify potential industrial relations issues and develop preventive strategies.

Negotiation and Collective Bargaining:
Lead and manage negotiations with unions or employee representatives on matters related to wages, working conditions, and other terms of employment.
Develop and implement collective bargaining agreements.
Ensure compliance with the terms of collective bargaining agreements.
Grievance Handling and Dispute Resolution:
Establish and manage effective grievance handling mechanisms.
Investigate and resolve employee grievances and industrial disputes in a fair and timely manner.
Mediate and facilitate discussions to reach amicable settlements.

Compliance with Labor Laws:
Ensure the organization's compliance with all applicable labor laws, regulations, and statutory requirements in India (including but not limited to the Industrial Disputes Act, Trade Unions Act, etc.).
Stay updated on changes in labor legislation and advise management on their implications.

Experience - 20+ years of Experience.

Knowledge & Skills

In-depth knowledge of Indian labor laws and industrial relations practices.
Proven negotiation and collective bargaining skills.
Strong conflict resolution and mediation abilities.
Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with employees, unions, and external authorities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ethical and fair approach to handling employee and industrial relations issues.
AboutCompany:
Tata Power- An Equal Opportunity Employer.

Led by a powerful vision, Tata Power pioneered the generation of electricity in India. It has now successfully served the Mumbai consumers for over ninety years and has spread its footprints across the nation. Today, it is the countrys largest private player in the sector. Apart from Mumbai and Delhi, the company has generation capacities in Jojobera, Jharkhand and Karnataka.As a growth strategy , Tata Power has ventured into several greenfield projects in Generation. The 4000 megawatt imported Coal-based generating station at Mundra , Gujarat , 1000 megawatt Thermal Power plant at Maithon , Jharkhand are some of its recent involvements. It has got several other upcoming capacity additions / greenfield projects in Maharashtra , Jharkhand , Orissa , West Bengal.

Description:
Zonal Human Resources Lead

Role Overview:

Position Summary:
The Zonal Human Resources Lead is responsible for overseeing and leading end-to-end HR service delivery for both direct and indirect employees across branch operations. This role acts as a strategic and operational HR partner focused on talent retention, performance management, employee grievance redressal, statutory labor compliance, and championing occupational health and safety standards in alignment with company values.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

1. HR Business Partnering & Operations
HR Strategy & Budgeting: Formulate and execute the annual branch HR plan and operating budget in alignment with business priorities and Hub HR objectives.
Workforce Planning & Talent Acquisition: Collaborate with the central recruitment team to ensure timely hiring, seamless onboarding, induction, and deployment of direct and indirect branch staff.
Employee Lifecycle & Records Management: Maintain accurate employee personal files and partner with the HR Shared Services / Transaction Center to ensure real-time ERP data integrity.
Performance & Talent Development: Drive the timely closure of the Performance Development Review (PDR) process for indirect staff; partner with the training function to identify training needs and ensure compliance with mandatory training programs.
HR Analytics: Compile, analyze, and present branch HR metric dashboards and reports to Hub and Corporate HR stakeholders.

2. Employee Relations, Engagement & Grievance Redressal

Grievance Resolution: Promptly address, manage, and resolve employee queries/grievances escalated beyond the central HR Helpdesk/Wish Center purview.
Employee Voice & Engagement: Conduct structured town halls, listening tours, and communication sessions to gather employee sentiment and implement corrective action plans.
Cross-Functional Escalation: Coordinate closely with Centers of Excellence (CoEs), Employee Relations (ER), and Shared Services for smooth conflict resolution.

3. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

Compliance Management: Partner with the central ER and Compliance teams to guarantee strict adherence to local labor laws, statutory acts, and client-site audit mandates.
Quality Standards: Drive documentation and procedural compliance for the HR chapter of ISO audits and corporate quality accreditations.
Vendor & Agency Oversight: Liaise with regulatory agencies and third-party staffing vendors as needed for audits and labor compliance.

4. Occupational Health & Safety

Workplace Safety: Promote adherence to corporate Health & Safety policies and safe working protocols across all branch facilities and operational deployments.
Incident Management: Drive safety awareness campaigns, conduct safety drills, report on-site incidents, and facilitate swift incident resolution.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Metrics
Plan vs. Actual: Adherence to branch HR headcount plan and operational budget.
Operational Execution: % completion of recruitment targets, PDR cycles, and statutory training.
Retention: Branch voluntary attrition rate compared to internal benchmarks.
Service Delivery: Grievance resolution turnaround time (TAT) and employee engagement scores.
Audit & Risk: Zero critical non-compliance observations during statutory or client audits.
Safety: Number of workplace Health & Safety incidents reported/resolved.
Key Relationships & Stakeholders
Internal Stakeholders: Branch Manager & Operations Team, Hub HR Business Partners, Hub ER Team, Corporate/HQ HR, Talent Acquisition Team, Learning & Development Team, HR Shared Services / Wish Center, Payroll & Benefits Team.
External Stakeholders: Statutory & Labor Law Authorities, Government Regulatory Bodies, Third-party Staffing & Logistics Vendors.
Education
Minimum: Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Preferred: Masters Degree or MBA with a specialization in Human Resources / Industrial Relations.
Experience
3 to 7 years of solid HR Generalist / HR Business Partnering experience within a structured corporate environment.
Workforce Scale: Demonstrated experience managing HR operations for large distributed/field-force teams (direct and indirect/blue-collar workforce) is strongly preferred.
Competencies & Skills
HR Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliances (PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Minimum Wages, Contract Labor Act), performance management, and HR ERP tools.
Operational Agility: Proven capability to navigate complex, fast-paced environments and manage competing operational priorities.
Communication: Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to influence branch leaders and front-line workers alike.
Leadership & Ethics: High standard of personal integrity, empathetic grievance handling, and collaborative stakeholder management.

Role: Area Sales Manager
Location: Zonal office- Bhubaneswar
Reporting to: Regional Sales Manager
Team name: Sales team
About the Team and the Role:
The Sales team at Ather is responsible for building a network and establishing the blueprint for selling Electric Vehicles in India, driving a historic transformation of the two-wheeler commute through a breakthrough product and an engaged community.
This role is for an Area Sales Manager who will play a key role in the growth story, owning the business in their region and ensuring growth in sales while maintaining high levels of customer experience and operational profits.
Responsibilities:
Drive sales through assigned Channel Partners
Build teams and systems that ensure sustainable sales growth while maintaining exceptionally high customer experience standards.
Foster and manage strong relationships with retail partners to ensure business thriving and alignment with brand vision.
Execute operational excellence at Channel Partners covering local demand generation and sales driving activities.
Analyze the sales funnel to identify problem statements, develop solutions, and motivate teams for implementation.
Deliver against steep ramp-up plans with a focus on scaling the regional business effectively.
Manage multi-stakeholder inputs from internal teams and external partners to maintain design and operational integrity.
Conduct regular performance reviews and site assessments to ensure business health and consistency across locations.
Strategise and strive to improve Ather market share in the assigned territory
Required qualifications
Postgraduate or graduate degree in Business or Engineering from a Tier I/Tier II institute.
4 to 10 years of experience in B2C/Channel sales.
Must Have Competencies
Data-driven analysis of sales funnels to identify bottlenecks and implement strategic solutions for revenue growth.
Strategic channel management to align retail partners with corporate goals while ensuring partner profitability.
Operational excellence in retail management, specifically driving local demand generation and customer experience standards.
Expertise in B2C sales strategies and the ability to execute aggressive market ramp-up plans in competitive environments.
Good to Have Competencies
Deep understanding of technology or automobile retail landscapes and evolving mobility trends in the Indian market.
Advanced negotiation and persuasive communication skills for navigating complex stakeholder relationships and retail partnerships.
Proficiency in organizational planning and resource prioritization to manage multi-location business operations.
Ability to build and empower high-performing teams through structured mentorship and performance management systems.
Want to know more?
At Ather, weve built India’s first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience. We are expanding in India, and in the coming years, we look forward to scaling up and launching more products globally. Today, our product offerings include the Ather 450X, 450S, 450 Apex, and Rizta. Beyond the product, we are also setting up an extensive charging network and re-imagining end-to-end ownership experience. To know more, check out our Careers site and our Substack.
Be You, With Us
The Ather story doesn't write itself - our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the same. Diversity is our strength, and building an inclusive and equitable workplace begins with acknowledging and embracing our differences. We are an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects a wide range of identities, experiences, and perspectives - all united by a shared passion to shape the Ather journey.

Description:
Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance expert with solution design experience across the full FI stack, preferably with an accounts and finance background.
Lead a team of Finance specialists; facilitate and guide the implementation and support teams.
Ability to lead and facilitate design workshops, assessments, and planning sessions, demonstrating leadership experience in project management.
Lead dynamic, interactive requirements-gathering sessions with stakeholders throughout the enterprise.
Strong, hands-on expertise across core SAP FI modules:
FI-GL (General Ledger) New GL, document splitting, parallel ledgers/accounting principles, chart of accounts design, financial statement versions, and period-end closing activities.
FI-AR (Accounts Receivable) — customer master data, credit management, dunning, incoming payments, down payments, and customer-side intercompany processes.
FI-AP (Accounts Payable) — vendor master data, payment runs, payment terms, down payments, automatic/electronic payments, and vendor reconciliation.
Asset Accounting (FI-AA) — asset classes, depreciation areas, parallel valuation, asset acquisitions/retirements/transfers, and integration with GL and CO, including regulated utility plant and FERC asset classification where applicable.
Bank Accounting / Treasury integration — bank master data, electronic bank statement processing, cash management, and bank reconciliation.
Taxation — tax procedures, tax codes, withholding tax, and statutory/compliance reporting requirements.
Basic, working knowledge of Controlling — Cost Center Accounting (CO-CCA), Profit Center Accounting (CO-PCA), and Internal Orders — sufficient to support FI-CO integration points and cross-module postings; deep Product Costing or Material Ledger specialization is not required for this role.
Strong knowledge of FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission) regulatory reporting for the utilities/energy industry, including FERC Form 1/2/6 preparation, regulatory chart of accounts mapping, and FERC account classification within SAP.
Hands-on experience configuring FERC-compliant Asset Accounting structures — Continuing Property Records (CPR), Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC, both debt and equity components), Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) capitalization, retirement units, and regulatory versus book depreciation.
Understanding of the regulatory ledger/parallel ledger approach (New GL document splitting, or FI-SL) to maintain FERC regulatory books alongside US GAAP/IFRS books, including regulatory asset/liability (ASC 980) accounting.
Exposure to Public Utility industry-specific functionality, Work Order management integration (PM/PS) for capital project accounting, and minor/major retirement processing relevant to utility plant.
Experience supporting FERC audits and regulatory filings, including variance analysis between book and regulatory basis of accounting.
Mentor, coach and manage multiple teams and projects.
Proven experience in configuring, testing and supporting SAP Finance solutions across GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting and Taxation.
Participate in design discussions, providing expertise on the SAP S/4HANA Finance platform.
Work with business users to understand requirements and propose alternative design solutions across FI processes.
Develop a collaborative and cohesive team, working with a culture of a One Team mindset.
Hands-on experience in Finance and accounts, with the ability to translate accounting requirements into system configuration.
Hands-on experience across S/4HANA Finance features with ability to design, develop and customize solutions, including integration with other modules like MM/SD/PS/PP/PM/IM — particularly how procurement, sales, and production postings flow into FI.
Knowledge of CFIN, and understanding of the elimination of ETL tools to enable transactional-level matching in real time.
Understanding of AIF and field value mapping, centralized transaction processing, payments, intercompany reconciliation, and group consolidation using S/4HANA Group Reporting.
Working familiarity with the S/4HANA Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR) tool, as well as a solid accounting and finance background.
Knowledge and experience in implementing SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting is an added advantage.

Implementation and configuration knowledge across IFS Cloud ERP, EAM,

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions underpinned by the worlds largest delivery network Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. About Global Network:
Accenture Strategy shapes our clientsfuture, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, every business is a digital business. Digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers, and communities how they manufacture and deliver products and services, and how they run their organizations. This is our unique differentiator. We seek people who recognize and understand the impact that digital, and technology have on every industry and every sector, and share our passion to shape unique strategies that allow our clients to succeed in this environment.
To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy''s services include those provided by our
Global
Network a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Approximately 10,000 consultants are part of this rapidly expanding network, providing specialized and strategic industry and functional consulting expertise from key locations around the world. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit .

Why Technology Consulting
The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation.
As technology rapidly evolves, its more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the clients toughest business problems.
Specialize in management or technology consulting to transform the world''s leading organizations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by:

Helping Clients: Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast-changing, customer-driven environments.

Enhancing your Skillset: Building expertise and innovating with leading-edge technologies such as Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence and Cloud.

Transforming Businesses: Developing customized, next-generation products and services that help clients shift to new business models designed for today''s connected landscape of disruptive technologies

Principal Duties

And Responsibilities:
Project environment that offers multiple opportunities for career growth.
The opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives are limitless in this ever-changing business landscape
Here are just a few of your day-to-day responsibilities.
Lead Hybrid Cloud Projects: Guide clients through application modernization and migration initiatives, designing strategies and roadmaps for hybrid environments.
Architect Hybrid Solutions: Develop cloud architectures integrating public cloud services with on-premises and private cloud platforms, using technologies such as OpenShift, Anthos, and VMware.
Application Modernization: Design composable architectures using microservices, event-driven architectures (EDA), and cloud-native technologies across hybrid environments.
Hybrid Cloud Integration: Implement solutions that enable seamless workload portability and management across on-premises, private, and public clouds.
DevOps & Automation: Establish CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Deployment Manager, OpenShift templates), and automated operations across hybrid environments.
Data Integration & Analytics: Architect data platforms that span cloud and on-premises, enabling advanced analytics, machine learning, and secure data exchange.
Security & Compliance: Design secure hybrid architectures, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices for identity, access, and data protection.
Client Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor, communicating hybrid cloud architecture, best practices, and transformation strategies to technical and business stakeholders.
Thought Leadership: Develop reusable assets, publish whitepapers, and contribute to the hybrid cloud community.
Business Case & ROI Analysis: Build financial models for cloud adoption, including TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI. Advise on cost optimization strategies and AWS pricing models.
Operating Model Design: Design cloud operating models for governance, security, and compliance. Recommend organizational changes for cloud adoption (e.g., Cloud Center of Excellence).
Resilience & DR Strategy: Define RTO/RPO tiers, multi-region patterns, backup/restore policies
Design Architecture Review Board charters, NFR baseline templates



Qualification

Qualifications:
Bachelors degree
MBA Degree from Tier-1 College (Preferable)
9-13 years of large-scale consulting experience and/or working with hi tech companies leading Projects on Cloud Strategy, Assessment, Cloud architecture, App Modernization, Containers, information security and information management.
Professional Cloud Architect Certification (GCP or AWS)

Experience:
We are seeking experienced professionals who have led large-scale engagements in application modernization, cloud architecture, and cloud strategy. The ideal candidates will have technical expertise in cloud strategy, assessments, cloud architecture, application modernization, and containers, across all stages of the innovation lifecycle, with a focus on shaping the future in real-time."
The candidate should have practical industry expertise in one of these areas - Financial Services, Retail, consumer goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources.

Key Competencies and Skills:
The right candidate should have competency and skills aligned to one or more of these archetypes
Expertise in hybrid cloud architecture, integration, and cloud-native development.
Strong knowledge of microservices, containers (Kubernetes, OpenShift), and event-driven design.
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation across hybrid environments
Other desired skills -
Strong desire to work in technology-driven business transformation
Strong knowledge of technology trends across IT and digital and how they can be applied to companies to address real world problems and opportunities.
Comfort conveying both high-level and detailed information, adjusting the way ideas are presented to better address varying social styles and audiences.
Leading proof of concept and/or pilot implementations and defining the plan to scale implementations across multiple technology domains
Flexibility to accommodate client travel requirements
Published Thought leadership Whitepapers, POVs

Description:
Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. They play a vital role in ensuring a seamless customer experience, managing inventory, and implementing operational processes to enhance store efficiency. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational and communication skills. Key Responsibilities : Customer Service : Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. Train and mentor store staff on customer service best practices. Inventory Management : Monitor and manage store inventory levels to prevent stockouts and overstock situations. Coordinate with suppliers for timely replenishment of inventory. Conduct regular stock audits and maintain accurate inventory records. Store Layout and Merchandising : Collaborate with the visual merchandising team to ensure attractive and effective product displays. Optimize store layout for a smooth flow of customers and improved product visibility. Operational Efficiency : Develop and implement operational procedures to streamline store processes and reduce operational costs. Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to store operations. Loss Prevention : Implement loss prevention strategies to minimize theft and ensure the security of store assets. Conduct periodic security audits and recommend improvements as needed. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Description:
The opportunity:

Risk management protects business performance and helps sustain results. Its about achieving a clear understanding of risks and developing plans to manage them.
As one of our risk professionals, youll work with multinational businesses and public sector organizations. You’ll help them develop an integrated, holistic approach to risk and benefit from their investments in internal controls.
You’ll deliver some of the most significant and class-leading internal audit and risk engagements globally. You’ll also team with our performance improvement professionals in multidisciplinary engagements, helping major global clients transform and sustain business performance.
By plugging into our market-leading global network, you’ll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional risk advisor.

Your key responsibilities:

Responsible for executing client-related engagements in the areas of governance, risk & compliance (GRC), internal audits, process reviews, standard operating procedures, enterprise risk management, revenue assurance, SOX 404 & Clause 49 assistance
Responsible for overall client service delivery in accordance with EY quality guidelines & methodologies
Manage accounts on a day-to-day basis & explore new business opportunity for the firm with new and existing clients
Actively establish & strengthen client (functional heads & key influencers) and internal relationships
Assist in developing new solutions, methodologies, and internal initiatives
Create a positive learning culture, coach, counsel, and develop junior team members
Market leadership related
Assist Partners & Senior Managers in driving the business development process on new/existing client engagements by gathering appropriate resources, gaining access to key contacts & supervising proposal preparation
Identify buyers, influencers & stakeholders in existing client engagements and build strong relationships
Create innovative insights for clients, adapt methods & practices to fit operational team needs & contribute to thought leadership documents
Practice secondment for developing new methodologies
Facilitate discussions / knowledge sharing with key client personnel and contribute to EY thought leadership
Service delivery related
Work with high-growth clients and other market leaders in industries such financial services, insurance etc
Establish audit objectives and scope of work; establish the engagement budget; and take responsibility for the overall execution of the audit project through wrap-up and final report delivery
Plan & schedule client engagements. Determine and deploy the right team with adequate skill sets for executing engagements and periodically review status of engagements and work products
Demonstrate strong project management skills
Maintain a strong client focus by effectively serving client needs and developing productive working relationships with client personnel. Stay abreast of current business and economic developments and new pronouncements/standards relevant to the client's business
Demonstrate industry expertise (deep understanding of the industry, emerging trends, issues/challenges, key players & leading practices)
Review status updates and prepare management presentations/audit committee presentations etc
Actively contribute to improving operational efficiency on projects & internal initiatives.
Drive timely billing of invoices & actively follow up on collections
People related
Display teamwork, integrity, and leadership. Work with team members to set goals and responsibilities for specific engagements. Foster teamwork and innovation
Drive performance management for self and team
Utilize technology & tools to continually learn and innovate, share knowledge with team members and enhance service delivery
Understand EY and its service lines. Actively encourage team members to contribute ideas
Conduct workshops and technical training sessions for team members. Contribute to the learning & development agenda

Skills and attributes for success

Demonstrate industry expertise (detailed understanding of the industry, trends, issues/challenges, and leading practices).

To qualify for the role, you must have
Chartered Accountant, Certified Internal Auditor, or master’s in business administration
Minimum 8+ years of post-qualification experience in risk advisory, related internal audit experience or external audit experience or related business experience.
Client-Facing Experience is must.
India Practice experience is must.

Ideally, you’ll also have
Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation, and negotiation skills
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility

What we look for
We’re interested in versatile people with the ability to take on new responsibilities and listen to clients to get things done. We’re not just looking for technical accounting experience — we’re after genuinely interesting people with the ability to build relationships, negotiate and think in unique and creative news ways. If you’re a confident leader with a curious mind and the ability to solve complex issues, this role is for you.

What working at EY offers
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

About EY
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we’ll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2020 a reality.

Description:
Manager - Actuarial - Business Consulting Risk
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it's your career and 'It's yours to build' which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
About Actuarial Services:
The Team advises clients in the terms of:
- Reserving
- Audit
- M&A Support
- Capital modelling
- IFRS Reporting
- Business Planning
- Reinsurance Structure and Optimization
- Regulatory Compliance and more
The opportunity:
General Insurance - Domestic & Global Market - Business Consulting Risk - Actuarial
Your key responsibilities
- The Incumbent will be responsible for executing projects in the Actuarial space
- We are looking for Actuaries with varying experience in the Indian/ Global insurance market. The job grade of the successful candidates for this role will depend on their respective qualities and experience. The typical responsibilities of the role include
- Play a proactive role within a multi-disciplinary EY team in supporting the various client engagements which may span across Reserving,
- Statutory reporting,
- Solvency assessment,
- IFRS17 implementation,
- Statutory Audit, Internal Audit & Review,
- Business planning.
- Build appropriate models for the above-mentioned projects allowing for client requirement and relevant regulations.
- Lend support on strands of research and specialisms work aimed at providing key insights to help our clients / consultants
- Develop cutting edge proposals for winning new and different clients /engagements
- Work closely with the team to develop consistent standards and best practice.
- Sharing knowledge in a timely and effective way by submitting regularly to the knowledge database
- Contribute to wider opportunities within EY and to raising its profile externally e.g. taking an active role in writing articles for The Actuary
- Develop and maintain deep technical knowledge in modelling skills
- Present internally and externally on areas of technical specialist knowledge
- Develop reports and presentations for the client
Skills and attributes for success
In addition to technical competence, what will set you up for success at EY is your ability to:
- Strong communication, documentation, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills
- Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
- Broad consulting and project management skills, effective written and oral communication skills
- Pursue passions beyond work and invest in your wellbeing
To qualify for the role you must have:
- A qualified graduate or postgraduate in Actuarial Science with minimum of 6 Qualified papers having 5+ years of experience in Actuarial GI domain.
Good technical understanding
- Reserving techniques
- Business planning and capital modeling
- IFRS 17 methodologies
- Audit
People Skills:
- Proven communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to put across complex technical issues and solutions to non-actuaries.
- Good team player and team handling skills
Desirable
- Good working knowledge of the relevant actuarial concepts and methodologies
- Working knowledge of tools like R, Python etc.
- Knowledge of the latest accounting standard - IFRS17 which is being implemented or reported across various geographies across the world.
- Confidence in speaking and expressing views through a variety of platforms like publications (internal/external), seminars etc.
Ideally you'll also have
- Proven ability to balance priorities and manage many competing demands to agreed deadlines and to the required level of quality.
- Ability to give/receive constructive feedback.
- Self-motivated, uses own initiative and is outcome-focused.
- Dealing constructively with uncertainty and ambiguity.
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.
What working at EY offers
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
About EY
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
Join us in building a better working world. Apply now.

and code quality improvements.

Azure/AWS/GCP (PaaS and IaaS).

models.

• 6+ years as a full stack or backend developer with proficiency in Python; fair to
strong experience with JavaScript frameworks/libraries (Angular, React).
• Strong software development skills across design, development, testing,
deployment, and maintenance of large-scale applications.
• Experience with RESTful APIs, asynchronous request handling, and ORM.
• Ability to build feature rich full stack AI integrated applications.
• Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases and data storage solutions; data
processing/manipulation and bulk data operations.
• Experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD.
• Working experience deploying to Azure, AWS, or GCP.
• Strong unit testing and debugging skills; strong experience with version control (Git).
• Understanding of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, multimodal
applications, agentic frameworks (fundamental level).
• Experience with data/ML frameworks and tools (PyTorch, LangChain, Autogen).
• Strong in data structures, architecture, and design; familiarity with Python threading
limitations and multi-process architecture.
• Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills; adherence to
security practices.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and cloud-native/serverless patterns (Azure
Functions, AWS Lambda).
• Experience exposing GenAI capabilities via APIs and embedding AI-driven UIs in
Angular/React.
• Experience with observability and basic telemetry for AI applications.
Good To have:
Certifications in AI/ML, Deep Learning and NLP from Learning platforms such as Coursera,
Udemy or equivalent.
Certifications on Cloud Architecture (GCP/Azure/AWS)
Experience building MCP servers or Agent to Agent applications.
Fine tuning LLMs and Hosting LLMs on Premises
