Job Summary
Senior Associate at C&I team supports the Account Manager and the Account Leadership team; Global Client serving Partner, Global Client Executive to develop and manage relevant activities on designated Priority accounts. The Senior Account Coordinator will be expected to provide high quality and insightful support to account teams on Go-to-market activities. The Senior Account Coordinator will build network across the account leadership and within GDS to develop account knowledge to benefit the regional/global Account team and our relationship and business with the client.
Role Type
Senior Account Coordinator
The opportunity Your key responsibilities Account Management
Own account reporting and ensure relevant stakeholders receive and understand reported data
In liaison with the Client Service Partner and Director, own the account planning process and ensure regular reviews against planned milestones and targets.
Understand the strategic communication and stakeholder engagement requirements to progress the account plan agenda, and work with global teams to respond and deploy
Provide relevant knowledge to Account teams focus on dissemination of business analysis and research, competitive intelligence and relevant firm thought leadership
To liaise and work with onshore account teams and internal business services groups to scope new support requirements, build processes for the execution of account management tasks, and ensure effective transition of work to the remote GDS support platform
Client Relationship Development
Contribute to complex account and business development needs, including global account planning, go-to-market research and strategy, pursuit or sales support, pitch development, among others
Work with BMC point of contact to plan and execute marketing initiatives that directly drive revenue
Accelerate strategy execution, particularly around prioritized Regions and strategic solutions.
Understand market trends, what is on our clients' agenda and how these translate into revenue generating opportunities. Monitor solution revenue to understand success, opportunities, underperformance
Communication
Coordinate with global network of regional account team meetings. Send updated account and sector content and information.
Develop and maintain relationships with service lines, Accounts, Market Segments, Emerging Markets and subsectors to serve as a two-way conduit for connection and communication
Responsible for working to develop high impact relationships and embedding ABD support into the processes of the accounts
Responsible for project management, quality control, review of deliverables, and for embedding the principles of exceptional client service of being connected, responsive and insightful in our support to the account teams and ABD stakeholders
Facilitation of knowledge sharing
Skills and attributes for success
Succinct and structured oral and written communications skills with proven ability to explain complex concepts in a crisp, clear, concise, and graphic-rich style, using appropriate analytics and visualization tools.
Experience in Account Management and preparing sales and pipeline reporting, as well as providing insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients
Experience in Microsoft tools like excel and PPT
To qualify for the role, you must have
Any Graduate
4-8 years' experience in Account management and data reporting and analysis
Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
Demonstrated strong written and oral communication skills
Ability to use both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis methodologies, including financial analysis skills, to synthesize information, review data inputs and provide analytic insights
Ideally, you'll also have
Account Management and data reporting skills
Exposure to tools like Tableau, PowerBi etc.
Credible experience working in a fast-moving, client-driven environment
Technologies and Tools
Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services
Experience using Procurement portals (i.e., SAP Fieldglass or Ariba)
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
A professional with strong interpersonal skills - confidence, maturity & ability to build strong client relationships

Job SummaryEY- Assurance Manager
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity: We're looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles
Your key responsibilities
Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement teams expectations
Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS orengagement teams.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.

Strong understanding of testing methodologies, test governance and defect management processes.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders in a complex transformation environment.
Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to present status, risks and recommendations clearly.
Analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, assess impacts and recommend practical improvements.
Inclusive and collaborative working style, with the ability to engage effectively across global and cross-functional teams.

Bachelors degree in information systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance or a related field.
5+ years of experience in software/application testing for transformation, technology, or enterprise application programs.
5+ years of experience leading testing activities for large-scale transformation programs, including test planning, test execution, defect management, UAT coordination, and testing status reporting.
Experience working with cross-functional business stakeholders and technology teams across onshore and offshore delivery models.
Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication and change leadership

Experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, ERP, Procure to Pay or SAP Ariba environments. Emphasis on S2P platform experience including SAP Ariba Strategic Sourcing Suite, Ariba SLP, Ariba Risk, Ariba Buying, Ariba Invoicing and Ariba Business Network.

Job Summary
Todays world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of almost 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.
Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.


Junior Security Analyst - Cyber Defense CTF (Cyber Triage and Forensics)

The Opportunity
Cyber Triage and Forensics (CTF) - The Cyber Defense Response Center is responsible for monitoring and detecting information security events that could adversely impact EY information assets and resources. Its mission is aligned with the incident response and attack lifecycles.
A qualified candidate will have the opportunity to work with highly talent Cyber security professional experts to learn and develop new skills. Candidate will be exposed to many technologies and security tools whilst working with EY as well as career growth opportunity. CTF also deliver training to analysts to upskill.


Your key responsibilities
Perform front line accurate and precise real-time monitoring and analysis correlation of logs/alerts from a multitude of security devices with a focus on the determination of what was said as events constitute security incidents.
Collaborate to detect and respond to information security incidents, develop, maintain, and follow procedures for security event alerting, and participate in security investigations.
The CTF Junior Security Analyst must be competent to work at a technical level, be capable of identifying threats and vectors that cause security events and be able to follow defined procedures for mitigating said threats.


Essential Functions
Respond to network and host based security events
Participate in detecting, investigating, and resolving security events
Identify and propose areas for improvement within the Cyber Defense Response Center
Provide documentation and project support
Serve as an escalation point for difficult problems and complex inquiries
Server as shift lead when necessary
Conduct detailed security event analysis from network traffic attributes and host-based attributes ( binary analysis, etc) to identify information security incidents
Provide feedback on security control capability gaps based off of security intrusion trends
Develop and maintain analytical procedures to improve security incident identification efficiency
Demonstrate ability to drive process improvements and identify gaps


Skills and attributes for success
Information Security Principles, Technologies, and Practices
Experience with multiple security event detection platforms
Fair understanding of Linux, TCP/IP, Network Security, encryption standards etc.
Aware of Types of attacks (DOS, DDOS etc.)
Understand basic IDS / IPS rules to identify and/or prevent malicious activity
Aware of security log analysis.
Idea about various penetration testing and application testing methodology and tools is a definite plus.
Comfortable navigating and troubleshooting Linux and Windows system issues


To qualify for the role you must have
Capability of working independently
Soft Skills - Excellent communication skills; written and verbal.
Good Presentation skills
Good Investigative, analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to work in a team, with little supervision and using own initiative


Experience
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in one or more of the following:
Working in a Security Monitoring/Security Operations Center environment (SOC)
Experience investigating security events, threats and/or vulnerabilities
Understanding of electronic investigation and log correlation Proficiency with the latest intrusion detection platforms; working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows systems administration (Including AD).
Scripting or programming (Shell scripting, Power Shell, C, C#, Java, etc.)


Qualifications, certifications and Education requirements
Under Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science or Engineering or related domain (MCA/MTech/BTech/BCA /BSc CS or BSc IT).


Desired Certifications
Any Cyber Security Certification


Ideally, youll also have
Good demeanour.
Willingness to work a flexible shifts with schedules that includes nights, weekends and holidays; shifts can changed based on business needs.
Demonstrated integrity in a professional environment
Willingness to learn new technologies.


What we look for
Under limited supervision the CTF (Cyber Triage and Forensics) Junior Security Analyst will report to the CTF Manager. The CTF Junior Security Analyst will perform tasks including monitoring, research, classification and analysis of security events that occur on the network or endpoint. The CTF Junior Security Analyst should have familiarity with the principles of network and endpoint security, current threat and attack trends, a basic understanding of the OSI model, and have a working knowledge of Defense in depth strategies.

Job Summary
As a Thought Leadership Insights - Social Media Manager Assistant Director, you will play a strategic role within the EY organizations Brand Marketing and Communication team, shaping how the EY organizations leaders show up in the market through insight led, reputation building social media, thought leadership and insights. You will lead the development of cohesive, data informed content strategies that position senior leaders as trusted voices and strategic advisors across priority markets and accounts.
This role sits at the intersection of social listening, insight generation, storytelling and brand governance. You will translate market signals, industry conversations, and EY intellectual capital into compelling narratives that resonate with priority audienceswhile safeguarding the brand, voice, and reputation.
Operating as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, you will guide them through ambiguity, competing priorities, and sensitive market moments, helping them engage credibly and consistently across social and digital platforms. You will also play a key role in orchestrating social media and thought leadership initiatives, working closely with global, regional, and creative teams to deliver measurable impact.


Your key responsibilities
Insight discovery and social intelligence
Lead social listening and multisource signal scanning across industry trends, leader networks, media narratives, and competitor activity
Synthesize weak and strong signals into timely, insightdriven points of view relevant to EY's strategic priorities
Leverage EY proprietary research, market intelligence, and AIenabled tools to uncover differentiated insights
Thought leadership and content strategy
Define and drive social media and thought leadership strategies aligned to Brand, Marketing, and business priorities
Shape cohesive editorial narratives across leaders, themes, and markets to ensure consistency and clarity of the brands point of view
Translate complex business, technical, and regulatory topics into clear, compelling, and audiencerelevant content
Executive social presence and advisory
Act as a strategic advisor to senior leaders on executive social presence, voice, and positioning
Develop leader personas, content arcs, and engagement strategies tailored to individual expertise and market relevance
Confidently challenge and reframe leader messaging where required, balancing authenticity with brand and reputational considerations
Content creation and delivery
Serve as lead writer and editor for social media and thought leadership content, ensuring quality, insight, and consistency
Create firstcut and final content across formats, including executive briefs and talking points, LinkedIn posts and articles, blogs, web articles, presentations, and multimedia assets
Support leaders with content for the EY organization and thirdparty events, including presentations and speaking points
Measurement, performance, and optimization
Define and track meaningful engagement and influence metrics beyond vanity measures
Translate performance data into actionable insights and impact narratives for leaders and stakeholders
Continuously refine content strategies based on analytics, audience response, and market feedback
Governance, risk, and quality control
Ensure all content aligns with brand, tone of voice, and editorial standards
Apply strong judgment around sensitive topics, regulatory considerations, and reputational risk
Operate within a mandatory humanintheloop model, with clear governance and approval workflows
Program and stakeholder management
Establish and deepen strategic connections with clients priority audiences, ensuring leader positioning and messaging resonate with target stakeholders across markets, sectors, and buying stages. Identify, curate, and shape insightled topics and narratives that address client pain points, emerging market trends, and regulatory or business inflection points, with clear potential to generate commercial conversations. Partner closely with Clients Industries (CI) and account teams to align content, thought leadership, and campaigns with account priorities, growth strategies, and active opportunity pipelines. Proactively translate audience engagement and content performance into demand signals, supporting the identification, acceleration, and creation of new business opportunities for leaders. Act as a strategic connector between leader agendas, audience insights, and accountlevel opportunities, enabling timely access to pipeline movement and whitespace opportunities. Support leaders in leveraging thought leadership and platform presence (e.g., LinkedIn, events, campaigns) as a business development enabler, not just a brandbuilding activity. Collaborate with CI and marketing teams to ensure followthrough on opportunities, including tagging, tracking, and handoff of demand signals into account planning and pursuit activities.
Continuously assess audience response, market relevance, and opportunity conversion to refine topic strategy and optimize future content and engagement efforts.
Projectmanage endtoend delivery of flagship thought leadership and social media programs
Coordinate with global, regional, and serviceline teams to align content pipelines and priorities
Manage external agencies and vendors where required
Capability building and leadership
Mentor and guide junior team members, setting high editorial and strategic standards
Contribute to the development of playbooks, frameworks, and best practices for social media and thought leadership
Stay abreast of external best practices and emerging platform trends, bringing innovation back into the team


Skills and attributes for success
This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, marketing mindset, editorial excellence, and executive level stakeholder management. You bring the confidence to advise senior leaders, the curiosity to mine insights from complexity, and the discipline to deliver high quality work in a fast paced environment.


Key skills required to excel in this role
Digital marketing acumen
Exceptional editorial, thought leadership writing skills and strong attention to detail
Strong organizational and project management skills
Ability to analyze and interrogate data to unearth one-of-its-kind stories
Ability to critically assess business/technical content and translate into digestible, insightful content relevant for specific audiences
Comfortable and confident engaging with senior stakeholders
Skilled at planning and executing content across a variety of channels and formats in support of campaign objectives


To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors or masters degree in Journalism, Communications

Job Summary
Role Title: GDS Microsoft Marketplace Transactions, Operations & Finance Lead Analyst
Alliance: Microsoft
Competency: Operations Management
Function: GDS ES Growth & Innovation
Skill Level: High
Sub Function: GDS Alliances Program Ops CoE
The Microsoft Alliance is one of EY's most strategic ecosystem relationships, helping clients accelerate transformation through cloud, data, AI, automation and emerging technologies. As marketplace-led motions become increasingly important to solution commercialization and client activation, disciplined transaction coordination, operational governance and finance visibility are critical to scalable alliance execution.
The Marketplace Transactions, Operations & Finance Lead Analyst will support the Microsoft Alliance team by managing marketplace transaction operations, finance coordination, reporting, documentation, stakeholder follow-through and process governance across Microsoft marketplace-related activities.
This role is designed for a detail-oriented professional who can connect marketplace activity with operational execution and finance transparency. The incumbent will work closely with Microsoft Alliance stakeholders, marketplace and solution teams, finance, commercial, sales, marketing, operations and GDS teams to ensure that transactions, approvals, documentation, reporting and follow-ups are completed accurately, on time and with clear ownership.
The role will also support AI-enabled marketplace growth by helping track AI, Copilot, Azure AI, Data & AI and automation-related marketplace activity, while ensuring transaction support considers business value, responsible AI requirements, data privacy considerations and commercialization readiness in a practical and consistent manner.
Your key responsibilities
Support marketplace transaction operations, governance routines and business review cadences for Microsoft Alliance marketplace-related activities.
Maintain transaction trackers, operational status views, finance coordination logs and action registers for marketplace opportunities, submissions, publications and commercial follow-ups.
Coordinate with solution owners, alliance teams, finance, commercial, sales and operations stakeholders to maintain visibility across transaction progress, readiness gaps, approvals, invoices and documentation requirements, where applicable.
Independently progress marketplace operations workstreams aligned to Microsoft Alliance priorities, ensuring activities are tracked, updated and advanced with clear owners and timelines.
Prepare concise leadership and stakeholder summaries covering marketplace transaction status, operational risks, finance dependencies, pending actions and decisions required.
Support marketplace finance coordination by tracking commercial information, funding linkages, transaction evidence, documentation, reporting inputs and reconciliation follow-ups required by the workstream.
Develop and maintain marketplace operations dashboards, Excel trackers, Power BI views, SharePoint repositories, reporting calendars and governance documentation.
Support monthly business reviews, operational check-ins, finance reviews and marketplace readiness discussions by preparing performance narratives and visual summaries.
Analyze trends across marketplace activity, transaction progress, operational bottlenecks, evidence gaps, finance dependencies and stakeholder actions to identify risks, improvement opportunities and recommended next steps.
Coordinate with sales, marketing and solution teams to support marketplace activation requirements, including offer narratives, enablement content, client-facing materials, marketplace content and commercialization readiness inputs.
Support AI-enabled marketplace activities by improving tracker automation, status summaries, exception reporting, dashboard commentary and leadership-ready narratives using responsible AI principles.
Build efficiency, automation and standardization into marketplace transaction workflows, finance coordination processes, reporting routines, data validation and documentation practices.
Partner with onshore Microsoft Alliance, marketplace, finance and operations contacts on special requests, process improvements, reporting enhancements and leadership asks.
Identify transaction risks, data gaps, finance coordination issues, process delays and documentation challenges that may impact marketplace execution, and coordinate timely resolution with stakeholders.
Translate marketplace, commercial and finance-related updates into simple, stakeholder-friendly narratives that support decision-making and execution follow-through.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong understanding of marketplace operations, transaction coordination, finance operations, reporting governance and stakeholder follow-through.
Exposure to sales, pipeline, commercial and finance processes, including opportunity life cycles, transaction tracking, reporting definitions, documentation requirements and operational controls.
Technology aptitude and comfort working across Microsoft solution areas such as Copilot, Azure AI, Data & AI, Cloud, Security, Business Applications, marketplace offerings and automation at a business level.
Good understanding of AI-enabled transformation and the ability to apply approved AI tools responsibly to improve marketplace reporting, transaction summaries, exception tracking and operational storytelling.
Exposure to continuous process improvement, workflow standardization, reporting automation, data validation, process documentation, internal controls and audit-ready evidence management.
Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills; Power BI, Power Query, dashboarding and AI-enabled productivity tools would be an added advantage.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with onshore stakeholders and operate effectively in a matrixed global environment.
Strong problem-solving capability, analytical thinking, root-cause evaluation, mitigation planning and ability to work across multiple teams toward practical issue resolution.
Good project management skills, including prioritization, tracking, governance, execution discipline, status reporting and management of multiple marketplace and finance-related activities with competing timelines.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to create concise updates, transaction summaries, finance narratives and decision-oriented materials independently.
Experience working with alliance, marketplace, finance operations, reporting or partner programs in a professional services, consulting or technology-led organization; knowledge of EY and GDS operating models will be an advantage.
To qualify for the role, you must have
University degree required, preferably in business, finance, commerce, analytics, technology, engineering or a related discipline.
MBA, postgraduate qualification or relevant certification in finance, analytics, project management, operations or technology would be an added advantage.
8+ years of relevant work experience in marketplace operations, transaction coordination, finance operations, alliance operations, sales operations, reporting, consulting, program management or strategic operations.
Experience supporting global stakeholders, cross-functional teams and operational or finance coordination initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
Flexibility to support different assignments, time zones and business priorities based on workstream requirements.
Ideally, you\'ll also have
Multi-domain exposure across alliances, marketplace operations, finance, commercial operations, sales, marketing, reporting, analytics, technology or transformation.

Environment Manager Risk Management GCO

Overview
Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure, and resilient technology services to support global business functions. Within this landscape, Risk Management GCO requires robust environment strategy, governance, and operational excellence to support critical regulatory and control platforms.
The Environment Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end lifecycle of all environments supporting Risk Management and GCO applications, including planning, provisioning, governance, and coordination with release and change management processes. This role requires strong leadership, operational discipline, and the ability to align technical environments with business and regulatory requirements.


The Opportunity
The Environment Manager will lead environment strategy and execution across Risk Management and GCO platforms, ensuring environments are aligned with business priorities, release schedules, and control requirements. This role is accountable for environment availability, stability, and readiness to support development, testing, and production activities.
You will partner with product owners, development, production support, and business stakeholders to enable seamless delivery and operational continuity.


Key Responsibilities
Coordinate, plan, and manage all environment-related activities including provisioning, refresh, and lifecycle management.
Define environment strategy covering availability, utilization, and capacity planning.
Align environment schedules with release and deployment timelines to ensure readiness.
Partner with Service Delivery and Operations to ensure coordinated delivery and operational readiness.
Establish and enforce governance standards including environment controls, access, and data integrity.
Drive issue resolution related to environment conflicts or instability.
Provide leadership, direction, and coaching to support teams.
Ensure clear communication across business, development, QA, and operations teams.
Identify and implement operational improvements to reduce cost and increase quality.
Support Agile/SAFe planning and execution across multiple products.
Track and communicate environment metrics and readiness status.
Contribute to budget planning and resource strategy.


Analytical / Decision-Making Responsibilities
Communicate effectively with Risk Management, GCO leadership, and Enterprise Technology stakeholders.
Influence prioritization and allocation of environments across competing initiatives.
Balance delivery demands with operational stability and compliance requirements.
Build strong stakeholder relationships to enable aligned decision-making.


Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Strong understanding of enterprise environment management practices.
Ability to translate business and regulatory requirements into environment strategies.
Experience in Agile/SAFe delivery models.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with tools such as GitHub, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
Ability to develop long-term environment roadmaps aligned to product strategy.


To Qualify for the Role You Must Have
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline.
10+ years of experience managing large-scale enterprise environments or platforms.
5+ years of experience in environment planning and lifecycle management.
5+ years supporting release and change management processes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Experience supporting system implementations or migrations.
Experience with multiple SDLC methodologies including Agile and Waterfall.
Strong project management capabilities and ability to manage competing priorities.


Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with regulatory and compliance-driven environments.
SAFe or Agile certifications.
Experience with cloud-based enterprise environments.


What We Look For
A self-starter with strong ownership and accountability.
Ability to work across complex, multi-team environments.
Strong focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Job Summary

Assistant Director - Senior Art Director
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and onbrand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human across multiple media platforms.
As a Senior Art Director, you will have a unique blend of creative vision and strategic thinking, to lead our team and will act as a strong creative strategist and a design thought leader.
You will own the creative and visual direction and design for creative collaterals across multiple formats, ensuring that all creatives are on-brand, user-centric and aesthetically proficient. With a passion for problem-solving and creative strategy, you lead creative brainstorms with stakeholders and content and digital marketing teams to produce best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. With your impeccable aesthetic sense and design sensibility, you are a versatile and reliable leader who can elevate any creative conceptualization, storyboard or creative direction for projects across multiple channels.


Your key responsibilities
You understand the power of creative ideas and have a track-record of delivering memorable ideas that shape audience perception, engagement, and participation
You help coach and train the wider team, transforming GDS Creative Services capability from providing excellent design and execution services, to leading with brand-building and distinctive creative ideas and strategy
Have experience leading teams in creative agencies or in-house brand teams, championing high-visibility campaigns for top global brands (preferably B2B)
Provide creative leadership to the design teams to deliver a range of collaterals (i.e., brochures, placemats, illustration, layouts, infographics, on-screen presentations, proposals, microsites, motion graphic content and social media collaterals)
Produce strategically sound conceptual work and bring it to life through rapid prototyping and storyboard creation and all the way through post-production
Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet, and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time, budget and efficiency

Function: Talent Services (GDS)
Sub Function: Mobility Talent Services


Job Summary
This Senior Associatelevel specialist role acts as a core technical enabler of the Global Mobility operating model. The role supports digital transformation initiatives by translating business requirements into intuitive, sustainable, and automation-enabled solutions. By strengthening standardization, governance, and system reliability, the role enables the adoption of AI-enabled capabilities and supports a future-ready Mobility function.


Responsibilities
The Global Mobility System Optimization Specialist supports the Global Mobility functions transformation agenda by enabling scalable, technology-enabled service delivery.
The role operates at the intersection of operations, process design, and digital enablement, identifying and delivering system and process optimization opportunities that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and strengthen end-to-end process reliability.
Key responsibilities include developing and enhancing low-code/no-code solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform, designing automated workflows, supporting system upgrades such as AssignmentPro, documenting processes and configurations, and contributing to training and change adoption.
Through close partnership with digital, innovation, and operations stakeholders, the role ensures that Global Mobility systems and workflows evolve in line with business needs and operational excellence standards.
Purpose of the Job: The purpose of this role is to modernize and optimize Global Mobility systems and processes to support scalable, data-led, and automation-enabled service delivery. The role applies analytical problem-solving to resolve technical and operational challenges, collaborates across functions to align system solutions with business priorities, and ensures solutions are sustainable through documentation, testing, and user enablement. Through these efforts, the role strengthens transparency, consistency, and efficiency across Global Mobility services.
Supervision Responsibilities: The role has no formal direct reports but provides indirect leadership and technical guidance across the Global Mobility and Mobility Talent Services teams. It supports capability building through informal coaching, mentoring on Power Platform development, and knowledge transfer, while coordinating with stakeholders to shape inputs, timelines, and outputs.


Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Requires proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform tools (Power Automate, Power Apps), Power BI, SharePoint, and foundational SQL skills. Strong analytical thinking, process improvement capability, and effective communication skills are essential. The role requires adaptability, initiative-driven problem-solving, and the ability to collaborate across diverse teams and time zones.


Other Requirements
Requires flexibility to work across time zones, agility in adapting to changing priorities, and commitment to continuous learning and knowledge sharing. Strong understanding of the Global Mobility framework and Talent Services strategy is required to align optimization efforts with business objectives.


Job Requirements
Education:
Bachelors degree in information systems, technology, business, or a related discipline is required.
Experience:
Experience in system optimization, automation, reporting, or process improvement within Global Mobility, HR, or Talent Services environments.
Certification Requirements:
No mandatory certifications; Power Platform or analytics-related certifications are considered an asset.

Job Summary
The GDS Alliance Operations Lead Analyst will operate from the GDS Alliances Program Operations CoE and provide structured operations, governance, stakeholder coordination, reporting, content management and execution support for the NVIDIA Alliance within the broader Global Alliances and Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The role will help alliance leadership run an effective, insight-led and scalable operating model by tracking priorities, managing operational cadence, improving process discipline and enabling timely execution of NVIDIA alliance initiatives across sell, build and deliver motions. The incumbent will work closely with alliance, market, finance, contracts, training, BMC and enablement stakeholders to strengthen delivery consistency, improve data and reporting quality, simplify ways of working and identify automation opportunities, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, enhance reporting narratives and improve operational outcomes.
Essential Functions of the Job
Serve as the central operations and PMO support point for assigned alliance activities, ensuring priorities, workstreams, owners, timelines, risks, dependencies and follow-ups are clearly captured, tracked and progressed with discipline.
Provide NVIDIA alliance leadership with timely business insights through structured reporting, dashboards and executive-ready narratives covering sales, pipeline, opportunity tagging, partner-sourced and co-sell activity, prospect tracking, key GTM wins, book of business movements, partner program measures and other performance indicators.
Support governance cadence for leadership meetings, QBRs, planning forums and operational reviews by developing agendas, storyboarding content, coordinating inputs, preparing meeting materials, capturing actions and tracking closure.
Maintain and continuously refresh alliance reference materials, SharePoint content, leadership-ready presentations, internal updates and other enablement assets to improve findability, consistency, relevance and adoption across stakeholder groups.
Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams to develop, review and maintain alliance-related content, ensuring alignment with messaging standards, stakeholder expectations and partner program requirements.
Program manage NVIDIA partner tools, portals and operational processes, including partner portal access request tracking, issue resolution, adoption monitoring, certification and skills currency tracking, training coordination and tool administration support.
Work with alliance investment, finance, legal and enablement teams to support NVIDIA Market Development Fund processes, investment tracking, compliance monitoring, quarterly reviews, documentation readiness, claims support and process adherence.
Support NVIDIA alliance contract and governance activities, including initiation and tracking of localization of global agreements, program documentation, partner distinction or specialization requirements and related compliance actions in collaboration with the Ecosystem Contracts team and relevant business stakeholders.
Partner with onshore NVIDIA alliance enablement contacts on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, stakeholder mapping, partner offering or marketplace coordination, event or sponsorship coordination, training interventions and other priority initiatives as required.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve alliance operations processes through process mapping, documentation, issue analysis, control strengthening, data quality improvement and adoption of reusable templates and playbooks.
Leverage automation and responsible AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to reduce repetitive manual activity, improve reporting turnaround time, support content drafting, enhance insight generation, improve follow-up tracking and enable scalable service delivery.
Manage stakeholder expectations, communication plans and delivery commitments with clarity, responsiveness and strong service orientation across global and regional teams.
Knowledge and Skill Requirements
Strong understanding of alliance, ecosystem or partner program operations, preferably in a professional services, technology, consulting, shared services, GCC or global capability center environment; exposure to NVIDIA, accelerated computing, AI platforms, enterprise technology or digital transformation ecosystems would be advantageous.
Working knowledge of sales, revenue, pipeline, opportunity lifecycle, partner program metrics, GTM motions, co-sell or referral activity, partner distinctions, specialization requirements and performance reporting, with the ability to interpret data and convert it into concise executive-ready insights.
Strong program and project management skills, including planning, tracking, governance cadence management, risk and dependency monitoring, action follow-up and management of multiple priorities with competing deadlines.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, workflow tools or other reporting and collaboration platforms considered an advantage.
Experience with continuous improvement, process simplification and operational excellence, including process mapping, SOP development, control documentation, audit readiness, root cause analysis and issue resolution.
Ability to identify automation opportunities and apply digital tools responsibly to improve productivity, reporting quality, follow-up discipline, knowledge management and stakeholder experience.
Practical exposure to generative AI tools for research, content development, summarization, insight generation, workflow support and productivity enhancement; preferable exposure to Agentic AI concepts, AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.
AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.
Strong stakeholder management capability, with the ability to engage senior onshore stakeholders, anticipate needs, manage expectations and build trusted advisor relationships across functions and geographies.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including business writing, executive presentation development, narrative building and the ability to create high-quality content with limited initial guidance.
Strong analytical thinking, problem solving, research capability and attention to detail, with the ability to work across multiple teams to drive practical and timely resolution.
Experience working in virtual, matrixed and multi-geography environments with cultural sensitivity, collaboration discipline and a global mindset.
Knowledge of EY and GDS operations, organization structure, operating model, management information systems and independence concepts for internal candidates; Big 4, consulting, technology or leadership support exposure for external candidates would be preferred.

MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent professional experience preferred.
Bachelors degree required; degree in business, technology, engineering, commerce, or a related discipline preferred.
Project/program management certification, process improvement certification, or relevant alliance, partner program, NVIDIA, technology partner or enterprise software certification would be an added advantage.
Relevant certifications or digital badges in generative AI, responsible AI, AI-enabled productivity, prompt engineering, automation, analytics, or Agentic AI concepts would be highly desirable, particularly where they demonstrate practical application in business operations, reporting, process improvement, knowledge management, or stakeholder enablement.
Experience
8+ years of progressive, relevant experience in alliance operations, program management, business operations, sales/GTM enablement.

Job Summary
I&O Platform Infrastructure Patching & Vulnerability Compliance Lead - Assistant Director | Enterprise Technology.
In EY Enterprise Technology, we are looking for an experienced and authoritative Patching and Vulnerability Compliance Lead to own and drive patching compliance, vulnerability management and security posture reporting across EY's entire I&O Platform Infrastructure estate. This is a senior cross-tower leadership role with accountability that spans every platform discipline Windows, Linux, Storage, Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI), Backup, Network, Facilities and associated managed services.
The role sits at the intersection of infrastructure operations, cybersecurity and executive reporting, and is a key leadership position within EY's Infrastructure Operations Centre (IOC). The successful candidate will serve as the firm's primary authority on infrastructure patching compliance, frontier AI risk response as it applies to infrastructure, and cross-tower SPI and SLA performance providing the visibility, governance and operational leadership needed to maintain a secure, compliant and well-managed global infrastructure estate.
Your key responsibilities
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Patching and Vulnerability Compliance Lead owns the end-to-end patching governance framework across all I&O platform towers, ensuring that vulnerability remediation commitments are met, compliance positions are accurately reported and exceptions are managed through a rigorous, risk-based process. This professional serves as the single point of accountability for patching SLA performance across Windows, Linux, Storage, HCI, Backup, Network and Facilities infrastructure domains.
Operating as a lead member of the Infrastructure Operations Centre (IOC), this role drives the weekly, monthly and quarterly compliance reporting cycle, chairs cross-tower patching forums, manages escalations from security and audit stakeholders, and leads the firm's response to frontier AI-related infrastructure risks ensuring that emerging AI-driven threat vectors are assessed, prioritized and remediated within agreed timelines. The Lead partners with tower engineering leads, security operations, risk and compliance teams, and senior I&O leadership to deliver a consistent, transparent and defensible compliance posture.
Skills and attributes for success
Broad knowledge of I&O Platform Infrastructure technologies across all towers, including:
Windows Server patching WSUS, SCCM/MECM, Windows Update for Business
Linux patching Red Hat Satellite, Ansible, YUM/DNF, APT-based tooling
Storage platform firmware and software lifecycle management
Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI) patching Azure Stack HCI, Nutanix, VMware
Backup platform patching Commvault, Veeam, Veritas or equivalent
Network device patching routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers
Facilities and data center infrastructure UPS, PDU, DCIM and environmental systems
Strong vulnerability management lifecycle experience from scan to remediation to compliance attestation (exclusionary).
Deep experience with vulnerability scanning tooling Qualys, Tenable Nessus, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent (exclusionary).
Experience leading patching governance forums and cross-tower compliance reviews.
Strong understanding of frontier AI infrastructure risks and the ability to assess, prioritize and respond to AI-driven vulnerability and threat intelligence.
Experience operating in and leading from within an Infrastructure Operations Centre (IOC) or equivalent 24x7 operations environment.
Strong SPI and SLA management capability; ability to define, track, report and drive remediation of patching and compliance KPIs across multiple platform towers.
Experience producing executive-level compliance dashboards and vulnerability posture reporting.
Strong knowledge of security and compliance frameworks relevant to infrastructure patching:
CIS Benchmarks
NIST SP 800-40
ISO 27001
SOC 2
CVSSv3/v4 scoring and prioritization
Experience managing patching exceptions, risk acceptances and compensating control documentation.
Ability to engage and influence tower engineering leads, security operations and senior leadership stakeholders.
Experience working with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) for change management, patch scheduling and compliance tracking.
Strong PowerShell or Python scripting capability for compliance reporting automation.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively across global engineering teams and time zones.
To qualify for the role, you must have experience with
Cross-platform patching governance and compliance program leadership 7+ years.
Vulnerability management lifecycle scan, triage, remediation, attestation 7+ years.
Windows Server patching at enterprise scale (WSUS, MECM, MDE) 7+ years.
Linux patching at enterprise scale (Satellite, Ansible, YUM/APT) 57 years.
HCI platform patching (Azure Stack HCI, Nutanix or VMware) 35 years.
Storage and backup platform firmware and software lifecycle management 35 years.
Network device patching governance across multi-vendor environments 35 years.
Vulnerability scanning tool administration (Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7 or equivalent) 57 years.
CVSSv3/v4 scoring, vulnerability prioritization and risk-based remediation planning.
SPI and SLA reporting for patching compliance across multiple infrastructure towers.
Executive compliance dashboard and posture reporting monthly and quarterly cycles.

IOC or NOC leadership presence cross-tower incident and compliance escalation management.
Frontier AI risk assessment as applied to infrastructure security posture (preferred).
Security framework alignment CIS, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2 (preferred).
PowerShell or Python automation for compliance reporting pipelines 35 years.

Job Summary
The Senior Oracle Database Administrator is accountable for the reliable, secure and efficient operation of Oracle database platforms supporting business-critical applications. The role combines hands-on database administration with engineering, troubleshooting, lifecycle management, security controls and close collaboration across application, infrastructure, security and DevOps teams.
The successful candidate will own operational database activities from installation and configuration through monitoring, performance optimization, backup and recovery, patching, upgrades and production support. The role also contributes database expertise to ensure that database changes are tested, documented, auditable and safely promoted through environments.


Your Key Responsibilities
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Core database administration
Install, create, configure and maintain Oracle databases on all environments
Administer database instances, schemas, storage, tablespaces, parameters, listeners, services and connectivity in line with agreed standards.
Plan and execute database patching, version upgrades and technical maintenance, including prerequisite checks, rollback planning, validation and evidence capture.
Execute database and schema refreshes across environments using approved native tools and controlled procedures.
Maintain accurate operational documentation, configuration records, runbooks and technical procedures.


Performance, availability and resilience
Monitor database health, capacity, availability and performance; identify trends and address risks before they affect service quality.
Perform database performance tuning, investigate bottlenecks and optimize configuration, queries, indexes and resource utilization where appropriate.
Design, operate and test backup, restore and recovery procedures using Oracle RMAN, and ensure recovery evidence is retained.
Operate and troubleshoot high-availability and disaster-recovery capabilities, especially Oracle Data Guard; experience with RAC, ASM and Grid Infrastructure is beneficial.
Support capacity planning, housekeeping, availability reviews and disaster-recovery exercises for critical database services.


Security, access and audit
Implement database security controls, including user and role administration, least-privilege access, authentication integration and segregation of duties.
Administer encryption controls such as Transparent Data Encryption and file-system-level encryption, as well as encrypted database connections.
Review vulnerability assessment findings, assess database impact and apply required remediation or patches through controlled change processes.
Configure and maintain database auditing and reporting mechanisms, and provide traceable evidence for reviews and audits.
Troubleshoot Oracle network configuration, listener issues, certificates, connection encryption and authentication problems.


Delivery, Operations and Collaboration
Operational support and service management
Provide advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for database incidents, performance degradation, failed jobs, connectivity issues and application errors.
Participate in incident, problem, change and release processes; communicate technical status, risk, impact and remediation clearly.
Support planned maintenance and, where required by the operating model, on-call or out-of-hours activities for critical services.
Work with application teams to translate business and technical requirements into supportable database solutions.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cloud, network, security and identity teams to resolve cross-platform issues.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administration, monitoring, configuration and deployment activities using scripting and configuration-management tools.
Contribute to standards, reusable procedures, knowledge transfer and continuous improvement of database operations.


Expected deliverables
Deliverable
Operational documentation
Change artefacts
Health and performance outputs
Security and compliance evidence
Knowledge transfer


Typical content
Runbooks, configuration standards, recovery procedures and troubleshooting guides
Implementation plan, test evidence, rollback plan, approvals and post-change validation
Monitoring findings, capacity observations, tuning recommendations and incident analysis
Access reviews, patch evidence, vulnerability remediation, encryption and audit records

Job Summary
De NCLC Manager Technology Consulting
EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant Manager with strong subject matter expertise in SharePoint, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex modernization. The role will lead teams delivering large Microsoft 365 migration and modernization programs for clients across regions.


Job Overview
We are looking for a client-focused technology leader who can shape and deliver Microsoft 365 transformation engagements. The role combines solution leadership, delivery management, stakeholder engagement and team development, with a preference for candidates who have led large-scale migration or modernization programs.


Your key responsibilities
Lead Microsoft 365 migration and modernization projects across SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, workflows and forms.
Provide technical leadership for SharePoint Online, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations, Nintex and Power Platform.
Define the delivery approach, estimates, migration waves, resourcing, governance and quality controls.
Lead assessments, identify risks and dependencies, and develop practical migration roadmaps.
Guide migration factory setup, pilots, wave execution, cutover and transition.
Oversee Nintex workflow and form modernization using Nintex Automation Cloud or Power Platform.
Review solution designs, migration plans, remediation approaches and deployment documents.
Lead delivery teams, remove blockers, monitor progress and maintain quality.
Manage client, security, Microsoft and vendor stakeholders, decisions and dependencies.
Support proposals, demonstrations, estimates, staffing plans and executive presentations.
Promote reusable methods, automation and continuous improvement.
Ensure compliance with security, quality, organizational and commercial requirements.


Skills and attributes
9-12 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
Strong SME-level knowledge of SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server, SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell and Microsoft 365 architecture.
Proven experience planning and delivering large Microsoft 365 migration programs involving SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
Experience with migration assessment, remediation, migration factory operations, wave planning, velocity management, cutover and hypercare.
Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.


Good to have Skills
Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.
Relevant Microsoft, Nintex, project management or agile certifications.


Soft Skills
Ability to lead, motivate and develop high-performing teams across locations.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
Ability to balance quality, timelines and cost.
Sound decision-making and problem-solving in complex situations.
Ability to manage scope, schedules, risks, quality and competing priorities.
Collaborative leadership with clear accountability for outcomes.
Ability to review technical deliverables, challenge assumptions and guide consultants and engineers.


To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelor\'s or master\'s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, preferably in a professional services or consulting organization.
Strong Microsoft 365 and SharePoint migration or modernization expertise.
Proven experience leading teams and delivering complex technology engagements.
Experience developing estimates, delivery plans, governance and stakeholder communications.


Ideally, youll also have
Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
Led large-scale Microsoft 365 migration or modernization projects from discovery through transition.
Managed multidisciplinary teams covering migration, development, workflow modernization, testing and change activities.
Contributed to proposals, solutioning, capability development and client relationship growth.

Job Summary
Microsoft is one of EYs most strategic ecosystem relationships, enabling clients to accelerate transformation through cloud, data, AI, automation and emerging technologies. Within this alliance, the Co-Innovation team brings together EYs industry experience and Microsofts technology capabilities to shape scalable, market-relevant solutions that support client transformation, marketplace readiness and growth across global priority markets.
We are looking for a highly collaborative, commercially minded and execution-oriented Marketplace Certification Manager / Strategist to support the Microsoft Alliance Co-Innovation team globally. This role will help lead and build the marketplace solution readiness, certification and publication lifecycle, strengthen submission governance, guide readiness across priority solutions and enable disciplined execution across the global co-innovation portfolio.
The role is designed for a senior professional who can connect solution development, certification strategy and commercialization readiness. You will work closely with global alliance leadership, Microsoft stakeholders, regional teams, solution owners, architects, engineering teams, sales, marketing and GDS teams to ensure co-innovation solutions are certification-ready, marketplace-aligned and positioned for scalable activation across markets.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of Microsoft marketplace operations, certification governance, AI-enabled innovation, solution commercialization, stakeholder management and go-to-market execution.


Your key responsibilities

Shape global marketplace certification strategy, governance and operating rhythm
Lead and build the structured solution intake, certification and publication lifecycle process for the global Co-Innovation portfolio, providing senior-level visibility into readiness, submissions, review status, risks, dependencies, decisions and publication outcomes.
Shape certification review meetings, leadership updates, business reviews and marketplace readiness forums with clear, consistent and decision-oriented materials.
Maintain a structured view of marketplace certification activities across solution stages, submission status, ownership, evidence requirements, remediation actions and publication milestones.
Drive execution discipline by helping stakeholders track actions, owners, timelines, dependencies and follow-through against agreed certification priorities.
Identify and advance opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows, automation, reusable templates and structured data capture to accelerate intake, evidence development, certification readiness, publication preparation and reporting.
Ensure certification decisions and updates are supported by accurate data, clear documentation and well-aligned next steps.


Define Microsoft marketplace readiness and certification focus
Provide strategic guidance on certification readiness for Microsoft-powered solutions across Azure, Copilot, AI Business Solutions, Cloud AI Platforms, Security, data, automation and emerging technology priorities.
Partner with solution owners, architects and technology stakeholders to capture certification requirements, readiness gaps, technical evidence, client applicability and commercialization considerations.
Build senior-level visibility into marketplace-ready solution assets, including offer narratives, demos, supporting documentation, solution artifacts, client-zero examples and go-to-market readiness materials.
Promote responsible AI adoption by ensuring marketplace submissions appropriately consider value, risk, governance, data requirements, privacy, security and adoption needs.
Translate Microsoft marketplace, certification and technology requirements into business-friendly narratives for global leadership, regional teams, sales and stakeholder groups.


Strengthen certification compliance, submission quality and technical assurance
Lead marketplace certification reviews, submission walkthroughs and operational checkpoints across prioritized global co-innovation initiatives.
Assess certification readiness across offer positioning, solution scope, technical documentation, security considerations, data flows, implementation approach, support model and customer-facing content.
Coordinate with alliance, technology, solution, delivery, marketing and commercial teams to maintain visibility across certification decisions, dependencies and required remediation actions.
Help assess whether solutions are progressing toward intended outcomes, including certification readiness, publication readiness, activation potential, adoption feasibility and global market relevance.
Prepare concise leadership summaries covering certification status, marketplace risks, remediation needs, required publication decisions and recommended actions.


Influence global stakeholder alignment and collaboration
Serve as a senior connector across global alliance leadership, Microsoft marketplace stakeholders, regional teams, solution owners, architects, engineering teams, service line leaders, sector stakeholders, sales, marketing and GDS support teams.
Support alignment across business, technology, delivery, marketing and go-to-market stakeholders so global priorities are translated into executable marketplace certification actions.
Coordinate certification readiness workshops, marketplace forums and leadership check-ins to ensure progress is visible and decision points are clear.
Proactively identify stakeholder gaps, ownership ambiguities and cross-team dependencies that could affect certification readiness, publication timelines or market activation across regions.
Build trusted relationships across a matrixed global and regional stakeholder network.


Shape marketplace reporting, insights and readiness tracking
Develop and maintain certification trackers, publication readiness summaries and executive views that provide clear visibility into global co-innovation certification health and progress.
Monitor key indicators related to certification stage, readiness gaps, submission quality, remediation status, publication progress, asset completeness, activation readiness and business outcomes.
Analyze trends across certification activities and provide practical recommendations to improve submission quality, governance and go-to-market impact.
Prepare materials for leadership reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews and other global governance forums.
Use data and stakeholder input to tell a clear story on where certification activity is progressing well, where support is required and where leadership decisions are needed.


Advance global marketplace activation readiness and market outcomes
Work with sales, marketing, regional and solution teams to support activation planning for certified and marketplace ready co-innovation solutions.
Track readiness of marketplace and solution assets, including offer descriptions, demos, architecture diagrams, credentials, case studies, sales collateral, enablement materials, marketplace content and client-facing narratives.
Help identify opportunities to scale successful marketplace-certified Microsoft-powered solutions across priority accounts, sectors, service lines and regions.
Support coordination of global and region-specific enablement activities so client-facing teams understand the marketplace offer, value proposition, certification status and activation pathway.
Ensure certification insights and lessons learned are fed back to solution teams to strengthen commercialization, adoption and governance discipline.

Job Summary
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.


Competency
Client Excellence Account Excellence


Role Type
Senior Account Coordinator


The opportunity
Senior Associate at CI team supports the Account Manager and the Account Leadership team; Global Client serving Partner, Global Client Executive to develop and manage relevant activities on designated Priority accounts. The Senior Account Coordinator will be expected to provide high quality and insightful support to account teams on Go-to-market activities. The Senior Account Coordinator will build network across the account leadership and within GDS to develop account knowledge to benefit the regional/global Account team and our relationship and business with the client.


Your key responsibilities

Account Management
Own account reporting and ensure relevant stakeholders receive and understand reported data
In liaison with the Client Service Partner and Director, own the account planning process and ensure regular reviews against planned milestones and targets.
Understand the strategic communication and stakeholder engagement requirements to progress the account plan agenda, and work with global teams to respond and deploy
Provide relevant knowledge to Account teams focus on dissemination of business analysis and research, competitive intelligence and relevant firm thought leadership
To liaise and work with onshore account teams and internal business services groups to scope new support requirements, build processes for the execution of account management tasks, and ensure effective transition of work to the remote GDS support platform


Client Relationship Development
Contribute to complex account and business development needs, including global account planning, go-to-market research and strategy, pursuit or sales support, pitch development, among others
Work with BMC point of contact to plan and execute marketing initiatives that directly drive revenue
Accelerate strategy execution, particularly around prioritized Regions and strategic solutions.
Understand market trends, what is on our clients' agenda and how these translate into revenue generating opportunities.Monitor solution revenue to understand success, opportunities, underperformance
Communication
Coordinate with global network of regional account team meetings. Send updated account and sector content and information.
Develop and maintain relationships with service lines, Accounts, Market Segments, Emerging Markets and subsectors to serve as a two-way conduit for connection and communication
Responsible for working to develop high impact relationships and embedding ABD support into the processes of the accounts
Responsible for project management, quality control, review of deliverables, and for embedding the principles of exceptional client service of being connected, responsive and insightful in our support to the account teams and ABD stakeholders
Facilitation of knowledge sharing


Your skills and attributes for success
Succinct and structured oral and written communications skills with proven ability to explain complex concepts in a crisp, clear, concise, and graphic-rich style, using appropriate analytics and visualization tools.
Experience in Account Management and preparing sales and pipeline reporting, as well as providing insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients
Experience in Microsoft tools like excel and PPT


To qualify for the role, you must have
Any Graduate
4-8 years' experience in Account management and data reporting and analysis
Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
Demonstrated strong written and oral communication skills
Ability to use both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis methodologies, including financial analysis skills, to synthesize information, review data inputs and provide analytic insights


Ideally, youll also have
Account Management and data reporting skills
Exposure to tools like Tableau, PowerBi etc.
Credible experience working in a fast-moving, client-driven environment


Technologies and Tools
Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services
Experience using Procurement portals (i.e., SAP Fieldglass or Ariba)


What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
A professional with strong interpersonal skills - confidence, maturity ability to build strong client relationships

Job Summary

Role title CRM Specialist Supervising Associate
Position Summary: The CRM Specialist (Supervising Associate) will own CRM opportunity tracking across Quantum/Physical AI/Other initiatives within EYs Next Frontier workstream. The role will drive pipeline visibility, weekly reporting, conversion analysis and data accuracy to support strategic decisions and revenue growth.
The role requires strong working knowledge of EY CRM and sales processes, advanced Excel skills, and the ability to translate pipeline data into clear insights for leadership and workstream teams. Experience generating reports using AI tools is preferred; Power BI is not required.


Responsibilities
Manage CRM opportunity tracking across Quantum/Physical/Other AI initiatives.
Maintain accurate pipeline data, opportunity status and ownership details.
Produce weekly CRM pipeline reports for leadership and workstream teams.
Analyse conversion from opportunity creation to closed sales.
Identify pipeline trends, risks and follow-up actions.
Reconcile CRM data with workstream inputs and sales updates.
Support revenue visibility by tracking progression, ageing and close probability.
Prepare clear summaries, dashboards or Excel views for decision-making.
Partner with sales, operations and initiative leads to improve data quality.
Use AI tools to speed up report generation and insight development.


CRM Opportunity Tracking
Track opportunities across Quantum and Physical AI workstreams.
Maintain opportunity stage, value, probability and close date accuracy.
Follow up with owners to resolve missing or outdated CRM data.
Monitor pipeline movement, blockers and items needing leadership attention.
Support weekly review routines with clear CRM inputs and insights.
Maintain a structured tracker for open, won, lost and stalled opportunities.
Ensure CRM records reflect agreed sales and workstream updates.


Pipeline Reporting and Insights
Generate weekly pipeline visibility reports using Excel and CRM exports.
Analyse opportunity conversion, ageing, win/loss movement and pipeline health.
Highlight trends that may impact revenue, forecasting or prioritisation.
Provide concise insights for Next Frontier leadership discussions.
Summarise key changes, risks and recommended actions.
Support ad hoc reporting requests for Quantum and Physical AI initiatives.
Use AI tools where helpful to draft summaries and improve reporting speed.


CRM Process and Stakeholder Support
Apply EY CRM and sales process knowledge to improve consistency.
Support initiative leads with CRM hygiene and reporting expectations.
Align reporting definitions across operations, sales and workstream teams.
Maintain simple documentation for reporting steps and data definitions.
Identify process improvement opportunities in pipeline tracking.
Coordinate with global stakeholders across time zones when required.


Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Strong knowledge of EY CRM and sales processes.
Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivots and structured reporting.
Ability to analyse sales pipeline data and explain clear business insights.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Experience preparing weekly reports for senior stakeholders.
Good understanding of opportunity stages, pipeline health and sales conversion.
Ability to identify trends, risks and follow-up actions from CRM data.
Comfortable working with AI tools to improve reporting and summaries.
Clear written and verbal communication skills.


Education and Experience
Bachelors or Masters degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Operations, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
58+ years of relevant experience in CRM, sales operations, pipeline management, business operations or reporting.
Experience working with CRM systems and sales process data.
Experience producing recurring reports, dashboards or Excel-based insights.
Experience supporting leadership reviews or revenue pipeline discussions.
Exposure to emerging technology, innovation or consulting environments is preferred.
Experience using AI tools for reporting, summarisation or analysis is preferred.
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and recurring reporting deadlines.
Willingness to work with global teams and support overlap with US hours when needed.

EY Managed Services empowers clients by transforming noncore yet essential activities into streamlined efficient processes. Our easy-to-integrate solutions and deep expertise alleviate the burdens faced in critical areas such as tax, risk, compliance, and finance.
