We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Supervising Associate to join our Global Managed Services team. This role supports strategic and operational decision making through data and insightful business analysis. The role has to understand business needs and collaborate with other Finance team members to bring best in class analytical support and solutions. The ability to understand and curate large data sets, present analysis and results through storytelling and problem solving is vital.


Your key responsibilities
Supporting financial and business analysis while supporting Managed Services Leaders and act as a trusted business adviser. Develop effective working relationships with the extended Finance team and leadership.
Focus on traditional performance management while also contributing to establishing 'next generation' reporting frameworks.
Support the development, management, and delivery of comprehensive performance reporting and financial analysis related to Managed services initiatives.
Analyze business performance by creating and maintaining dashboards, reports, and presentations that enable business leaders to quickly understand performance and underlying drivers.
Provide ad-hoc financial modeling and analysis services to GMS leadership in support of business planning and strategic and operational decision-making
Collaborate across EY (Super Regions, Service Lines, Finance, and Markets) to deliver one source of truth for Global Managed services performance.
Support the development of a suite of short and medium-term forecasting activities
Utilize EY's Opportunity and Engagement data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities that impact business growth and client delivery.
Support continuous improvement in data quality, reporting tools, and analytical methodologies.
Support issue management and resolution, ensuring delivery of exceptional client service to stakeholders.
Ensure compliance with EY's financial policies and governance standards.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong analytical skills, focused on analysis, advice, and solutions that drive achievement of goals.
Strong understanding of EY's business model, finance processes, and tools.
Ability to interpret data, assess its value, and present concise findings to stakeholders
Comfortable supporting new business models and innovative views into the business.

Advanced Excel, data modelling, Power BI PowerPoint skills - ability to understand and curate large data sets, present analysis and results through story-telling and problem solving is vital.

Graduate and/or professional certification in a business-related subject matter (e.g., Accounting, Finance).
A minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in finance or business analysis, preferably within professional services.
Advanced skills in financial/markets reporting, data analysis, and performance measurement.
Experienced in data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Analysis Servers, Excel).

Job Summary
The GDS Cyber Alliances Operations Specialist is a Manager-level role within the GDS Alliances Partner Operations CoE, designed to strengthen how EYs Cyber Alliance ecosystem is operationalized, governed, measured, and scaled. The role will serve as a trusted operations and insights partner to Cyber Alliance stakeholders by bringing together disciplined execution, partner program enablement, data-led decision support, process excellence, and stakeholder orchestration. This position will help translate Cyber Alliance priorities into clear operating rhythms, actionable insights, improved adoption of partner programs, stronger pipeline and opportunity discipline, and measurable business impact across EYs Cyber Alliance agenda.


Responsibilities
Act as a Manager-level operations partner for Cyber Alliances, driving disciplined execution across governance cadences, stakeholder requests, delivery commitments, action tracking, issue resolution, and operational follow-through.
Convert Cyber Alliance data into actionable business insight by analyzing revenue, sales, pipeline, opportunity, partner program, certification, enablement, and stakeholder activity to highlight trends, risks, gaps, and growth opportunities.
Build and enhance leadership-ready dashboards, scorecards, insight packs, and executive views that move beyond reporting to provide clear interpretation, business context, recommended actions, and progress visibility.
Strengthen Cyber Alliance pipeline and opportunity management by improving alliance tagging, data quality, pursuit tracking, account and prospect visibility, book-of-business hygiene, escalation management, and performance analysis.
Lead operational enablement for partner programs, including tool and portal administration, access governance, certification and competency tracking, enablement participation, partner program requirements, and stakeholder support.
Drive a strong continuous process improvement agenda across Cyber Alliance operations by simplifying processes, standardizing ways of working, improving controls, reducing manual effort, strengthening documentation, and proactively identifying opportunities for automation, workflow redesign, and Agentic AI-enabled productivity, decision support, and service quality improvements.
Maintain high-quality operational knowledge assets, including process guides, partner program materials, reference repositories, enablement content, stakeholder trackers, and operating documentation that improve adoption and service consistency.
Enable high-impact Cyber Ecosystem and Alliance leadership forums through crisp agendas, insightful pre-reads, decision-oriented content, action logs, outcome documentation, and timely follow-through.
Support strategic engagements between EY Cyber leadership and alliance partners by coordinating briefing materials, stakeholder inputs, meeting logistics, priority topics, next steps, and decision records.
Coordinate with Alliances Investment, Cyber Alliance, Legal, Finance, Compliance, and enablement teams to support Market Development Funds, investment requests, reimbursements, governance reviews, approval workflows, and process adherence.
Partner with onshore Cyber Alliance Enablement contacts to advance strategic projects, operating model enhancements, reporting modernization, stakeholder communications, process transformation, and leadership-driven priorities.
Support global agreement localization, partner program obligations, operational reviews, and related documentation in partnership with Ecosystem Contracts and relevant internal teams.
Manage stakeholder expectations with maturity by ensuring responsiveness, clarity, prioritization, escalation discipline, delivery transparency, and a consistently high-quality service experience.


Knowledge and Skills
Strong understanding of alliance operations, cyber or technology services, partner ecosystems, opportunity life cycles, sales enablement, professional services operations, and GCC/shared services delivery models.
High comfort with data-led business operations, including the ability to interpret operational, pipeline, financial, certification, enablement, and stakeholder data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
Ability to create compelling executive narratives, insight packs, dashboards, briefings, and business reviews that connect operational performance to strategic Cyber Alliance priorities.
Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint; Power BI, SQL, workflow automation, data visualization, process mining, AI-enabled productivity tools, and practical use of Agentic AI or copilots for operational execution, insight generation, knowledge management, and productivity improvement will be strong differentiators.
Strong continuous improvement orientation with experience in process simplification, operating model design, SOP development, documentation, controls, quality reviews, governance, and service delivery optimization.
Working knowledge of Agentic AI concepts, responsible AI usage, prompt design, AI-assisted workflow orchestration, automation opportunity identification, human-in-the-loop controls, data quality considerations, and practical governance requirements for using AI in enterprise operations.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior Cyber Alliance stakeholders, Cyber practice leaders, alliance partner contacts, and cross-functional teams confidently and credibly.
Proven ability to operate effectively in a virtual, global, cross-border environment with cultural sensitivity, responsiveness, collaboration discipline, and sound professional judgment.
Strong problem-solving, issue management, root cause analysis, research, prioritization, and mitigation skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and bring practical solutions to closure.

Control operational costs and improvise tools or equipment to improve overall operational efficiency and scale.

Business unit specific description - PE CoE (UKI)
The Private Equity Center of Excellence supports the firm in managing independence, compliance and regulatory requirements associated with major UK-headquartered private equity groups and their portfolio entities. The team helps protect the firm by proactively monitoring proposed engagements and business relationships across service lines and supporting compliance with applicable SEC, EU, UK and EY independence requirements.
The Supervising Associate combines hands-on delivery with day-to-day team oversight across assigned PE accounts. The role coordinates regulatory procedures, account structures, research, reporting and stakeholder actions while maintaining high standards of accuracy, timeliness, documentation and professional judgement. The individual works closely with Market Segment Managers, account teams, Partners, senior management and internal risk stakeholders, and provides clear updates, practical guidance and timely escalation of issues.


Your key responsibilities
Lead day-to-day delivery across assigned PE accounts and related workstreams, taking ownership of priorities, timelines, dependencies and outcomes.
Support quarterly Independence Summary Memo procedures, including the initial review of submissions and supporting documentation to confirm required procedures are completed.
Establish and maintain account-level structures, trackers and documentation that enable account teams to meet regulatory and independence requirements.
Reconcile relevant systems and account information to confirm PE group and portfolio structures are accurately reflected.
Monitor press releases, industry announcements and research sources for acquisitions, disposals and other changes affecting focus accounts.
Support public and private company independence procedures for acquisitions and respond to general independence queries relating to PE accounts.
Plan and allocate work across team members, monitor progress and capacity, and ensure agreed deliverables are completed on time.
Perform detailed quality reviews, challenge incomplete or inconsistent outputs and ensure review points are resolved before submission.
Act as a key contact for routine stakeholder matters, communicate status clearly, manage expectations and escalate complex issues or risks promptly.
Facilitate team and stakeholder discussions, convert decisions into clear actions, assign ownership and drive follow-through to closure.
Collate leadership action points and support program and project coordination, management information and workload visibility.

Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to analyse synthesize, and clearly present research findings and insights to stakeholders.
Prior exposure to account, client, or master data management systems, along with experience using account or relationship management platforms.
Experience supporting compliance processes, including compliance work papers, due diligence activities, checklists, governance reviews, and policy adherence.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks, SEC guidelines, compliance policies, risk management, or governance-related activities. Exposure to AML, financial crime or stock market-related domains would be considered as an added advantage.
Experience with SharePoint content management, newsletters, surveys or knowledge repositories.
Experience using automation, artificial intelligence or emerging technologies to improve process efficiency, data quality and business insight.
Strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and understand the objectives of different programs and initiatives.

High degree of professionalism, integrity and sound judgement.


To qualify for the role, you must have
A graduate or postgraduate qualification in Business Administration, Finance, Information and Data Science, or a related discipline.
Approximately 8 to 12 years of relevant experience in financial services, professional services, business process management, consulting, research and/or corporate strategy.
Demonstrated experience coordinating projects, reviewing deliverables and working effectively with multiple stakeholders.
Proven ability to analyse information, produce high-quality reports or presentations and communicate clear business insights.
Experience supporting business leaders or leadership groups in a deadline-driven environment.

A delivery-focused professional who can balance hands-on execution with team oversight, prioritization, review and stakeholder communication.

Function: GDS ES Growth Innovation
Skill Level: Strategic Leadership
Sub Function: GDS Alliances Partner Operations CoE


The Opportunity
EY GDS Growth Innovation enables EY's strategic ecosystem relationships, market activation priorities and alliance-led growth programs. The Mistral alliance brings together EY's industry, transformation, risk and responsible AI capabilities with Mistral AI's enterprise AI platform, open and commercial models, and flexible deployment approaches. The alliance requires a senior operations leader who can connect joint strategy, governance, commercialization, enablement, investment oversight and multi-geo execution through a disciplined global operating model.
The GDS Mistral Alliance Operations Strategist is an Associate Director-level role responsible for defining and driving the business management, governance and execution strategy for the EY-Mistral alliance. The role serves as the operational counterpart to global alliance leadership, translating joint priorities into scalable plans, measurable outcomes and coordinated execution across go-to-market, solution development, sales activation, delivery readiness, marketing, enablement and alliance investment programs.
Operating from GDS, this role will orchestrate consistent support across regions and service lines while maintaining clear interfaces with EY and Mistral stakeholders. It combines strategic planning, alliance business management, program leadership and executive influence with working knowledge of enterprise generative AI, sovereign and private deployment considerations, model and platform lifecycle management, responsible AI, security, regulatory obligations and the fast-moving economics of AI solutions.


Responsibilities
Own and continuously mature the global operating model, governance framework and business management processes for the EY-Mistral alliance.
Translate joint alliance priorities into annual and quarterly operating plans, execution roadmaps, decision rights, milestones and measurable business outcomes.
Design and run executive governance forums, steering committees, pipeline and performance reviews, and working cadences involving EY and Mistral leadership.
Develop alliance scorecards and executive insight packs covering pipeline, bookings, influenced revenue, solution maturity, client adoption, delivery capacity, enablement, investments, risks and outcomes.
Coordinate joint go-to-market planning, account activation, campaigns, events, thought leadership, case studies and priority pursuits across regions and sectors.
Support the lifecycle of Mistral-enabled offerings from ideation and business case through solution approval, readiness, launch, field adoption and performance improvement.
Build repeatable GDS services, playbooks, intake processes, service levels, knowledge assets and escalation paths for alliance, sales and delivery stakeholders.
Coordinate capability building across Mistral AI models, APIs, enterprise platform capabilities, agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, model customization and cloud, VPC, on-premises or edge deployment patterns.
Embed responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, intellectual property, data residency, model risk and applicable regulatory considerations into alliance operating processes, with specialist teams retaining accountability for formal approvals.
Maintain visibility of model, platform and commercial changes; assess operational impacts and coordinate updates to enablement, offerings, controls, contracts and stakeholder communications.
Manage alliance investments, forecasts, budgets, resource plans, benefits realization and supporting evidence in collaboration with finance, commercial and alliance leadership.
Orchestrate execution across alliance, technology, consulting, industry, risk, legal, procurement, finance, marketing, sales and delivery teams in a complex global matrix.
Identify bottlenecks, dependencies and execution risks early, establish remediation plans and provide decision-ready recommendations to alliance leaders.
Drive automation and data quality improvements across pipeline reporting, governance workflows, knowledge management, enablement tracking and leadership reporting.

Job Summary
DE NCLC Senior Technology Consulting
EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant with strong capabilities in SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex. The resource will be part of the Enterprise Content Management and Modern Workplace team, delivering solutions to clients across regions.


The opportunity
We are looking for professionals with expertise in Microsoft 365 consulting, migration and modernization to join our AI Workforce Consulting team. This is an opportunity to contribute to large transformation programs while supporting the growth of our Microsoft 365 service offerings.


Your key responsibilities
Work with client and project teams to understand business requirements, current-state environments and modernization objectives.
Design and deliver SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 solutions using SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP and PowerShell.
Plan and execute Microsoft 365 migrations, including SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams workloads, with appropriate assessment, remediation, testing and cutover activities.
Assess and modernize Nintex workflows and forms, including Nintex for SharePoint and Nintex Automation Cloud.
Prepare technical designs, migration plans, mapping documents, test scripts, deployment guides and operational handover documentation.
Troubleshoot migration, workflow, solution and integration issues, escalating risks and dependencies when required.
Ensure deliverables comply with project standards, security requirements, governance processes and technical design principles.
Support estimates, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts and technical discussions with stakeholders.
Develop reusable assets, accelerators and best practices for Microsoft 365 migration and modernization engagements.
Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.


Skills and attributes
5-8 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
Strong hands-on experience with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), TypeScript, React, Fluent UI, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
Good knowledge of SharePoint Online architecture, information architecture, permissions, content types, site designs and governance concepts.
Experience in Microsoft 365 migrations covering SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Teams, including discovery, assessment, remediation, migration execution, validation and cutover.
Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
Ability to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.


Good to have Skills
Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.


Soft Skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
Self-starter with a strong drive to learn and adopt new technologies
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
Good presentation and client-facing skills
Ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams
Collaborative team player with a positive and constructive approach


To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
A minimum of 5 years of relevant Microsoft 365, SharePoint, migration or modernization experience.
Demonstrable hands-on expertise in SPFx and Microsoft 365 migration delivery.
Practical experience with Nintex workflows and forms.
Strong consulting, documentation and stakeholder communication skills.


Ideally, youll also have
Experience in a professional services or consulting organization.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams and translate complex requirements into manageable deliverables.
Ability to operate independently with minimum supervision and support junior team members.

Role & responsibilities
This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Delhi & Rajasthan. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory.

The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.
Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders.
Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.

Preferred candidate profile

Required Knowledge and Experience:

High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
OR Associates Degree AND 6+ years experience
OR Bachelors Degree AND 4+ years experience

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY - Risk Consulting - Senior Consultant, Regulatory Compliance
As part of Risk Consulting, you will support and deliver regulatory compliance engagements focused on sector-specific regulatory gap reviews, assessments, compliance monitoring and remediation across the MENA region. You will work with clients across banking, sovereign wealth funds, government, infrastructure, energy and other regulated sectors to strengthen compliance processes, systems and controls.
The opportunity
We are looking for a motivated regulatory compliance professional to join our Risk Management team. This is an opportunity to contribute to high-quality regulatory gap assessments, compliance reviews and remediation programmes, strengthen your consulting capabilities and help clients translate regulatory requirements into practical actions. The position will be based in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will gain experience in regulatory gap assessments, regulatory obligation analysis, risk and control mapping, compliance testing, regulatory change, inspections, remediation and stakeholder advisory across varied industries and operating environments.
Your key responsibilities
As part of the role, you will lead and support responsibilities across the following areas:
Regulatory Gap Assessments
Conduct regulatory gap assessments against applicable MENA and international requirements, including CBUAE, SAMA, Basel, AML/KYC, Consumer Protection, FATCA/CRS and relevant ISO standards.
Assess the design and operating effectiveness of compliance processes, systems and controls, and identify gaps and enhancement opportunities.
Develop clear findings, risk-rated observations, practical recommendations and remediation roadmaps aligned with regulatory expectations and business priorities.
Support regulatory remediation programmes and broader compliance and enterprise risk transformation initiatives.
Monitor key regulatory compliance risks and support the development and tracking of proportionate mitigation actions.
Regulatory Framework Reviews
Analyse new and amended regulations, determine their applicability and business impact, and provide practical guidance on implementation.
Develop regulatory inventories, obligation registers, risk and control matrices, compliance checklists and testing strategies tailored to local regulatory frameworks.
Assist clients in preparing for regulatory inspections, supervisory reviews, information requests and onsite visits.
Draft and communicate regulatory updates, guidance notes, compliance reports and executive presentations.
Support the delivery of compliance training sessions in line with clients compliance training programmes.
Sector-Specific Compliance Assessments
Apply regulatory requirements to the operating context of banking, sovereign wealth funds, government, infrastructure, energy and other regulated sectors.
Present assessment results and recommendations to senior management, CXOs and audit or risk committees.
Assist in managing working relationships with regulatory authorities and, where relevant, law enforcement bodies.
Manage assigned workstreams, coordinate information requests and stakeholder meetings, and deliver high-quality outputs within the agreed scope and timelines.
Review the work of junior team members and support their coaching and development.
Contribute to proposals, credentials, methodologies, thought leadership and other business development initiatives.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong understanding of regulatory compliance frameworks, obligation management, risk and control assessment, compliance monitoring and remediation.
Working knowledge of CBUAE, SAMA, Basel, AML/KYC, Consumer Protection and governance requirements, with the ability to interpret their practical implications.
Ability to analyse regulations, policies, processes and evidence, identify gaps and convert findings into clear, risk-based recommendations.
Strong report writing, presentation, stakeholder interviewing and workshop facilitation skills, including confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
Effective project coordination skills, with the ability to manage assigned workstreams and multiple priorities within tight deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Attention to detail, professional scepticism and a commitment to quality and regulatory integrity.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with data analytics, Power BI or GRC and compliance platforms would be advantageous.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelor s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Law, Engineering or a related discipline.
Four to eight years of relevant experience in regulatory compliance, internal audit, risk management or conduct review programmes across banking, financial services, government, infrastructure, energy or other regulated sectors.
Experience within a bank, regulator, consulting firm, financial institution or comparable regulated organisation.
Practical experience conducting regulatory gap assessments, developing risk and control matrices or testing strategies, and supporting remediation activities.
Experience working with cross-functional teams and interacting with client, business or regulatory stakeholders.
Ideally, you ll also have
A relevant professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CIA and/or CAMS.
Prior consulting or professional-services experience.
MENA regional experience involving CBUAE, SAMA or other local regulators.
Experience preparing executive-level compliance reports, regulatory updates or audit and risk committee materials.
Arabic language capability, where relevant to client engagements in the MENA region.
Mobility and travel
Willingness and ability to travel to client locations at short notice, with an expected onsite travel requirement of up to 75%.
A valid passport and ability to meet applicable travel requirements.
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You will work on inspiring and meaningful projects, supported by education, coaching and practical experience. We value our people and provide opportunities to shape your development through challenging assignments, knowledge exchange and collaboration. We offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues.
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that is right for you.

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Career Family
GDS Risk Management Services

Role Type
Associate Analyst/Analyst

Competency
Alliance Ecosystem_ BRIDGE Support
Associate Analyst / Analyst - Independence - Risk Management Services
This role requires the candidate to conduct research and execute global Independence processes aligned with EY Global (EYG) policies. These processes aim to safeguard EYs independence by assisting professionals in complying with the firms personal Independence policies. The candidate will monitor business relationship to identify and report potential conflicts of interest with business teams. Additionally, this role involves providing coordinated support to EY professionals by answering their inquiries and questions on various country and personal Independence-related topics
The opportunity
Risk Management Services (RMS) is an internal function within EY GDS (Global Delivery services), responsible for protecting the organization from the risks that may arise from its professional practice. We work closely with all parts of the organization to identify and manage risks, providing coordinated advice and assistance on suite of services like Independence, Conflicts, Compliance, regulatory, policy and security issues as well as dealing with claims and queries regarding ethics. Formed in 2007, the RMS team is growing rapidly as a Center of Excellence for all standardized quality/compliance related activities.
This role will be part of the largest sub-service function, i.e., Independence within Risk Management Services (RMS) responsible for assisting EY professionals to maintain auditor objectivity by identifying and mitigating any potential conflicts of interest that could compromise an auditors independence. This includes assessing employee financial and personal relationships, conducting investigations, providing guidance on resolving personal independence and monitoring for new independence threats.
RMS Independence team is currently 950+ people strong, operating from 3 countries and 5 centers : India (Gurugram, Kochi, Bengaluru), Poland (Wroclaw), Philippines (Manila). The team is closely integrated with Global Independence and has been involved in the development of key Independence processes.
This role offers the opportunity to contribute to EYs reputation as an independent auditor by supporting niche Independence profiles within a dynamic and growing environment. Youll work closely with EY professionals to mitigate their personal independence-related risks. This will involve collaborating with senior team members and stakeholders to resolve queries and gather information, ultimately positioning you as a subject matter expert in Independence processes.
Key Responsibilities :
Conduct In-depth Secondary Research : Utilize internal and external sources to gather critical information that is required for different compliance requirement review and approvals.
Service Delivery: Process daily inflow of requests, manage administrative activities and communicating process related nuances appropriately to the Business team/audit teams/ Alliance formation & team managers at GDS.
Document Acquisition : Gather and manage essential documents from EY business, Alliance formation and Regional Independence team professionals ensuring all details are accurate and up to date in EY internal systems
Approval Process Management : Oversee the Business relationship Independence approval submission process for various internal approvals, meticulously tracking progress and addressing any issues that arise.
Diligent Follow-ups : Maintain a proactive approach to follow-ups, guaranteeing all approvals are obtained and projects reach successful closure.
Cross-functional Coordination : Seamlessly coordinate with business, regional Independence and Alliance formation teams to ensure that all necessary information and documents are received
Knowledge and Skill requirement
Strong research and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and coordination abilities.
Proficient in using corporate internal tools and software.
Basic understanding of Independence concepts and business relationships from accounting firms perspective
Proactive mindset, adept at managing multiple tasks and deadlines.
Consultation and reporting skills.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Education: Graduate/post-graduate
Experience: 0 to 3 years of relevant experience
Basic understanding of type of company structures, Ownership structures, and basic risk management concepts.
Business relationships & BRIDGE tool knowledge would be added advantage
Ideally, you ll also have
Flexibility to work in rotational shifts
Technologies and Tools
Experience in MS office suites like Microsoft 365, MS excel, PowerPoint
What you can look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
A team which has its foundation in the core values of trust, respect and teaming. The team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills.
Opportunities to work with Global Executive risk management teams on strengthening and monitoring compliance framework
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership : We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Description:
Job Description: Sales Executive (Inside Sales, UAE Market)
Company: Inox Global
Location: Thrissur, Kerala (office-based)
Department: Sales
Reports to: [Sales Manager / Head of Sales]
Employment type: Full-time
About the Role
Inox Global is looking for a Sales Executive to grow our business in the UAE market. Working from our Thrissur office, you will reach customers by telephone, WhatsApp, and email, follow up on enquiries, generate new leads, and bring repeat and additional business from our existing customers. Candidates with prior work experience in the UAE/Gulf (Gulf returnees) are strongly preferred.
Qualifications and Requirements
Bachelors degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Previous work experience in the UAE or other GCC countries is preferred, in sales, customer service, or a related role
[1-3] years of experience in inside sales, telesales, or export/B2B sales; strong freshers may be considered
Excellent spoken and written English; Arabic, Hindi, or Urdu is an added advantage
Confident and professional on phone calls, WhatsApp, and email
Good negotiation, follow-up, and persistence skills
Basic knowledge of CRM tools, MS Excel, and email/WhatsApp Business
Ability to work to UAE business hours (UAE is 1.5 hours behind IST) [adjust shift timings as needed]
Target-driven, organised, and able to manage multiple leads at once
Preferred Skills
Gulf/UAE work experience (Gulf returnee), with first-hand understanding of UAE business culture, buying habits, and communication style
Existing contacts or network among UAE businesses, traders, or contractors
Knowledge of [your product category, e.g., stainless steel, industrial supplies, building materials]
Understanding of export documentation, Incoterms, and international payment terms
Familiarity with UAE market practices such as VAT, credit terms, and local suppliers
Offer: Competitive salary plus incentives, training, and growth opportunities.
AboutCompany: INOX GLOBAL is a dynamic and professionally managed organization. The Company maintains stocks of Stainless Steel to a wide variety of segments in Engineering sectors. We are empowered by an authorized & genuine vendor base that helps us in providing quality products to our esteemed clients. We are dedicated to provide unique, genuine & outstanding services to our clients & bring an innovative results to various difficult problems, backed by the experienced staff & technical know-how. We develop & maintain good relationships with all our valuable customers, by offering a wide range of products & services under one roof."

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Process all guest check-ins by confirming reservations, assigning room, and issuing and activating room key. Process all payment types such as room charges, cash, checks, debit, or credit. Process all check-outs including resolving any late and disputed charges. Answer, record, and process all guest calls, messages, requests, questions, or concerns. Coordinate with Housekeeping to track readiness of rooms for check-in. Communicate parking procedures to guests/visitors and dispatch bell staff or valet staff as needed. Supply guests with directions and information regarding property and local areas of interest. Run daily reports (number of arrivals, departures), identify any special requests, and check reports for accuracy. Complete designated cashier and closing reports in the computer system. Cash guests personal checks and travelers checks. Count bank at the beginning and end of shift. Balance and drop receipts according to Accounting specifications.
Follow all company safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Function Summary
The Bancassurance Department within Axis Max Life Insurance plays a critical role in driving the distribution of life insurance products through our strategic partnership with Yes Bank. This department leverages Yes Bank s existing customer base and infrastructure to offer insurance solutions.
Bancassurance Department serves as a bridge between Axis Max Life Insurance Company and Yes Bank, ensuring that insurance products are effectively marketed and sold to a wide customer base, while maintaining high standards of customer service, compliance, and performance.
Below is a summary of the key functions typically performed by the Bancassurance Department:
Sales and Distribution Management
Customer Relationship Management
Compliance and Regulatory Oversight


Job Summary
This role involves establishing and strengthening relationships with branch managers and staff to generate leads, the candidate will actively participate in branch activities. The incumbent will be responsible for closing sales and ensuring follow-up on issuance.
A key aspect of the role is to increase the bank s customer awareness about life insurance solutions and achieve targeted penetration of cross-sell within the branch s customer base. The candidate will effectively drive reward and recognition programs for bank staff and regularly train them on life insurance concepts and new product introductions.


Key Responsibilities
Establishing strengthening relationship with branch manager staff to gain leads from them.
Involvement in work site activities (putting up stalls and making presentations in corporate.
Closing sale and following up on issuance.
Increasing bank s customer awareness about Life Insurance solutions and achieve the targeted penetration on cross sell within the branch s customer base.
Drive effectively the Reward and recognition programs launched for the bank staff.
Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.


Key skills required
Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity.


Desired qualification and experience
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
6 months to 3 years of experience in sales
Good communication skills - English regional language (preferred)
Age group: 21-28 years
Preferably has own conveyance

Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Job Summary
Role Overview The Field Officer is the frontline member of the KiDS project team, responsible for direct engagement with schools, teachers, students, parents, and communities in the assigned districts. The role reports to the District Coordinator or Programme Manager and requires consistent field presence and strong community engagement skills.
Location
Saharanpur, Chitrakoot, Jhansi, Lucknow, Kanpur
Organization
YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF)
Project
KiDS (Kids and Diabetes in Schools) - supported by Sanofi
Experience
Minimum 3 years of experience in development, health, education, or nutrition programmes at the district level.
Qualifications
Post-graduation in Home Science, Nutrition, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
Working knowledge of the education department system in UP is required.
Key Responsibilities
Field Implementation Facilitate teacher training sessions using the KiDS manual in assigned schools.
Support trained teachers in conducting diabetes awareness sessions with students.
Organise and facilitate parent-teacher meetings in project schools.
Map the communities linked to each project school and conduct community awareness meetings.
Identify and support diabetes ambassadors within communities who can sustain awareness efforts beyond the project period.
Documentation and Reporting Document all field activities systematically and compile data for submission to the District Coordinator / Programme Manager.
Provide field data and inputs for programme reports in coordination with the ME Officer.
Maintain complete records of referrals to health facilities, forms, and related documentation.
Travel The role requires approximately 20 days of field travel per month. Travel and logistics support will be provided under the project.
Skills
Proficiency in MS Excel for data entry and reporting.
Strong written and oral communication skills in Hindi and English.
Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently in field settings with minimal supervision.

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Management and Support (Specialized in Laboratory, Physiology, and Rehabilitation Equipment)
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 6 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Medical Electronic or Electronic or Biomedical Engineering.
-Certifications or training in laboratory or rehabilitation equipment preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation-related equipment, with at least 5 completed projects.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 3 projects.
-Hands-on experience in the installation, calibration, and basic maintenance of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
Role Responsibilities:
Equipment Installation Calibration:
-Lead the installation, setup, and calibration of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment at MSSSCRC.
-Ensure that equipment is installed according to specifications and regulatory standards, meeting safety and performance requirements.
-Conduct initial testing to verify the functionality of newly installed equipment, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance.
Compliance and Quality Assurance:
-Perform routine checks and inspections to ensure that equipment continues to meet operational standards and regulatory requirements.
-Monitor equipment performance, ensuring it adheres to safety and operational regulations in line with national and international standards.
-Assist in compliance audits and support the creation of reports to document adherence to health regulations.
Troubleshooting Technical Support:
-Provide technical troubleshooting support for any malfunctioning laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation equipment.
-Offer quick resolutions for minor issues and escalate complex technical problems to senior specialists or vendors for further investigation and resolution.
-Diagnose equipment faults and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal functionality.
Training MSSSCRC Staff on Equipment Use Maintenance:
-Develop and deliver training programs for MSSSCRC staff (clinical, technical, and administrative) on the correct use, handling, and safety protocols for laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Conduct hands-on training sessions to ensure staff are proficient in operating the equipment, including detailed instructions on how to maintain and troubleshoot the equipment.
-Create training materials and user manuals tailored to the equipment, ensuring that staff have clear, accessible guides for reference.
-Assess staff competency in operating the equipment and provide additional guidance or refresher courses as necessary to ensure staff confidence and safety in equipment handling.
-Provide specialized training in equipment calibration, regular maintenance tasks, and how to perform troubleshooting for common issues.
Record Maintenance Reporting:
-Maintain accurate and detailed records of equipment installation, servicing, and performance, ensuring that all equipment data is properly documented and accessible.
-Track service histories, calibration schedules, and any repairs or modifications made to the equipment.
-Assist in preparing periodic reports on equipment status, including any issues identified, actions taken, and overall performance evaluation.
-Coordination with Senior Specialists Vendors:
-Collaborate with senior specialists and vendors to manage upgrades, repairs, and replacements of equipment.
-Coordinate with vendors to procure spare parts and ensure that all equipment remains functional throughout the project duration.
-Ensure timely maintenance schedules are followed to minimize equipment downtime and avoid disruptions in medical services.
Project Support Management:
-Assist in the management of project timelines, ensuring that equipment-related tasks such as installation, calibration, and maintenance are completed on schedule.
-Support project teams in planning and procuring equipment, ensuring that equipment specifications meet the project s healthcare requirements.
-Provide guidance and technical input in the planning phase for procurement of new laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
Safety Operational Efficiency:
-Conduct regular safety checks to ensure that all equipment complies with health and safety regulations and operates efficiently.
-Evaluate the operational efficiency of equipment and recommend improvements or upgrades when necessary.
-Ensure that all equipment is safely decommissioned or disposed of at the end of its useful life.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Cost Expert
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 4 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Biomedical Engineering/Medical electronics or Electronic.
-Certifications in cost analysis or financial planning preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum of 15 years of experience in cost analysis of medical equipment or related fields.
-At least 7 years of experience in the medical or healthcare sector.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 2 projects.
-Experience working on Japanese ODA Loan Projects in any sector.
-At least 1 year of experience in SAARC or ASEAN regions (preferable).
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
-Strong knowledge of procurement processes and cost optimization techniques.

Role Responsibilities:
Cost Estimation Budgeting:
-Lead the estimation of preliminary project equipment costs during the basic design phase, ensuring accurate forecasting of all associated costs.
-Develop cost models and prepare detailed cost estimates for medical equipment procurement and installation.
-Identify and quantify the costs related to equipment, components, consumables, transportation, and installation work, ensuring that the budget is comprehensive and aligned with project objectives.
Survey Data Collection:
-Conduct surveys of existing or similar healthcare facilities to gather information on operational and maintenance costs of medical equipment.
-Assess the existing equipment in operational facilities to understand their functionality, lifespan, and associated costs to make informed decisions.
-Collect data on the cost of spare parts, consumables, and other supplies necessary for the proper functioning of medical equipment.
Evaluation of Local Distributors Service Providers:
-Survey local distributors for warranty services, maintenance contract availability, and pricing.
-Evaluate the reliability and service offerings of local vendors, ensuring they meet the operational needs of the project and provide cost-effective maintenance solutions.
Cost Breakdown Analysis:
-Collect and analyze detailed data on equipment-related costs, including main components, consumables, transportation costs, turnkey work, maintenance contracts, and other related services.
-Ensure a thorough understanding of all cost components and provide a comprehensive cost breakdown for each equipment item.
-Collaborate with procurement teams to optimize cost-efficiency and select the best value options for the project.
Tender Evaluation Compliance:
-Assist the Project Management Unit (PMU) in evaluating financial documents related to equipment tenders, ensuring that the costs are in line with the project s financial goals.
-Review tender submissions for compliance with project specifications, budget constraints, and cost-effectiveness.
-Provide recommendations on cost optimization and value for money, ensuring that all financial aspects of the tender align with project needs.
Cost Reporting Documentation:
-Prepare and maintain detailed reports on cost estimations, budgets, and financial evaluations related to medical equipment.
-Ensure that all cost reports are accurately documented and available for review by the project team and stakeholders.
-Track and report any changes in cost projections, identifying areas where cost savings or adjustments can be made.
Collaboration with Project Stakeholders:
-Work closely with the project team, including procurement specialists and clinical engineers, to align equipment cost management with overall project goals.
-Provide regular updates on cost estimations, procurement strategies, and cost optimization efforts to senior management and stakeholders.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications
Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities; Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
(i) To advise the concerned departments in planning and organizing measures necessary for Safe Work Practices for all employees thus prevent personal injuries.
(ii) To implement Work Permit System across the Plant and create awareness on importance adhering to Safe Work Practices.
(iii) To carry our Safety Audit periodically and evaluate the effectiveness of the action taken or proposed to be taken to prevent personal injuries.
(iv) To ensure availability of personal protective equipment and usage appropriately.
(v) To advise on matters relating to carrying out of plant safety inspections.
(vi) To carry out plant safety inspections in order to observe the physical conditions of work and the work practices and procedures followed by workers and to render advise on measures to be adopted for removing the unsafe physical conditions and preventing unsafe actions by workers.
(vii) To render assistance on matters relating to reporting and investigation of industrial accidents and occupational diseases.
(viii) To encourage reporting of Near Miss and Potential hazard and address all those observations to prevent incident/accident.
(ix) To render assistance for the cases of industrial diseases contracted and in respect of dangerous occurrences reportable under rule 106 of the Pondicherry Factories Rules, 1964.
(x) To render assistance on the maintenance of such records as are necessary relating to accidents, dangerous occurrences and industrial diseases.
(xi) To conduct safety committee meeting periodically and address all such observation.
(xii) To organize in association with the concerned departments, campaigns, competitions, contests and other activities which will develop and maintain the interest of the workers in establishing and maintaining safe conditions of work and procedure; and
(xiii) to design and conduct either independently or in collaboration with the training department, suitable training and educational programs for the prevention of personal injuries and for the propagation of safety awareness.
xiv) To work for obtaining the certification of EOHS, ESG and GreenCo.
The Safety Officer will be responsible for ensuring the safety and health of all employees within the organization. This role includes developing, implementing, and overseeing safety programs and policies to maintain compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. The Safety Officer will conduct regular safety inspections, risk assessments, and audits to identify potential hazards in the workplace. This position requires the development and delivery of safety training programs to enhance employee awareness and compliance. The Safety Officer will also investigate accidents and incidents, prepare reports, and recommend corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.

Description:
About the Role:
The role involves coordinating activities related to new product introductions within the organization. It emphasizes ensuring that components are ready for production and managing the overall process of product rollouts. The position will require active engagement with cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth transitions from development to manufacturing.

About the Team:
You will be working with a dynamic and collaborative cross-functional team consisting of members from engineering, production, and quality assurance. The team is focused on driving innovation and efficiency in product development, ensuring that all members actively contribute their expertise to achieve common goals.

You are Responsible for:
Coordinating all aspects of new product introduction activities and ensuring that all parts are ready on time. Conducting production tryouts and addressing any manufacturing line issues that arise during the process. Securing necessary approvals at each stage of the product rollout and working in collaboration with the cross-functional team to resolve any challenges encountered.

To succeed in this role - you should have the following:
A strong background in electronics products such as Sensors, ECUs, DC-DC converters, Ignition coil and Rectifier and regulator. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Problem-solving abilities to quickly address manufacturing issues and the capability to adapt to changing project requirements. Experience in coordinating product introduction activities will be highly beneficial.
Job Title: Senior Engineer - NPI

Company Name: India Nippon Electricals


The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating new product introduction activities in the organization. This includes ensuring part readiness for production, conducting production tryouts to validate processes, obtaining necessary approvals, and effectively resolving any manufacturing line issues in collaboration with the cross-functional team (CFT). The role requires a strong focus on detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate new product introduction activities to ensure timely and efficient rollout.
- Ensure all parts are ready for production and meet quality standards.
- Conduct production tryouts to assess the manufacturing process and product functionality.
- Obtain necessary approvals from relevant stakeholders at each phase of the product introduction.
- Work closely with the cross-functional team to resolve any issues that arise on the manufacturing line.
- Monitor and report on the progress of new product initiatives and provide updates as required.
- Collaborate with engineering and quality assurance teams to ensure adherence to specifications.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong knowledge of electronics products, including Sensors, Electronic Control Units (ECU), DC-DC converters, and regulators (RR).
- Excellent project management skills to oversee multiple product introductions simultaneously.
- Strong problem-solving abilities to address manufacturing line issues effectively.
- Familiarity with manufacturing processes and standards in the electronics industry.
- Proficient in using tools for project tracking, data analysis, and reporting.
- Effective communication skills to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
- Attention to detail and a systematic approach to tasks and responsibilities.

This role is crucial for ensuring that new products are introduced successfully and efficiently into production, maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

Description:
1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.

Maintain departmental reports and statutory documentation.

Collaborate with industries and academic institutions.
Contribute to institutional initiatives and continuous improvement.

Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Roles & Responsibilities

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance production efficiency, ensure quality compliance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing principles, tools, and technologies, as well as strong leadership capabilities to mentor junior engineers and coordinate team efforts.

Gold Plus Group is the second-largest glass manufacturing company in India, headquartered at Kings Mall, Rohini, Delhi. Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale

Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets

Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
