Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will be the star of your station, crafting delicious dishes and wowing our guests. With your passion for cooking and your attention to detail, youll be a valuable member of our culinary team. As a Demi Chef de Partie, you re not just overseeing the preparation of high-quality dishes - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Technical education in hospitality or culinary school.
At least 3 years as a Cook in Chinese / Banquet / Main / Pastry Kitchen in a 5-star category hotel or individual restaurant with high standards.
At least 1 year as a Commis I in an international brand hotel or individual restaurant with high standards.
Possess good leadership and training skills.
Up to date with sanitation classes.
Knowledgeable in HACCP.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Prepare great-tasting dishes: Season, cook, and test dishes according to standard recipes, ensuring consistency in taste and presentation
Supervise the kitchen team: Oversee line cooks to ensure and provide support as needed in the absence of senior chefs to ensure smooth and efficient operations
Maintain kitchen cleanliness: Keep all work areas clean, tidy, and free of cross-contamination
Ensure food quality and storage compliance: Monitor ingredient quality, ensuring proper storage and stock rotation
Assist with cost management: Contribute to controlling food costs, improving gross profit margins, and meeting departmental financial targets
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment
Uphold regulatory standards: Maintain compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations, ensuring the highest standards of guest and team member wellbeing.

Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners

Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help

Job Description Senior Manager Maintenance (Optical Fiber Cable Plant)

Position
Senior Manager Maintenance

Department
Engineering & Maintenance

Location -Verna, South Goa

Qualification
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics Engineering
MBA (Preferred)

Experience
12 -18 years of total experience in Plant Maintenance.
Mandatory: The candidate must have continuous experience in Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) Manufacturing for the previous/latest 10 years.
Experience from Automotive, FMCG, Chemical, Steel, or other manufacturing industries will not be considered.

Job Purpose

To lead the Maintenance function of the Optical Fiber Cable Plant by ensuring maximum machine availability, improving equipment reliability, minimizing downtime, managing utilities, and driving continuous improvement through preventive and predictive maintenance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Utility, and Automation maintenance activities.
Ensure maximum uptime of OFC manufacturing machines through effective preventive and predictive maintenance.
Handle breakdown analysis and implement Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA).
Plan and execute annual shutdowns and major maintenance activities.
Maintain critical utilities including Compressors, Chillers, HVAC, DG Sets, Transformers, HT/LT Systems, Air Dryers, Water Systems, and Power Distribution.
Maintain and troubleshoot OFC manufacturing equipment including:
Fiber Coloring Lines
Ribbonizing Lines
SZ Stranding Machines
Buffering Lines
Sheathing/Jacketing Extrusion Lines
Armouring Lines
Rewinding & Take-up Systems
Spark Testers and Online Testing Equipment
Lead TPM, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and reliability improvement initiatives.
Monitor machine performance through MTBF, MTTR, OEE, and downtime analysis.
Ensure availability of critical spare parts and optimize maintenance inventory.
Manage maintenance budgets, AMCs, vendor development, and contractor activities.
Ensure statutory compliance, electrical safety, and implementation of EHS standards.
Maintain SAP PM/CMMS records, maintenance history, and technical documentation.
Develop and mentor maintenance engineers, supervisors, and technicians.

Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, PLC, SCADA, Servo Drives, VFDs, and Industrial Automation.
Hands-on experience in OFC manufacturing equipment maintenance.
Expertise in Preventive, Predictive, and Reliability-Centered Maintenance.
Knowledge of SAP PM/CMMS.
Strong leadership, planning, vendor management, and problem-solving skills.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Machine Availability
Team Handling
OEE Improvement
Breakdown Reduction
Preventive Maintenance Compliance
MTBF & MTTR
Utility Availability
Maintenance Cost Control
Spare Inventory Optimization
Safety & Statutory Compliance

Mandatory Screening Criteria

Latest 10 years of experience must be in Optical Fiber Cable Manufacturing only.
Hands-on maintenance experience on OFC production machinery.
Experience in managing maintenance teams in a manufacturing plant.
Willing to work at Urse, Pune.

Interested candidate can also share their CV on Rutuja.Mohite@Finolex.com

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on Video Producer who is passionate about shooting and editing films, advertisements and digital video content.
The role involves creating engaging visual content for Delhivery's brand and marketing initiatives, from shooting on-ground stories and brand films to producing advertisements, social media videos and campaign content.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling the entire video production process independently, from setting up the camera and lighting to shooting, editing and delivering the final film.
Key Responsibilities
1. Video Shooting & Production
Independently shoot advertisements, brand films, corporate videos, social media content and documentary-style stories.
Operate professional cameras, mirrorless cameras and other video equipment.
Manage camera settings, framing, composition, camera movements and lighting.
Handle on-location shoots across offices, warehouses, operational facilities and outdoor locations.
Record quality audio and manage basic sound equipment.
Plan and execute shoots with minimal supervision.
2. Video Editing & Post-Production
Edit videos for different platforms and formats, including YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn and digital advertising.
Create engaging edits with strong storytelling, pacing, transitions and visual flow.
Perform basic colour correction, colour grading, sound mixing and audio enhancement.
Create titles, subtitles, graphics and basic motion graphics.
Adapt long-form footage into short-form videos, reels and advertisements.
Deliver final videos in the required aspect ratios, resolutions and formats.
3. Creative Collaboration
Work with the Brand and Marketing teams to translate creative briefs into effective video content.
Contribute ideas on visual storytelling, camera treatments and editing styles.
Collaborate with internal teams, employees and external production partners during shoots.
Stay updated on emerging video production techniques, equipment and editing trends.
Skills & Qualifications
2-5 years of experience in videography, video production and editing.
Strong hands-on experience in shooting and editing videos independently.
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve.
Working knowledge of After Effects is an advantage.
Good understanding of cameras, lenses, lighting, audio recording and composition.

What We Are Looking For
Someone who loves being behind the camera as much as being in the editing room.
A strong visual sense and an eye for detail.
Someone who can independently take ownership of a video assignment from shoot to final edit.
A practical, resourceful individual who can produce quality content without always depending on large production crews.
A portfolio demonstrating actual shooting and editing work is essential.

Description:
Job Description
Role Objective
The objective of this team is to identify, onboard, and grow premium, high-CFT and trending
outlets on Dineout, with a strong focus on being the first mover in acquiring high-potential
restaurants before competitors such as District.
The team will initially focus on premium outlet acquisition and onboarding, with a long-term
mandate to also own account management, GOV growth, market share, and exclusive
campaigns/events for these strategic accounts.

Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs)
1. Identify Premium High-Potential Outlets
Identify premium restaurants and high-CFT outlets across priority markets.
Track trending, upcoming, and high-demand restaurants that have strong customer pull.
Build a pipeline of strategically important outlets based on brand value, CFT potential, customer demand, and market relevance.
Proactively identify new restaurant launches and emerging premium brands.
2. Close Comp-Gaps for Premium Outlets
Identify premium outlets that are already live on Z but are missing from Dineout.
Prioritize and close these Comp-Gaps to ensure strong outlet coverage.
Develop a systematic approach to track, prioritize, and convert high-value Z-Gap opportunities.
3. First-Mover Advantage
Ensure Dineout is the first mover in onboarding high-value premium outlets, wherever possible.
Track upcoming launches, competitor movements, and market trends to identify opportunities before other competitors.
Build strong relationships with restaurant owners, management teams, and key decision-makers to secure early partnerships.
Create a culture of proactive acquisition rather than reactive competitor-led onboarding.
Long-Term Scope of the Team
The role is expected to evolve beyond acquisition into end-to-end ownership of strategic
premium accounts.
1. Account Management
Build account management capabilities within the team for outlets onboarded by them.
Maintain strong relationships with premium restaurant partners.
Drive partner engagement, retention, and business growth after onboarding.
Identify opportunities to deepen the relationship and increase business contribution.
2. Drive GOV Growth Market Share
Own and drive GOV growth from the premium outlet portfolio.
Increase Dineouts market share within premium restaurant segments.
Identify opportunities to improve outlet performance, customer transactions, and overall business contribution.
3. Exclusive Campaigns Events
Identify premium partners suitable for exclusive campaigns, partnerships, and events.
Work closely with internal teams to conceptualize and execute differentiated campaigns.
Leverage Scenes to create visibility and demand for premium restaurant partners.
Build exclusive restaurant-led experiences and campaigns that strengthen Dineouts proposition for both consumers and restaurant partners.
Key Success Metrics
The performance of the team can be evaluated through:
Number and quality of premium/high-CFT outlets identified.
Premium outlet onboarding rate.
Reduction in Z-Gaps.
First-mover onboarding rate versus competitors.
GOV generated from newly onboarded premium outlets.
GOV growth from managed accounts.
Dineout market share within the premium outlet segment.
Number and quality of exclusive campaigns/events launched. Qualifications
Strong business development and sales orientation.
Ability to identify and pursue high-value opportunities proactively.
Strong understanding of the premium restaurant/FB ecosystem.
Excellent relationship-building and negotiation skills.
Ability to work with data and identify business opportunities.
Ability to transition from pure acquisition into strategic account management

Customer-first mindset with focus on scalability and automation

Functions as the strategic business leader of property operations and acts as General Manager in his/her absence.
Areas of responsibility include Front Office, Retail/Gift Shops, Recreation/Fitness Center, Housekeeping, Security/Loss Prevention, Engineering/Maintece, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Event Management, where applicable.
Position works with direct reports (Executive Committee members and department heads) to develop and implement the operations strategy and ensuring implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
The position ensuring operations meet the brand s target customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes ficial performance.
As a member of the Executive Committee, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Profitability and Departmental Budgets
- Keeps operations team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired ficial results.
- Ensures that all operational areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.
- Reviews ficial reports and statements to determine how Operations is performing against budget.
- Ensures capital expenditure funds are being used to address the priorities outlined in the service strategy.
- Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establishing ways to improve the departments ficial performance.
- Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.
- Identifies and analyzes operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
- Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy rate, wages and controllable expenses.
- Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holds team accountable for results.
- Develops an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand s business strategy and leads its execution.
- Makes and executes key decisions to keep property moving forward towards achievement of goals.
Managing Property Operations
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding operational goals to produce desired results on a continuous basis.
- Ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
- Ensures core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.
- Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
Leading Property Operations Teams
- Establishes a vision for product and service delivery on property.
- Champions the brand s service vision for product and service delivery and ensuring alignment amongst the property leadership team.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Hires operations management team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
- Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
- Utilizes an open door policy and reviewing employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Stays knowledgeable of leadership talent in the property.
- Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.

As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You dial. You pitch. You close. Repeat

Location perks - Build your career in Goa (yes, really)

At Delhivery, we use technology to drive supply chain innovation. Our mission is to fulfill all of India’s online and offline consumption demand through best-in-class industry solutions, domain expertise and pan-India operations

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! As a Kitchen Porter, you re not just keeping our kitchen and dining areas sparkling clean - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Keep serviceware spotless: Clean all chinaware, silverware, and cooking utensils, scrub pots and pans, and polish silver
Monitor stock levels: Ensure supplies and equipment are always well stocked and organized for seamless service
Maintain kitchen cleanliness: Perform essential cleaning tasks, including mopping and waste removal
Support events delivery: Prepare and set up clean serviceware for banquets and functions
Follow health and safety protocols: Handle hazardous substances safely and comply with all hygiene and safety regulations
Report hazards and maintenance needs: Promptly alert the supervisor on duty to any safety concerns or equipment issues
Train and mentor team members: Share your expertise with new team members to help strengthen team performance

Description:
Job description

About the Role

We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.

What Youll Do

Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What Were Looking For

0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?

Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.

If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Summary
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.

Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.

Monitor first 10 shipments closely flag TAT breaches, address NDR issues, and resolve any documentation gaps
Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction
3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Overseeing daily restaurant operations to ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently, you will create a warm and welcoming atmosphere where every guest feels like a VIP. You are responsible for developing a menu that creates unique dining experiences that will leave our guests in awe. As a Restaurant Manager, you re not just elevating the dining experience - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Proven experience as an Outlet Manager or similar role in a high-end restaurant or hotel, or 2-3 years as an Assistant Manager.
Assistant Manager: The ideal candidate should possess at least 1 year of experience as an Assistant Outlet Manager.
High school diploma or equivalent; hospitality training is a plus
Excellent communication, grooming, and interpersonal skills
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
Friendly, professional, and guest-focused
Able to work flexible shifts
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Operational Oversight: Manage daily outlet operations to ensure smooth service and adherence to brand standards.
Team Leadership: Supervise, train, and motivate staff to deliver exceptional guest experiences and maintain high performance.
Guest Experience Management: Ensure personalized service, handle guest feedback, and resolve issues promptly to enhance satisfaction.
Inventory Cost Control: Monitor stock levels, manage ordering, and control costs to optimize profitability.
Sales Revenue Support: Drive upselling initiatives, monitor sales performance, and support revenue targets.
Compliance Hygiene: Ensure adherence to health, safety, and hygiene regulations across all outlet areas.
Coordination Communication: Collaborate with kitchen, housekeeping, and other departments for seamless service delivery.
Food Safety Regulations: Ensuring that all food safety standards are met.

JOB SUMMARY
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable. Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Assists in supervising daily shift operations.
- Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.
- Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
- Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
- Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
- Opens and closes restaurant shifts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Meets and greets guests.
Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Supervises on-going training initiatives.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

JOB SUMMARY
Position responsible for all the food and beverage operations, which includes all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations. Oversees guest and employee satisfaction, maintaining standards and meeting or exceeding financial goals. Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of all applicable food and beverage laws and regulations. Develops and implements business plan for food and beverage.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Developing and Maintaining Budgets
- Develops and manages all financial, employee engagement and guest satisfaction plans and actions for Food and Beverage departments.
- Maintains a positive cost management index for kitchen and restaurant operations.
- Utilizes budgets to understand financial objectives.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Manages the Food and Beverage departments (not catering sales).
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Oversees all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
- Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.
- Provides excellent customer service to all employees.
- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.
- Provides a learning atmosphere with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Provides proactive coaching and counseling to team members.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Monitors and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Sets clear expectations with the employees and team leaders and verifies that appropriate rewards are given if expectations are exceeded.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides excellent customer service.
- Responds quickly and proactively to guests concerns.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Drives alignment of all employees, team leaders and managers to the brands service culture.
- Sets service expectations for all guests internally and externally.
- Takes ownership of a guest complaint/problem until it is resolved or it has been addressed by the appropriate manager or employee.
- Verifies all banquet functions are up to standard and exceed guests expectations.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Manages day-to-day operations, drives quality, and verifies standards are meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Conducts performance reviews in a timely manner.
- Promotes both Guarantee of Fair Treatment and Open Door policies.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Develops an action plan to attack need areas and expand on strengths based on employee engagement and guest satisfaction results.
Additional Responsibilities
- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Drives effective departmental communication and information systems through logs, department meetings and property meetings.

Description:
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Sales Associate - Health Insurance
Position: Sales Associate
Department: Sales & Business Development
Industry: Health Insurance / Insurance Distribution
Location: Meghalaya
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reporting To: State Head
1. About the Role
Smart IT Services Pvt. Ltd. is looking for energetic, customer-focused, and target-oriented candidates for the position of Sales Associate - Health Insurance. The selected candidates will be responsible for promoting health insurance products, generating business leads, assisting customers in selecting suitable insurance plans, and achieving assigned sales targets.
The role requires excellent communication, customer relationship management, and sales skills, along with a willingness to work in a target-driven environment.
2. Key Responsibilities
Identify and generate new business leads through field visits, customer referrals, tele calling, and other sales activities.
Promote and sell health insurance policies to individuals, families, and prospective customers.
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable health insurance plans.
Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to overall business growth.
Maintain accurate sales records, customer databases, and daily activity reports.

3. Eligibility Criteria
Minimum: 10+2 / Higher Secondary.
Graduate in any discipline preferred.

Experience:
Freshers with good communication and sales aptitude may apply.
Experience in health insurance, life insurance, banking, financial services, or field sales will be an added advantage.

4. Required Skills
Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Basic understanding of health insurance products or willingness to learn.
Willingness to travel locally for field sales.

5. Compensation and Benefits
Salary: As per company norms and candidate experience.
Attractive sales incentives based on performance, as applicable.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Customer satisfaction and retention.
Policy renewal and referral generation.

7. Candidate Requirements
Strong knowledge of the Meghalaya market and local business environment will be preferred.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of district-level business targets.
Good communication skills in English; knowledge of local/regional languages are Mandatory.

Interested candidates may share their updated CV: hr.executive@smartitservices.in

Description:
Job Responsibilities VAPT Engineer
Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) for web applications, APIs, networks, and IT infrastructure.
Conduct authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability assessments to identify security weaknesses.
Execute manual penetration testing to validate vulnerabilities and assess their exploitability.
Use security testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Identify and validate security vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10 risks and common network security weaknesses.
Prepare detailed VAPT reports covering identified vulnerabilities, severity levels, technical evidence, risk impact, and remediation recommendations.
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to support vulnerability remediation.
Perform retesting after remediation and verify vulnerability closure.
Support secure code review and application security assessments.
Maintain VAPT documentation, testing procedures, and assessment records.
Support security compliance audits and assessments in accordance with applicable security standards and organizational policies.
Ensure all penetration testing activities are conducted within the approved scope and follow established security testing methodologies.
Required Technical Skills
Hands-on experience in VAPT and manual penetration testing.
Knowledge of web application, API, network, and infrastructure security testing.
Experience with Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG).
Ability to prepare technical VAPT reports and recommend remediation measures.
Experience with vulnerability validation, remediation tracking, and retesting.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with practical experience executing penetration tests, validating vulnerabilities, preparing technical reports, and conducting remediation retesting are preferred. Candidates with experience limited to GRC, compliance, or reviewing third-party VAPT reports may not be suitable for this hands-on role.

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Manager - Training

The Manager - Training will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing training programs aimed at enhancing the skills and knowledge of employees within the organization. This role involves conducting training needs assessments, designing training materials, and delivering engaging training sessions. The Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure alignment of training programs with company objectives and employee performance metrics. Additionally, the role requires tracking and reporting on training effectiveness and participating in continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Conduct training needs assessments to identify gaps in employee skills and knowledge.
2. Design and develop training programs and materials tailored to various employee groups.
3. Deliver engaging and effective training sessions using various instructional techniques.
4. Collaborate with department heads to ensure training aligns with business goals.
5. Evaluate training effectiveness through surveys, assessments, and performance metrics.
6. Provide coaching and support to employees to reinforce learning outcomes.
7. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in training and development.
8. Manage training budgets and resources efficiently.

Skills and Tools Required:
1. Strong communication and presentation skills.
2. Ability to design and develop training materials and programs.
3. Knowledge of adult learning principles and training methodologies.
4. Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and training software.
5. Analytical skills to assess training effectiveness and make data-driven decisions.
6. Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
7. Project management skills to oversee training initiatives and meet deadlines.
8. Familiarity with performance management systems and tools.
9. Innovative thinking to create engaging and effective training solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
2. Proven experience in training and development within the insurance or financial services industry.
3. Certification in training or instructional design is a plus.

Description:
Job Summary
The Civil Engineer will be responsible for planning, technical assessment, execution monitoring and quality supervision of construction, renovation, repair and infrastructure-development works undertaken by the Organisation. The role will ensure that civil works are completed in accordance with approved designs, specifications, budgets, timelines, safety requirements and organisational procurement and financial procedures. The position will also provide technical documentation and measurement-based verification to support transparent project implementation and payment processing.
Meghalaya


Responsibilities

A. Site Assessment and Technical Planning
Conduct site visits and assess existing infrastructure, site conditions and project requirements.
Prepare technical feasibility reports, layouts, drawings and specifications, as required.
Prepare detailed cost estimates, quantity calculations and Bills of Quantities (BOQs).
Identify material, labour, equipment and resource requirements and highlight technical risks.


B. Project Execution and Site Supervision
Supervise construction, renovation, repair and maintenance works at assigned locations.
Monitor contractors and vendors to ensure work is carried out as per approved drawings, BOQs, specifications and work orders.
Track site progress against approved timelines and budgets and submit periodic updates.
Identify delays, deviations and additional-work requirements and obtain written approval before execution of variations.
Coordinate with project teams, contractors, architects and other technical personnel.


C. Quality Control and Compliance
Inspect construction materials and workmanship at different stages of execution.
Ensure quality of materials and work conforms to approved specifications and applicable engineering standards.
Identify defects and recommend corrective measures within agreed timelines.
Monitor compliance with applicable building regulations, site-safety requirements and relevant standards.


D. Measurement and Contractor Bill Verification
Verify physical measurements and quantities of work completed at site.
Prepare or check Measurement Books (MBs) and item-wise measurement sheets.
Verify running and final contractor bills against actual work completed, approved BOQ and agreed rates.
Provide technical certification of work completed for payment processing, subject to organisational approval.
Document quantity variations, deductions and additional items with supporting justification.


E. Budgeting and Cost Monitoring
Prepare project-wise cost estimates and provide technical inputs for budget preparation.
Monitor expenditure and identify potential cost overruns or savings.
Review technical proposals for additional work and recommend cost-effective alternatives.
Ensure that work is not undertaken beyond the approved scope without prior written authorisation.


F. Procurement and Vendor Coordination
Prepare technical specifications and BOQs for procurement of civil works and materials.
Review vendor quotations for technical compliance and support preparation of technical comparisons.
Participate in technical evaluation of contractors and vendors, as required.
Coordinate with Procurement and Finance teams to ensure complete supporting documentation.


G. Safety, Documentation and Reporting
Monitor site-safety arrangements and report unsafe conditions or incidents promptly.
Maintain site inspection reports, progress records, approved drawings, BOQs and measurement records.
Maintain stage-wise and before-and-after photographs of civil works.
Prepare completion reports and technical completion certificates after verification of work.
Provide technical clarifications and records required for management reviews, audits or donor reporting.


Qualifications and Experience
Graduate degree or diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
Relevant experience in construction, renovation, infrastructure development or civil-work supervision.
Experience in preparing BOQs, cost estimates, technical drawings and measurement books.
Working knowledge of construction materials, quality standards, site supervision and contractor bill verification.
Experience in NGO, development-sector or institutional projects will be an advantage.


Skills and Competencies
Strong technical knowledge of civil construction and renovation works.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOQs and technical specifications.
Good measurement, estimation, costing and analytical skills.
Strong coordination, communication and vendor-management skills.
Ability to prepare clear site reports and maintain accurate documentation.
Proficiency in MS Office; knowledge of AutoCAD and relevant estimation tools will be an advantage.
Ability and willingness to travel to project sites, as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance Area: Timely completion; Expected Result: Civil works completed within approved timelines.
Performance Area: Budget adherence; Expected Result: Actual cost monitored against approved estimate and budget.
Performance Area: Quality; Expected Result: Compliance with approved specifications and timely closure of defects.
Performance Area: Measurement accuracy; Expected Result: Accurate and complete MBs and quantity verification.
Performance Area: Bill verification; Expected Result: Contractor bills technically checked against actual work and approved rates.
Performance Area: Documentation; Expected Result: Timely submission of site reports, photographs and completion records.
Performance Area: Safety and compliance; Expected Result: Prompt reporting and resolution/escalation of site-safety and compliance issues.


Working Relationships
The Civil Engineer will work closely with Project/Programme teams, Administration, Procurement, Finance, contractors, vendors and other stakeholders to ensure effective planning, execution, monitoring and documentation of civil works.


Authority and Accountability
The Civil Engineer is responsible for technical assessment, site supervision, measurement and technical recommendations. The Engineer shall not independently approve budgets, vendor selection, scope variations or payments unless specifically authorised in writing. All procurement, financial and administrative approvals shall follow the Organisations delegated-authority matrix and policies.

Description:
Job Summary
You will design social media posts, carousels, ad creatives, decks and brand visuals for our B2B and B2C clients, every day.


Job Type
Full-time


Responsibilities
Social media design. Posts, carousels, stories, reel covers and thumbnails for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
Ad creatives. Static ads for Meta, Google and LinkedIn, plus versions for testing, each changing one thing (the headline, the image or the colour).
Campaign visuals. Launches, offers, events and lead generation campaigns.
Decks and collateral. Presentations, proposals, reports, brochures, banners and website graphics. Print files are done properly (CMYK, bleed, outlined fonts).
Brand consistency. Keep each clients colours, fonts and style consistent across everything.
Work the right way round. Get one sample approved before designing the full set, and design only from approved copy.
Stay organised. Name and file your work properly, and export platform-ready files.


Requirements
1 to 4 years of graphic design experience
Strong visual sense: layout, spacing, typography, colour and hierarchy
Strong in at least one of Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma or Canva (Canva alone isnt enough)
A portfolio showing social media and ad designs for real brands
Can design for several brands without making them all look the same
Takes feedback well and meets deadlines


Nice To Have
Agency experience
Basic motion graphics or animation
Understands what makes an ad creative perform
Website or landing page visuals
Builds brand templates
Uses AI design tools


Key Performance Indicators
Designs delivered on time
Few errors, and briefs followed accurately
Quick, positive response to feedback
Visual quality improving across client accounts
Tidy files and clean handovers


Working Hours
Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 6 PM, Mohali or Shillong office. Some Saturdays may be working days.

Description:
You will be the main point of contact for a small group of 3 to 5 client accounts. You run their client calls, plan and track their monthly work with our specialist teams, check the work before it reaches the client, and make sure every client gets what we promised, on time. You dont do the execution yourself. Our SEO, social media, ads, design, video and tech specialists do. You make sure it happens, and that its right.


What this Role Is
youve handled client accounts at a digital marketing agency, you understand marketing well enough to brief and check the work, and youre very organised.


What this Role Is Not
your background is IT project management, sales only, or SaaS customer support without marketing.


Responsibilities
Own your clients. Be the main contact for your 3 to 5 accounts. Lead the weekly and monthly client calls, and bring in a specialist when something technical needs explaining.
Plan the month. Take each clients agreed monthly plan and turn it into dated tasks, one task per line, on your client dashboard.
Track every day. Know whats happening on every task, spot delays early, and follow up with the team before a date slips.
Check before it goes out. Make sure every deliverable matches what the client asked for and what was agreed, after our team leads have approved the craft.
Report. Send each client a weekly update and a monthly report that explains results clearly.
Handle changes properly. Know the difference between a revision and new work. Log extra requests and get them priced, rather than quietly absorbing them.
Chase client inputs. Get the approvals, access and content you need from the client, early and in writing.
Keep and grow your accounts. Look after renewals, and spot where a client would benefit from more of our services.
Know your numbers. Understand the revenue and cost of your client group, and help keep it healthy.


Requirements
3 to 6 years of experience, with at least 2 years in client servicing or account management at a digital marketing agency
Has handled at least 3 clients at the same time
Understands social media, ads, SEO and content, and design and video well enough to brief and check the work
Very organised: trackers, dashboards or project tools like Asana, ClickUp, Trello or Google Sheets
Calm and clear in difficult client conversations
Excellent written and spoken English


Nice to Have
International clients (UK, US, UAE)
Both B2B and B2C clients
Understands marketing numbers: leads, cost per lead, traffic, engagement
Experience preparing client reports and presentations


Not Needed
Hands-on execution skills. Our specialist teams do the work.


KPIs
Your clients get what we promised, on time
Little work sent back by clients
Your clients renew and grow with us
Problems caught by you before the client notices
Clear, on-time weekly updates and monthly reports


Perks
Own a small, focused group of accounts: no juggling 15 clients
Specialist teams behind you, so you can focus on the client
A clear path to Client Servicing Lead

You have done hands-on SEO and outbound for clients, and you are ready to lead a team.

Hands-on SEO and content experience
Hands-on cold email or LinkedIn outbound experience
Has managed or guided at least 1 or 2 people (team members or freelancers)
Comfortable talking to clients, including when the news is not good
Clear written English


Nice to Have
Experience with tools like Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead or Lemlist
Worked with international clients (UK, US, UAE)
Worked on website builds or redesigns
Uses AI tools well, and checks their output properly


KPIs
Client work delivered on time and to a high standard
More traffic, leads and meetings for clients, against the targets you set
Fast replies to every lead from outbound campaigns
A team that gets better under you
Clear, on-time progress reports


Working Hours
Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 6 PM, at our Mohali or Shillong office. Some Saturdays may be working days.

You have handled clients at a digital marketing agency for several years, you can tell good marketing work from average work, and you are ready to be the final say on quality.

Calm and direct in difficult client conversations
Excellent written and spoken English

Description:
Position Details
- Position: Video Presenter & Digital Content Correspondent
- Work Location: Primarily Remote (Work From Home)
- Travel Requirements: Occasional travel may be required depending on reporting assignments, interviews, documentary shoots, or other production needs.
- Experience: Fresh graduates and experienced candidates are welcome.
- Employment: Paid position under Innercall Media Pvt. Ltd.
Key Responsibilities
- Present regional news, current affairs, and social issues through on-camera videos.
- Research and present stories related to regionalism, identity, indigenous communities, culture, history, and contemporary society.
- Participate in developing and presenting original documentary series and in-depth explainers.
- Record voice-overs and narrations for documentaries, Shorts, and long-form content.
- Conduct online interviews, moderate public discussions, and occasionally undertake field reporting when required.
- Research and prepare accurate, engaging scripts while maintaining an independent, non-partisan editorial approach.
- Collaborate remotely with the Innercall editorial team on upcoming productions.
- Help establish a consistent and recognisable on-screen identity for Innercall, building stronger connections and trust with its audience.
Recruitment & Selection Process
Round 1 Paid Assignment
Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid assignment involving a video presentation, narration, or research-based storytelling task.
The assignment will help us evaluate communication, research, storytelling, presentation skills, and understanding of regional issues.
Candidates completing the assignment according to the agreed requirements will receive the communicated payment, regardless of final selection.
Round 2 — Online Interview
Candidates selected after reviewing their assignments will be invited for an online interview.
Final selection will be based on the overall assessment of both rounds.
Who Can Apply?
We welcome applicants who:
- Have strong communication skills in English and/or Hindi.
- Are comfortable speaking on camera and recording audio.
- Have an interest in journalism, documentaries, regional affairs, and storytelling.
- Can independently research and present topics with accuracy and sensitivity.
- Are comfortable working remotely and undertaking occasional travel when required.
- Are willing to learn, contribute creative ideas, and grow professionally with the platform.

Organized and responsible in order to manage sessions, assessments, documentation, and learner.

The Infrastructure Finance Expert will provide financial and economic expertise to support the planning and appraisal of infrastructure and risk reduction interventions, with a focus on long-term resilience and efficiency.

CA/CMA or MBA (Finance)/Master of Finance and Control /M.Com /PGDBM (with specification in Finance).

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To carry out chemical analysis and quality control activities for raw materials, intermediate products, clinker and cement to ensure compliance with defined quality standards and specifications. The role will be responsible for XRF analysis, laboratory testing, monitoring chemical parameters and supporting consistent product quality throughout the manufacturing process.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Chemical Analysis & Quality Control
Conduct chemical analysis of limestone, additives, raw mix, kiln feed, clinker, gypsum, fly ash, slag and cement.
Perform routine and non-routine chemical testing as per established laboratory procedures.
Monitor key chemical parameters such as:
CaO, SiO, AlO and FeO
MgO, SO, KO, NaO and other relevant parameters
LOI and other quality indicators
Ensure test results are accurate, reliable and recorded properly.
B. XRF Operations
Operate and perform routine analysis using X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) equipment.
Prepare samples and pellets/beads as required for XRF analysis.
Perform calibration, standardization and routine checks of the XRF equipment.
Monitor instrument performance and identify abnormal readings or deviations.
Maintain XRF-related records, standards and calibration data.
Coordinate with the concerned team for troubleshooting and maintenance of XRF equipment.
C. Cement & Clinker Quality Monitoring
Monitor the chemical quality of clinker and cement at different stages of production.
Analyze and report quality deviations promptly to the concerned departments.
Support production teams in maintaining required chemical parameters.
Ensure final cement quality meets applicable BIS/IS specifications and internal quality standards.
Assist in maintaining consistency in cement quality.
D. Raw Material & Process Control
Analyze incoming raw materials and monitor their chemical characteristics.
Monitor raw mix and kiln feed quality.
Evaluate chemical variations and communicate deviations to the concerned team.
Support optimization of raw mix and process parameters based on laboratory results.
E. Laboratory Management
Ensure proper functioning, cleanliness and housekeeping of the chemical laboratory.
Maintain laboratory equipment, instruments, chemicals, reagents and standards.
Maintain proper records of test results, calibration, analysis and equipment maintenance.
Ensure safe handling, storage and disposal of laboratory chemicals.
Follow laboratory safety procedures and applicable environmental and safety requirements.
F. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain daily laboratory test reports and quality records.
Prepare and communicate test results to the concerned HOD/Manager.
Ensure timely reporting of critical quality deviations.
Maintain documentation as per departmental SOPs and quality systems.
Participate in internal/external quality audits whenever required.
3. Required Skills & Competencies
Hands-on experience in XRF analysis in a cement manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of cement chemistry and quality control.
Good understanding of raw mix, clinker and cement chemical parameters.
Knowledge of laboratory testing procedures and quality standards.
Ability to interpret XRF results and identify quality deviations.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Production, Process, Mines and Quality teams.
Good documentation and reporting skills.
Strong attention to accuracy and detail.
Knowledge of laboratory safety and chemical handling procedures.
4. Preferred Experience
Candidates should preferably have:
4+ years of relevant experience in a cement manufacturing plant.
Strong hands-on exposure to XRF operation and analysis.
Experience in cement/clinker/raw material chemical analysis.
Experience working in a Quality Control / Quality Assurance laboratory of a cement plant.
Exposure to BIS/IS standards and cement quality specifications.
Experience with laboratory instruments and calibration/standardization activities.
5. Key Performance Areas (KPIs)
Accuracy and reliability of laboratory/XRF test results.
Timely completion and reporting of chemical analysis.
Compliance with cement quality specifications.
XRF equipment uptime and proper maintenance.
Reduction of testing errors and quality deviations.
Proper maintenance of laboratory records and documentation.
Compliance with laboratory safety procedures.
Effective coordination with Production and Process departments.
Candidate Profile
Minimum Experience: 4+ Years
Mandatory Industry: Cement Manufacturing
Mandatory Technical Skill: XRF Analysis
Qualification: B.Sc./M.Sc. Chemistry or equivalent
Department: Quality Control
Ideal Candidate: A technically sound Chemistry professional with 4+ years of hands-on experience in a cement plant, particularly in XRF operation, clinker/cement chemical analysis, raw material testing and quality control, with the ability to independently handle routine laboratory operations and support process-quality improvement.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.
Compensation & Benefits

Performance-based commission and bonus structure
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

Description:
Field Associate - West Garo Hills (Garo Language)
Location: West Garo Hills, Meghalaya (Onsite)
Experience Level: 1-3 years (Relevant fellowships in enterprise/livelihoods considered)
Salary Band: 5-6 LPA
Job Summary
Ground Zero is looking for an independent, field-driven Field Associate based in West Garo Hills to strengthen women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) through our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). Working directly with community members and state livelihood frameworks, this role provides handholding support in day-to-day business operations, member engagement, governance, procurement, and market linkages across rural enterprises (agri-business, spices, etc.).
Responsibilities
Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize and engage women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business actions, including produce procurement, aggregation, and marketing.
Business Operations & Planning: Help set up ground-level business operations for agri-business and value chains. Coordinate with input suppliers, buyers, transporters, and local service providers.
Governance & Financial Records: Assist PG leaders in maintaining accurate books of accounts, meeting resolutions, governance registers, and financial discipline.
Capacity Building & Training: Facilitate block and district-level training sessions for producer groups and community cadres.
Strategic Linkages & Coordination: Build institutional linkages with local government departments, market actors, and financial institutions under the guidance of the senior team.
Reporting & Field Surveys: Conduct ground-level surveys, market studies, and maintain routine field reports on operational progress, issues, and financials.
Qualifications & Candidate Profile
Education: Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Rural Management, Development Studies, or a related field (Master s/MBA preferred).
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in rural development, SHGs/PGs, collective enterprises, or livelihood promotion. Candidates with recognized fellowships in rural enterprise development will also be considered.
Language Mandatory: Excellent written and spoken command of Garo is mandatory. Basic ability to communicate in English and Hindi is preferred.
Key Competencies: Strong community mobilization skills, basic computer literacy (MS Word, Excel), and willingness to conduct rigorous field travel.
Logistics: Having a personal two-wheeler/bike is highly advantageous for field mobility. Candidates must be open to occasional travel to Shillong and Guwahati for official meetings.
Diversity: Female candidates are preferred, though qualified male candidates are also encouraged to apply.
Hiring Process
Round 1: HR & Program Team Interview
Round 2: Practical Assignment
Round 3: Final Interview based on Assignment (with Program Lead)
Hiring Note: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Description:
Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
